sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sp_theme"><sp_theme action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><css_variables>//=Utilities
$pad-xs: 5px !default;
$pad-sm: 10px !default;
$pad: 15px !default;
$pad-md: 20px !default;
$pad-lg: 30px !default;
$pad-xl: 50px !default;

$m-xs: 5px !default;
$m-sm: 10px !default;
$m-md: 15px !default;
$m-lg: 20px !default;
$m-xl: 30px !default;

//=New Variables
//==Text color
$text-primary:                          #25282A;
$text-secondary:                        #474D5A; //--now-color_text--secondary
$text-tertiary:                         #56595B; //$text-muted --now-color_text--tertiary
$text-tertiary-light:					#DDDDDD; 
$text-white:                            #ffffff; //--now-color--neutral-0

//==Backgrounds
$background-primary:                    #ffffff; //--now-color_background--primary
$background-secondary:                  #f6f6f8; //--now-color_background--secondary
$background-tertiary:                   #F0F1F5; //--now-color_background--tertiary

//==borders
$border-primary:                        #8790A1; //--now-color_border--primary
$border-secondary:                      #ACB2BE; //--now-color_border--secondary
$border-tertiary:                       #DDDDDD;  /*#DADDE2; //--now-color_border--tertiary*/
$border-white:							#ffffff;

//==colors for selected
$select-primary: 	                    #007b58; //--now-color_selection--primary-2
$select-primary-lighter: 	            #D7EBE5; //--now-color_selection--primary-0
$select-primary-darker: 	            #003929; //--now-color_selection--primary-4

//==Primary color 
$brand-primary-darkest:                 #1D1E46; //--now-color--primary-3
$brand-primary-darker:                  #333579; //--now-color--primary-2
$brand-primary-lighter:                #7DE69B; /* #8789D2; //--now-color--interactive-1*/
$brand-primary-lightest:                #D1D2EE; //--now-color--primary-0
$brand-primary-opacity:				 	#E3E4F2; //--now-color--primary-0 (with opacity 0.5)

//==Brand Darker colors
$brand-danger-darker:                   #CC293C!default; //--now-color_alert--critical-3
$brand-warning-darker:                  #AFA400!default; //--now-color_alert--warning-3
$brand-moderate-darker:                 #6B52C4!default; //--now-color_alert--moderate-3 
$brand-low-darker:                      #6E6F78!default; //--now-color_alert--low-3 
$brand-success-darker:                  #3B7F00!default; //--now-color_alert--positive-3
$brand-info-darker:                     #297CB2!default; //--now-color_alert--info-3

//==spacing according to Ryan's design
$sp-space--xxs:                         2px;
$sp-space--xs:     	                    4px;
$sp-space--sm:     	                    8px;
$sp-space--md:    	                    12px; 
$sp-space--lg:     	                    16px;
$sp-space--xl:		                    24px;
$sp-space--xxl: 	                    32px;
$sp-space--3xl: 	                    40px;

//==Box shadow according to Ryan's design
$sp-panel-box-shadow:                   0 4px 8px 0 rgba(23,40,52,0.08);

//==Subnav background-color
$sp-nav-subnav:                         $sp-navbar-divider-color;

//==End new variables ----/


// Define NavBar
$sp-navbar-height: 		                60px;
$sp-navbar-divider-color:               #333579;

box-shadow: $btn-secondary-box-shadow;
background-color: $btn-secondary-bg;
color: $btn-secondary-color;

&:hover, &:active {
background-color: $btn-secondary-hover;
border-color: $btn-secondary-hover;
}
}

@mixin h1-styles($important: false) {
font-weight: $font-weight-bold if-important($important);
font-size: $font-size-3xl if-important($important);
line-height: 54px if-important($important);
font-family: "Poppins", sans-serif;
} 

@mixin h2-styles($important: false) {
font-weight: $font-weight-bold if-important($important);
font-size: $font-size-xl if-important($important);
line-height: 36px if-important($important);
font-family: "Poppins", sans-serif;
} 

@mixin h3-styles($important: false) {
font-weight: $font-weight-bold if-important($important);
font-size: $font-size-large if-important($important);
line-height: 21.6px if-important($important);
font-family: "Poppins", sans-serif;
}

@mixin h4-styles($important: false) {
font-weight: $font-weight-semibold if-important($important);
font-size: $font-size-base if-important($important);
line-height: 1.2 if-important($important);
font-family: "Poppins", sans-serif;
}

@mixin h5-styles($important: false) {
font-weight: $font-weight-medium if-important($important);
font-size: $font-size-sm if-important($important);
line-height: 1.2 if-important($important);
font-family: "Poppins", sans-serif;
}

@mixin breadcrumbs-links($important: false) {
color: $inverse-text-color if-important($important);
font-weight: $font-weight-normal if-important($important);
font-size: $font-size-small if-important($important);
line-height: 1.2 if-important($important);
padding: 0 $pad 0 0 if-important($important);
}

@mixin p-style {
font-weight: 400;
font-size: 14px;
line-height: 16.8px;
}

@mixin see-all-icon {
content: "";
height: 1.2rem;
width: 1.2rem;
background: no-repeat right center;
background-color: $brand-primary; //Changes the icon color
-webkit-mask-image: url($see-all-icon);
mask-image: url($see-all-icon);
//background-image: url($see-all-icon);
}

// Design element after title
@mixin after-headline {
content: "";
display: block;
margin-top: 15px;
width: 25px;
height: 3px;
background-color: $badge-bg;
}

@mixin ellipsis {
word-break: break-word;
overflow: hidden;
text-overflow: ellipsis;
display: -webkit-box;
-webkit-box-orient: vertical;
-webkit-line-clamp: 2;
}

@mixin panel-heading($important: false) {
background-color: unset if-important($important);
border-bottom: none if-important($important);
padding: 0 if-important($important);
}

@mixin panel-shadow {
border-color: transparent;
box-shadow: $box-shadow-10;
}

@mixin panel-default-styles($important: false) {
background-color: $background-primary if-important($important);
border: $border-default if-important($important);
border-radius: $border-radius-large if-important($important);
box-shadow: none if-important($important);
> .panel-heading {
@include panel-heading($important);
}
}

@mixin panel-secondary-styles($important: false) {
background-color: $background-primary if-important($important);
border: 0 if-important($important);
border-top: 10px solid $brand-primary if-important($important);
border-radius: $border-radius-large if-important($important);
box-shadow: $box-shadow-10 if-important($important);
> .panel-heading {
background: unset if-important($important);
padding: 0 0 20px if-important($important);
border-bottom: 1px solid $border-tertiary if-important($important);
}
> .panel-body {
padding: 20px 0 0  if-important($important);
}
}

// Styled Content  widget specific mixins
@mixin styled-content-action-link($important: false) {
font-weight: $font-weight-semibold if-important($important);
font-size: $font-size-sm if-important($important);
line-height: 1.2 if-important($important);
}

@mixin border-hover-styles-before-hover($important: false) {
position: relative if-important($important);
box-sizing: border-box if-important($important);
@include pseudo-element('before') {
content: '';
border: $border-default-width solid transparent if-important($important);
top: -$border-default-width if-important($important);
left: -$border-default-width if-important($important);
border-top-left-radius: $border-radius-medium if-important($important);
height: 0 if-important($important);
width: 0 if-important($important);
box-sizing: inherit if-important($important);
position: absolute if-important($important);
}

@include pseudo-element('after') {
content: '';
border: $border-default-width solid transparent if-important($important);
border-bottom-right-radius: $border-radius-medium if-important($important);
bottom: -$border-default-width if-important($important);
right: -$border-default-width if-important($important);
height: 0 if-important($important);
width: 0 if-important($important);
box-sizing: inherit if-important($important);
position: absolute if-important($important);
}
}

@mixin border-hover-styles-after-hover($important: false) {
@include pseudo-element('before') {
width: calc(100% + ($border-default-width * 2)) if-important($important);
height: calc(100% + ($border-default-width * 2)) if-important($important);
border-top-color: $border-hover-color if-important($important);
border-right-color: $border-hover-color if-important($important);
border-top-right-radius: $border-radius-medium if-important($important);
border-bottom-right-radius: $border-radius-medium if-important($important);
transition:
border-top-left-radius 0s,
width 0.1s ease-out,
border-top-right-radius 0s 0.1s,
height 0.1s ease-out 0.1s,
border-bottom-right-radius 0s 0.2s;
}

@include pseudo-element('after') {
width: calc(100% + ($border-default-width * 2)) if-important($important);
height: calc(100% + ($border-default-width * 2)) if-important($important);
border-bottom-color: $border-hover-color if-important($important);
border-left-color: $border-hover-color if-important($important);
border-top-left-radius: $border-radius-medium if-important($important);
border-bottom-left-radius: $border-radius-medium if-important($important);
transition:
border-bottom-right-radius 0s,
border-color 0s ease-out 0.2s,
width 0.1s ease-out 0.2s,
border-bottom-left-radius 0s 0.3s,
height 0.1s ease-out 0.30s,
border-radius-top-left-radius 0s 0.4s;
}
}

// Recommended for you panel hover
@mixin content-card-hover($important: false) {
//border: 0.15rem solid #1D4D52 if-important($important);
box-shadow: none if-important($important);
//transition: outline 0.6s linear if-important($important);
//cursor: pointer;
@include border-hover-styles-after-hover($important);
}

// Topic Cards
@mixin topic-card($important: false) {
background-color: $background-primary if-important($important);
max-width: unset if-important($important);
box-shadow: none if-important($important);
border: $border-default if-important($important);
border-radius: $border-radius-medium if-important($important);
max-height: 66px;
@include border-hover-styles-before-hover($important);
}

// Content Card Panels
@mixin content-card-panel($important: false) {
//transition: color 0.25s;
background-color: $background-primary if-important($important);
padding: $pad-md if-important($important);
border: $border-default if-important($important);
box-shadow: none if-important($important);
@include border-hover-styles-before-hover($important);
}

// Content Card Badge
@mixin card-badge {
font-weight: $font-weight-bold;
line-height: 1.2;
gap: $pad-sm; // 10px
}

// Announcements
@mixin announcment-panel {
background-color: $brand-primary;
background-size: cover;
border: solid 3px $background-primary;
box-shadow: $box-shadow-10;
color: $text-white;
padding-bottom: $pad;

h3, .h2 {
margin-top: 0;

&::after {
@include after-headline;
}
}

a {
color: $text-white;
}

p {
@include ellipsis;
-webkit-line-clamp: 5;

a {
color: #E4EBF2;
font-weight: $font-weight-medium;

&:hover {
color: $text-white;
}
}
}
}

@mixin underline-hover-effect-no-hover($color: $brand-primary) {
text-decoration: none;
background-image: -webkit-gradient(linear, left top, left bottom, from($color), to($color));
background-image: linear-gradient($color, $color);
background-position: 0% 100%;
background-repeat: no-repeat;
background-size: 0% 3px;
-webkit-transition: background-size 0.2s;
transition: background-size 0.2s;
width: -webkit-fit-content;
width: -moz-fit-content;
width: fit-content;
display: inline;
padding-bottom: 1px;
}

@mixin underline-hover-effect-hover {
background-size: 100% 2px;
padding-bottom: 1px;
}

@mixin title-after-line {
display: flex;
align-items: center;
gap: 20px;
&::after {
content: '';
height: 1px;
background-color: $border-tertiary;
display: block;
flex: 1;
}

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sp_widget"><sp_widget action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><category>custom</category><client_script><![CDATA[api.controller = function ($scope, $rootScope, $location, $timeout, $window) {
	var c = this;

	$rootScope.$on('$locationChangeSuccess', function (event, newUrl, oldUrl) {
		c.data.action = 'getTopicId';
		c.server.update().then(function(res) {
			c.data.topic_id = res.topic_id;
		});
	});

	c.closeSideNav = function(e) {
		$rootScope.$broadcast('closeSideNav', e);
	};

	c.SUB_NAVBAR_HEIGHT = 51;
	c.SIMPLE_MENU_WIDTH = 268;
	c.MOBILE_DEVICE_SCREEN_WIDTH = 815; //767;
	c.MEGA_MENU_ITEMS_PADDING = 24;
	c.GRID_ITEM_PADDING_RIGHT = 24;
	c.GRID_ROW_GAP = 20;
	c.QUICK_LINKS_CONTAINER_WIDTH = 0; // TODO: Change this value to match designs
	c.MEGA_MENU_MAX_WIDTH = 1430;
	c.DELTA_OFFSET = 24;
	c.IE_PREFIX = 'Trident/';
	c.isIE = (window.navigator.userAgent.indexOf(c.IE_PREFIX) !== -1);

	c.DEFAULT_FONT_SIZE = 16;
	c.textZoomFactor = 1;

	// Events fired from/to $rootScope for responsive mobile view.
	c.SHOW_MOBILE_MEGA_MENU = 'showMobileMegaMenu';
	c.SHOW_MOBILE_MENU_ON_DESKTOP = 'showMobileMenuOnDesktop';
	c.TOGGLE_MOBILE_MENU_VISIBILITY = 'toggleMobileMenuVisibility';

	// Below 2 scope variables (showMegaMenu & selectedMenuItem) are used together to show simple/mega menu.
	$scope.showMegaMenu = false;
	$scope.selectedMenuItem = undefined;
	$scope.simpleMenuPosition = undefined;
	$scope.megaMenuPosition = undefined;
	$scope.megaMenuLeftOffset = undefined;
	$scope.levelOneTopicsWithNoChildren = [];
	$scope.selectedMenuItemRightCoordinate = 0;

	// This value is computed after the grid layout is complete based on type (single-column, 2-column, orphan-list) of items present in the grid.
	c.gridItemWidth = 0;

	// Below 2 boolean scope variables are set to true in mutually exclusive manner based on how grid item width is computed after layout
	c.usedOrphansColumnForGridItemWidth = false;
	c.allGridItemsHaveTwoColumns = false;

	/* We set this to false when we encounter 2-column grid item while resizing each item & use it to prevent executing
    the logic to fill vertical gaps formed due to presence of 2-column grid items */
	c.allGridItemsHaveSingleColumn = true;

	/* Below 2 scope variables (showMobileMenuOnDesktop, showMobileMegaMenu) have counterparts in EC Header widget also.
     So whenever we set these variables, make sure to emit an event on rootScope to update them in the former widget as well. */
	$scope.showMobileMenuOnDesktop = false;
	/* showMobileMegaMenu, isLevelOneMobileMegaMenu are used together. If showMobileMegaMenu is true and
    isLevelOneMobileMegaMenu is false it means we are currently viewing level 2 subtopics in mobile mega menu */
	$scope.showMobileMegaMenu = false;
	$scope.isLevelOneMobileMegaMenu = false;
	$scope.selectedMobileMenuItem = undefined;
	$scope.levelOneSelectedMobileMenuItem = undefined;
	$scope.lastSelectedElementId = undefined;
	$scope.isWindowResized = false;
	$scope.isMobileView = ($window.innerWidth <= c.MOBILE_DEVICE_SCREEN_WIDTH) || $rootScope.isHeaderInMobileView || c.data.isMobile ;

	/**
     * Used for capturing positions of columns in the mega menu:
     * masonry layout.
     * navigationMap : an object with key as left offset in pixel & value as array
     */
	$scope.navigationMap = {};
	$scope.keyboardNavRowIndex = 0;
	$scope.keyboardNavColIndex = 0;

	/**
     * This function provides keyboard navigation within mega menu 
     * 
     * @param {Object} event - keyboard event object
     * @see {@link c.initialiseKeyboardNav}
     * @todo change event.which to event.key after end of support for IE11.
     */
	$scope.handleMegaMenuKeyboardEvent = function (event) {
		event.preventDefault();
		var navIndex = Object.keys($scope.navigationMap);
		switch (event.which) {
			case 32://fall through, click on space or enter key
			case 13:
				$(event.target).click();
				break;
			case 38:
				if (!$(event.target).hasClass("browse-button")) {
					//if not on 1st row, move up a row
					if ($scope.keyboardNavRowIndex != 0) {
						$scope.keyboardNavRowIndex--;
					}
					else if ($scope.keyboardNavRowIndex === 0) { //if on top most link, set it to last link of the column
						$scope.keyboardNavRowIndex = $scope.navigationMap[navIndex[$scope.keyboardNavColIndex]].length - 1;
					}
				}
				break;
			case 40:
				if (!$(event.target).hasClass("browse-button")) {
					// if not on last row, move down one row
					if ($scope.keyboardNavRowIndex + 1 !== $scope.navigationMap[navIndex[$scope.keyboardNavColIndex]].length)
						$scope.keyboardNavRowIndex++;
					// if on last row, go to 1st row
					else if ($scope.keyboardNavRowIndex === $scope.navigationMap[navIndex[$scope.keyboardNavColIndex]].length - 1) {
						$scope.keyboardNavRowIndex = 0;
					}
				}
				break;
			case 37:
				$scope.keyboardNavRowIndex = 0;
				// if 1st column => move to Browse button => last column now
				if ($scope.keyboardNavColIndex === 0) {
					$scope.keyboardNavColIndex = navIndex.length - 1;
				}
				// if not 1st column, decrease the column to the left one
				else {
					$scope.keyboardNavColIndex--;
				}
				break;
			case 39:
				$scope.keyboardNavRowIndex = 0;
				// if not last column, move to next column
				if ($scope.keyboardNavColIndex + 1 < navIndex.length) {
					$scope.keyboardNavColIndex++;
				}
				// if last column (i.e. on browse button) => move to 1st column
				else {
					$scope.keyboardNavColIndex = 0;
				}
				break;
				// shift keydown & keyup events are already being handled in link script.
			case 9:
				//if shift + tab
				if (c.shiftKeyPressed) {
					if ($scope.keyboardNavRowIndex != 0) {
						$scope.keyboardNavRowIndex--;
					}
					//if it is 0th row
					else {
						// and column is also 0th, then move to parent selected navigation menu item
						if ($scope.keyboardNavColIndex === 0) {
							$(".navigation-menu-item.selected-item").focus();
							$scope.$apply(function () {
								c.closeMegaMenu();
							});
							return;
						}
						else { //if 0th row but not 0th column, then decrement column & go to its last row
							$scope.keyboardNavColIndex--;
							$scope.keyboardNavRowIndex = $scope.navigationMap[navIndex[$scope.keyboardNavColIndex]].length - 1;
						}
					}
				}
				// only tab
				else {
					// if not on the last row of current column, then increment the row
					if ($scope.navigationMap[navIndex[$scope.keyboardNavColIndex]].length != $scope.keyboardNavRowIndex + 1) {
						$scope.keyboardNavRowIndex++;
					}
					// if on the last row
					else {
						// but not the last column, then increment column & go to row 0 of next column.
						if ($scope.keyboardNavColIndex !== navIndex.length - 1) {
							$scope.keyboardNavRowIndex = 0;
							$scope.keyboardNavColIndex++;
						} //if on last row of last column, then  move to 1st column
						else if ($scope.keyboardNavColIndex === navIndex.length - 1) {
							$scope.keyboardNavColIndex = 0;
						}
					}
				}
				break;
		}
		$scope.navigationMap[navIndex[$scope.keyboardNavColIndex]][$scope.keyboardNavRowIndex].focus();
	};

	/**
     * Helper function for c.initialiseKeyboardNav
     * Searches existing column offsets in range of currentOffset ± DELTA_OFFSET
     * and returns index of the nearest column offset, else -1.
     * @param {Array} columnOffset s - array of left offsets of columns
     * @param {string} currentOffset - current element's left offset
     * @see {@link c.initialiseKeyboardNav}
    */
	var columnSearch = function (columnOffsets, currentOffset) {
		var start = 0, end = columnOffsets.length - 1;
		while (start <= end) {
			var mid = Math.floor((start + end) / 2);

			if ((Number(columnOffsets[mid]) - c.DELTA_OFFSET <= currentOffset) && (currentOffset <= Number(columnOffsets[mid]) + c.DELTA_OFFSET))
				return mid;

			else if (Number(columnOffsets[mid]) + c.DELTA_OFFSET < currentOffset)
				start = mid + 1;
			else
				end = mid - 1;
		}
		return -1;
	};

	/**
     * This function identifies columns from the masonry layout and stores in navigationMap object
     */
	c.initialiseKeyboardNav = function () {
		$scope.navigationMap = {};
		var allItems = $('.mega-menu').find('a');
		for (var index = 0; index < allItems.length; index++) {
			var element = allItems.get(index);
			if ($scope.navigationMap.hasOwnProperty(element.offsetLeft))
				$scope.navigationMap[element.offsetLeft].push(element);
			else
			{
				var _navKeys = Object.keys($scope.navigationMap);
				var _currentOffset = element.offsetLeft;
				var _closeColumn = columnSearch(_navKeys, _currentOffset);
				if (_closeColumn !== -1) {
					$scope.navigationMap[String(_navKeys[_closeColumn])].push(element);
				}
				else {
					$scope.navigationMap[_currentOffset] = [element];
				}
			}
		}

		$scope.navigationMap["browse-button"] = [$('.mega-menu').find('.browse-button').get(0)];
	};

	$rootScope.$on(c.SHOW_MOBILE_MEGA_MENU, function (event, showMobileMegaMenu) {
		$scope.showMobileMegaMenu = showMobileMegaMenu;
	});

	// 'ngRepeatFinished' is emitted from onFinishRepeat Angular Provider Directive
	$scope.$on('ngRepeatFinished', function () {
		/* On page load, when sub navbar is populated with taxonomy root topics & portal main menu items this method determines
         whether to use desktop/mobile view for portal navigation by checking if sub navbar contents exceed viewport width. */
		c.evaulateNavigationType();
	});

	$scope.$watch(
		function () {
			return $(".navigation-menu-item-calc").css("line-height");
		},
		function (newVal, oldVal) {
			if (newVal !== oldVal) {
				c.evaulateNavigationType();
				if (!$scope.showMobileMenuOnDesktop && $scope.showMegaMenu) {
					c.preMasonryWorkForMegaMenuRefreshWithNewItems();
					c.initializeMasonry();
				}
			}
		});

	$scope.$watch('showMegaMenu', function (newValue, oldValue) {
		if (!oldValue && newValue) {
			c.initializeMasonry();
		}
	});

	$scope.$watch('selectedMenuItem', function (newSelectedMenuItem, oldSelectedMenuItem) {
		/* When selected main menu item is changed to show mega menu for another root topic,
        execute masonry logic again for refreshing mega menu UI with new menu items */
		if ($scope.showMegaMenu && newSelectedMenuItem && oldSelectedMenuItem) {
			if (newSelectedMenuItem.sys_id !== oldSelectedMenuItem.sys_id) {
				c.preMasonryWorkForMegaMenuRefreshWithNewItems();
				c.initializeMasonry();
			}
		}
	});

	// Check if mobile view on desktop is needed every 0.25 secs (check link function) browser window is resized.
	$scope.$watch("isWindowResized", function (newValue, oldValue) {
		if (newValue) {
			c.evaulateNavigationType();
			$scope.isWindowResized = false;
			if ($scope.showMegaMenu) {
				c.preMasonryWorkForResponsiveViews();
				c.initializeMasonry();
			}
		}
	});

	// Cleaning up previous grid data for refreshing Mega menu UI when switching from one root topic Mega menu to another root topic Mega menu
	c.preMasonryWorkForMegaMenuRefreshWithNewItems = function () {
		// Resetting Grid variables in controller scope to their initial values.
		c.gridItemWidth = 0;
		c.usedOrphansColumnForGridItemWidth = false;
		c.allGridItemsHaveTwoColumns = false;
		c.allGridItemsHaveSingleColumn = true;

		// Revert the styles applied to grid items for previous selected main menu item
		var gridItems = $(".level-one-item");
		gridItems.each(function (currentIndex, gridItemDOMElement) {
			$(gridItemDOMElement).css({
				"grid-row-end": "auto",
				"grid-column-end": "auto",
				"margin-top": "0px",
				"height": "fit-content"
			});
		});
		$(".quick-links-container").css("min-height", c.isIE ? "0px" : "min-content");
		$(".quick-links-container").css("height", "");
	};

	c.preMasonryWorkForResponsiveViews = function () {
		/* Revert the styles applied to grid items to fill vertical gaps in the previous view.
        We need not revert grid-row-end, grid-column-end values here as actual menu items are not
        changing here like they were changing while switching from one Mega menu view to other. */
		var gridItems = $(".level-one-item");
		gridItems.each(function (currentIndex, gridItemDOMElement) {
			$(gridItemDOMElement).css({
				"margin-top": "0px",
				"height": "fit-content"
			});
		});
		$(".quick-links-container").css("min-height", "min-content");
	};
	$rootScope.$on('isHeaderInMobileView', function($evt, isHeaderInMobileView) {
		//re-evalutate navigation type if header mobile type is changed
		c.evaulateNavigationType();
	});

	// Enables mobile view on desktop if main menu items are overflowing viewport width
	c.evaulateNavigationType = function () {
		var mainMenuDOMElements = $(".main-menu-width-calc");
		// Getting last element if there are multiple as 'ngRepeatFinished' is emitted before rendering last element.
		var mainMenuDOMElement = mainMenuDOMElements[mainMenuDOMElements.length - 1];
		if (mainMenuDOMElement && (mainMenuDOMElement.offsetWidth < mainMenuDOMElement.scrollWidth)) {
			$scope.showMobileMenuOnDesktop = !$scope.isMobileView;
			$rootScope.$broadcast(c.SHOW_MOBILE_MENU_ON_DESKTOP, !$scope.isMobileView);
			if ($scope.showMobileMenuOnDesktop) {
				c.closeMegaMenu();
			}
		} else {
			$scope.showMobileMenuOnDesktop = $scope.isMobileView || $rootScope.isHeaderInMobileView;
			$rootScope.$broadcast(c.SHOW_MOBILE_MENU_ON_DESKTOP, $scope.isMobileView || $rootScope.isHeaderInMobileView);
		}
		if ($scope.showMobileMenuOnDesktop) {
			if ($('.toggle-dropdown').get(0)) {
				$('.toggle-dropdown').get(0).tabIndex = -1;
			}
			if ($('.impersonate-and-logout .header-menu-item a').get(1)) {
				$('.impersonate-and-logout .header-menu-item a').get(1).tabIndex = 0;
			}
			if ($('.impersonate-and-logout .header-menu-item a').get(2)) {
				$('.impersonate-and-logout .header-menu-item a').get(2).tabIndex = 0;
			}
		}
	};

	c.initializeMasonry = function () {
		// Do not use grid layout for IE. Using `flex` with display: -ms-flexbox; in CSS
		if (c.isIE) {
			$timeout(function () {
				$('.mega-menu').addClass('ie');
				$('.level-one-item').each(function (index, domElement) {
					$(domElement).addClass('ie');
					if (c.getSubTopicGroupCountInGridItem(domElement) === 2) {
						$(domElement).addClass('ie-two-column');
					}
				});
				$('.simple-list li').addClass('ie');
				$('.level-one-topic-name').parent().addClass('ie');
				$('.quick-link-title').addClass('ie');
				$('.sub-topics-container').addClass('ie');
				$('.sub-topics-list').addClass('ie');
			}).then(function(){
				c.adjustQuickLinksPanelHeight();
				c.initialiseKeyboardNav();
				topicTooltip();
			});
			return;
		}
		c.textZoomFactor = parseInt($('body').css('font-size')) / c.DEFAULT_FONT_SIZE;

		// Setting scroll position to top before applying masonry logic for proper layout of grid items
		if ($(".mega-menu__items").scrollTop() !== 0) {
			$(".mega-menu__items").scrollTop(0);
		}

		/* Masonry logic is applied in 3 stages.
        1. Allow grid items to span grid rows & columns based on their heights & no.of subtopic groups respectively.
        2. Set mega menu width based on its contents.
        3. Fill any gaps formed in the grid due to the 2-column grid items */
		c.expandMegaMenuToFullWidth().then(function () {
			c.resizeAllGridItems();
			c.adjustMegaMenuWidth();
			c.fillVerticalGapsInTheGrid().then(function () {
				c.adjustQuickLinksPanelHeight();
				c.initialiseKeyboardNav();
			});
		});
	};

	// Returns a Promise ensuring that all grid items are laid out in Mega menu occupying 100% viewport width.
	c.expandMegaMenuToFullWidth = function () {
		return new Promise(function (resolve, reject) {
			// Allow mega menu to consume viewport width for CSS Grid to layout items before applying masonry logic.
			$(".mega-menu").css("width", "100%");
			resolve();
		});
	};

	c.resizeAllGridItems = function () {
		var grid = $(".sub-topics-container").get(0);
		var rowHeight = parseInt($window.getComputedStyle(grid).getPropertyValue('grid-auto-rows'));

		var gridItems = $(".level-one-item");
		c.gridItemWidth = c.getGridItemWidth(gridItems);

		gridItems.each(function (currentIndex, gridItemDOMElement) {
			c.resizeGridItem(gridItemDOMElement, rowHeight);
		});
	};

	/* Grid item width is computed based on 3 scenarios.
    1. There is a single column grid item. In this case, we use this grid items width to normalize other items widths.
    2. All grid items have 2 columns. In this case, we take half of the 1st grid item content width and use it to normalize other items widths.
    3. Grid has only 2-column and orphan-list items. In this case, we use the orphan list grid item as base to set other grid items widths. */
	c.getGridItemWidth = function (gridItems) {
		var gridItemCount = gridItems.length;
		for (var index = 0; index < gridItemCount; index++) {
			var gridItemDOMElement = gridItems[index];
			if (c.getSubTopicGroupCountInGridItem(gridItemDOMElement) === 1) {
				return gridItemDOMElement.getBoundingClientRect().width;
			}
			if (index === gridItemCount - 1) {
				var orphanListGridItems = $(gridItemDOMElement).children(".orphan-list");
				if (orphanListGridItems.length) {
					c.usedOrphansColumnForGridItemWidth = true;
					return orphanListGridItems[0].getBoundingClientRect().width;
				}
				c.allGridItemsHaveTwoColumns = true;
				return $(gridItemDOMElement).find(".sub-topic-groups")[0].getBoundingClientRect().width / 2;
			}
		}
	};

	// This method sets the rowSpan & columnSpan values for grid item based on its height & no.of subtopic groups under it respectively.
	c.resizeGridItem = function (gridItemDOMElement, rowHeight) {
		var correctedScrollHeight = gridItemDOMElement.scrollHeight / c.textZoomFactor;
		var rowSpan = Math.ceil((correctedScrollHeight + c.GRID_ROW_GAP) / (rowHeight + c.GRID_ROW_GAP));
		gridItemDOMElement.style.gridRowEnd = "span " + rowSpan;

		var subTopicGroupsDOMElement = $(gridItemDOMElement).children(".sub-topic-groups").get(0);
		var levelTwoItemColumnDOMElements = $(subTopicGroupsDOMElement).children("ul").get();
		if (levelTwoItemColumnDOMElements.length > 1) {
			c.allGridItemsHaveSingleColumn = false;
			gridItemDOMElement.style.gridColumnEnd = "span " + levelTwoItemColumnDOMElements.length;

			$(levelTwoItemColumnDOMElements).each(function (currentIndex, levelTwoItemColumnDOMElement) {
				$(levelTwoItemColumnDOMElement).css("width", c.gridItemWidth - c.GRID_ITEM_PADDING_RIGHT + "px");
				if (currentIndex != levelTwoItemColumnDOMElements.length - 1 || c.allGridItemsHaveTwoColumns) {
					$(levelTwoItemColumnDOMElement).css({
						"flex-grow": "1",
						"padding-right": c.GRID_ITEM_PADDING_RIGHT + "px"
					});
				}
			});
		}
	};

	c.adjustMegaMenuWidth = function () {
		var gridItems = $(".level-one-item");
		var gridElementTopValue = gridItems[0].getBoundingClientRect().top;
		c.QUICK_LINKS_CONTAINER_WIDTH = $(".quick-links-container").innerWidth();

		// Computing no.of columns based on initial grid items layout.
		var gridColumnCount = c.getGridColumnCount(gridItems, gridElementTopValue);

		// Get computed grid (sub-topics-container) width.
		var subTopicsContainerWidth = c.getGridContainerWidth(gridItems, gridColumnCount);
		var megaMenuWidth = c.MEGA_MENU_ITEMS_PADDING + subTopicsContainerWidth + c.QUICK_LINKS_CONTAINER_WIDTH;

		// Checking if there is room for fitting another topic on the right side and adjusting width of mega menu.
		var canFitAnotherTopicOnTheRight = c.canFitAnotherTopicOnTheRight(megaMenuWidth, gridItems, gridColumnCount);
		megaMenuWidth = megaMenuWidth > c.MEGA_MENU_MAX_WIDTH ? c.MEGA_MENU_MAX_WIDTH : megaMenuWidth;
		megaMenuWidth = canFitAnotherTopicOnTheRight && ($window.innerWidth < c.MEGA_MENU_MAX_WIDTH) ? $window.innerWidth : megaMenuWidth;

		// If mega menu doesnt fit on the right side, fix the right coordinate and expand toward left
		if($scope.megaMenuLeftOffset + megaMenuWidth > $window.innerWidth){
			$('.mega-menu').css({'right': 0,'left':''});
		}

		$('.mega-menu').css('width', megaMenuWidth == $window.innerWidth ? '100%' : megaMenuWidth);
		if (!canFitAnotherTopicOnTheRight && c.hasSecondRowStarted(gridItems, gridElementTopValue)) {
			$(".mega-menu").css("width", megaMenuWidth + c.MEGA_MENU_ITEMS_PADDING * c.textZoomFactor > c.MEGA_MENU_MAX_WIDTH ? c.MEGA_MENU_MAX_WIDTH : megaMenuWidth + c.MEGA_MENU_ITEMS_PADDING * c.textZoomFactor);   
		}
	};

	c.adjustQuickLinksPanelHeight = function () {
		var quicklinksContainer = $(".quick-links-container");
		if (quicklinksContainer.length) {
			var containerBottom = quicklinksContainer[0].getBoundingClientRect().bottom;
			var quickLinksLastBottom = $(".quick-links-container > .simple-list > li:last-child")[0].getBoundingClientRect().bottom;
			if (containerBottom <= quickLinksLastBottom) {
				quicklinksContainer.css("height", "min-content");
			}
			var gridElements = $('.sub-topics-container');
			if (gridElements.length) {
				var gridDOMElement = gridElements.get(0);
				var quickLinksPanelHeight = parseInt(gridDOMElement.offsetHeight);
				var usedGridScrollHeight = false;
				if (gridDOMElement.offsetHeight < gridDOMElement.scrollHeight) {
					usedGridScrollHeight = true;
					quickLinksPanelHeight = parseInt(gridDOMElement.scrollHeight);
				}
				$(".quick-links-container").css("min-height", quickLinksPanelHeight + (usedGridScrollHeight ? c.MEGA_MENU_ITEMS_PADDING : 0) + "px");
			}
		}
	};

	// Returns no.of columns based on initial (not final) grid items layout. Final column count may change after filling vertical gaps.
	c.getGridColumnCount = function (gridItems, gridElementTopValue) {
		var gridColumnCount = 0;
		for (var index = 0; index < gridItems.length; index++) {
			var gridItemDOMElement = gridItems[index];
			if (gridItemDOMElement.getBoundingClientRect().top !== gridElementTopValue) {
				break;
			}
			gridColumnCount += (c.getSubTopicGroupCountInGridItem(gridItemDOMElement) + $(gridItemDOMElement).children(".orphan-list").length);
		}
		return gridColumnCount;
	};

	// Grid (sub-topics-container) width is computed based on how c.gridItemWidth value is computed (Check c.getGridItemWidth method documentation).
	c.getGridContainerWidth = function (gridItems, gridColumnCount) {
		var subTopicsContainerWidth = c.allGridItemsHaveTwoColumns ? (gridItems[0].getBoundingClientRect().width * gridColumnCount / 2) : (gridColumnCount * c.gridItemWidth);
		if (c.usedOrphansColumnForGridItemWidth) {
			/* Orphan links column is used for computing grid item width only when all the grid items have 2-columns (i. e. level-2 sub topic count in each grid item > 10).
             So we are halving the grid item width. But in case of 1-level hierarchy also mega menu is displayed and orphan links column is used for grid item width computation, so we need not half grid item width. */
			subTopicsContainerWidth = Math.ceil(gridItems[0].getBoundingClientRect().width * gridColumnCount / (c.allGridItemsHaveTwoColumns ? 2 : 1));
		}
		return subTopicsContainerWidth;
	};

	// Checks if there is room for fitting another topic on the right side.
	c.canFitAnotherTopicOnTheRight = function (megaMenuWidth, gridItems, gridColumnCount) {
		var canFitAnotherTopicOnRight = (megaMenuWidth + c.gridItemWidth > $window.innerWidth) ||
			(megaMenuWidth + 2 * c.gridItemWidth > $window.innerWidth && gridColumnCount < gridItems.length && c.getSubTopicGroupCountInGridItem(gridItems[gridColumnCount]) === 1);
		if (c.allGridItemsHaveTwoColumns) {
			canFitAnotherTopicOnRight = (megaMenuWidth + gridItems[0].getBoundingClientRect().width > $window.innerWidth);
		}
		return canFitAnotherTopicOnRight;
	};

	c.hasSecondRowStarted = function (gridItems, gridElementTopValue) {
		for (var index = 0; index < gridItems.length; index++) {
			var gridItemDOMElement = gridItems[index];
			if (gridItemDOMElement.getBoundingClientRect().top !== gridElementTopValue) {
				return true;
			}
		}
		return false;
	};

	c.fillVerticalGapsInTheGrid = function () {
		return new Promise(function (resolve, reject) {
			// Vertical gaps show up due to presence of 2-column grid item in rows other than 1st row.
			if (c.allGridItemsHaveSingleColumn) {
				resolve();
			}
			var gridTop = $(".sub-topics-container").get(0).getBoundingClientRect().top;
			var gridItems = $(".level-one-item");
			for (var currentIndex = 0; currentIndex < gridItems.length; currentIndex++) {
				var currentGridItemDOMElement = gridItems[currentIndex];

				var currentGridItemTop = currentGridItemDOMElement.getBoundingClientRect().top,
					currentGridItemRight = currentGridItemDOMElement.getBoundingClientRect().right,
					currentGridItemLeft = currentGridItemDOMElement.getBoundingClientRect().left;

				// Gaps show up only for items not in 1st row & are single-column items
				if (currentGridItemTop !== gridTop && (c.getSubTopicGroupCountInGridItem(currentGridItemDOMElement) === 1 || $(currentGridItemDOMElement).children(".orphan-list").length)) {
					var maxBottomValue = -1;
					var currentItemLiesInTwoColumnItemRow = false,
						currentItemRowSpanValue;

					for (var index = 0; index < gridItems.length; index++) {
						var gridItemElement = gridItems[index];
						var subTopicGroupCountInGridItem = c.getSubTopicGroupCountInGridItem(gridItemElement);

						// Need not continue if we reached current item while filling gaps, continue to next grid item (outer loop).
						if (c.areSameGridItems(currentGridItemDOMElement, gridItemElement)) {
							break;
						}
						// Checking if current item is lying in same row as a 2-column item. We will use this later below to adjust current items height.
						if (subTopicGroupCountInGridItem === 2 && gridItemElement.getBoundingClientRect().top === currentGridItemTop) {
							currentItemLiesInTwoColumnItemRow = true;
							currentItemRowSpanValue = parseInt(currentGridItemDOMElement.style.gridRowEnd.substr(5));
						}
						// Collecting the grid item that sits right above current item to adjust the vertical gap formed between them.
						if (gridItemElement.getBoundingClientRect().left === currentGridItemLeft ||
							(gridItemElement.getBoundingClientRect().right === currentGridItemRight && subTopicGroupCountInGridItem === 2)) {
							maxBottomValue = Math.max(maxBottomValue, gridItemElement.getBoundingClientRect().bottom);
						}
					}

					/* If there is no item above current item (maxBottomValue = -1), it means it should sit in the 1st row. And if there is a maxBottomValue,
                and the gap between the maxBottomValueGridItem & current item > grid row gap (20px), then add margin top to current element to fill this gap. */
					if (maxBottomValue === -1 || (currentGridItemTop - maxBottomValue > c.GRID_ROW_GAP))
						c.fillVerticalGapForCurrentGridItem(gridItems, currentIndex, maxBottomValue, currentItemLiesInTwoColumnItemRow, currentItemRowSpanValue);
				}
			}
			resolve();
		});
	};

	c.areSameGridItems = function (gridItem1, gridItem2) {
		var gridItemTop = gridItem2.getBoundingClientRect().top;
		var gridItemRight = gridItem2.getBoundingClientRect().right;
		var gridItemBottom = gridItem2.getBoundingClientRect().bottom;
		var gridItemLeft = gridItem2.getBoundingClientRect().left;

		return gridItem1.getBoundingClientRect().top === gridItemTop &&
			gridItem1.getBoundingClientRect().right === gridItemRight &&
			gridItem1.getBoundingClientRect().bottom === gridItemBottom &&
			gridItem1.getBoundingClientRect().left === gridItemLeft;
	};

	c.fillVerticalGapForCurrentGridItem = function (gridItems, currentIndex, maxBottomValue, currentItemLiesInTwoColumnItemRow, currentItemRowSpanValue) {
		var gridTop = $(".sub-topics-container").get(0).getBoundingClientRect().top;
		var currentGridItemDOMElement = gridItems[currentIndex];
		var currentGridItemTop = currentGridItemDOMElement.getBoundingClientRect().top;

		var marginTop = (maxBottomValue === -1) ? (currentGridItemTop - gridTop) : (currentGridItemTop - maxBottomValue - c.GRID_ROW_GAP);
		$(currentGridItemDOMElement).css({
			"margin-top": -1 * marginTop + "px"
		});
		/* If current item is lying in same row as a 2-column item, we need to adjust its height
           to prevent it from occupying extra space below after applying margin-top on it. */
		if (currentItemLiesInTwoColumnItemRow || currentIndex === gridItems.length - 1) {
			var rowSpanValue = (currentItemRowSpanValue - marginTop / c.GRID_ROW_GAP);
			currentGridItemDOMElement.style.gridRowEnd = "span " + (rowSpanValue > 0 ? rowSpanValue : 1);
			if (rowSpanValue < 0) {
				$(currentGridItemDOMElement).css({
					"height": "fit-content"
				});
			}
		}
	};

	$scope.handleMobileMainMenuItemClick = function (menuItem) {
		if (c.doesMenuItemHaveChildren(menuItem)) {
			if (!$scope.showMobileMegaMenu)
				$scope.showMobileMegaMenu = true;

			$scope.selectedMobileMenuItem = menuItem;
			$scope.isLevelOneMobileMegaMenu = true;
			$rootScope.$broadcast(c.SHOW_MOBILE_MEGA_MENU, true);
			return;
		} else {
			if (c.data.topic_id == menuItem.sys_id) {
				$rootScope.$broadcast('closeSideNav');
				return;
			}
		} 
		
		
		c.redirectToMenuItemPage(menuItem);
		$rootScope.$broadcast(c.TOGGLE_MOBILE_MENU_VISIBILITY);
	};

	$scope.setToClose = function() {
		$rootScope.$broadcast('toggleSidebar');
	};

	// 2 cases here, user either clicks level-one item or level-two item
	$scope.handleMobileMegaMenuItemClick = function (menuItem) {
		/* Case-1: If level-one item has children, we are showing level-two children under it.
         Otheriwse simply redirect user to level-one topic page. */
		//HERE
		if (c.doesMenuItemHaveChildren(menuItem)) {
			handleTransition();
			$scope.levelOneSelectedMobileMenuItem = $scope.selectedMobileMenuItem;
			$scope.selectedMobileMenuItem = menuItem;
			$scope.isLevelOneMobileMegaMenu = false;
			return;
		} else {
			if (c.data.topic_id == menuItem.sys_id) {
				$rootScope.$broadcast('closeSideNav');
				return;
			}
		} 
		// Case-2: level-two topics have no children in mega menu. So simply redirect user to clicked topic page.
		c.redirectToMenuItemPage(menuItem);
		$rootScope.$broadcast(c.TOGGLE_MOBILE_MENU_VISIBILITY);
	};

	function handleTransition() {
		var elem = '.mobile-mega-menu__item';
		$(elem).css('transition', 'unset');
		$timeout(function() {
			$(elem).css('transition', '0.25s ease-in-out');
		}, 250);
	}

	/* If back button is clicked on level-1 of mega menu, go back to main menu.
    Otherwise, change selected topic to parent of level-2 topics to refresh the view */
	$scope.goBackOnMobileView = function () {

		handleTransition();
		if ($scope.isLevelOneMobileMegaMenu) {
			$scope.lastSelectedElementId = $scope.selectedMobileMenuItem.sys_id;
			$scope.showMobileMegaMenu = false;
			$rootScope.$broadcast(c.SHOW_MOBILE_MEGA_MENU, false);
			return;
		}
		$(".back-container").blur();
		$scope.lastSelectedElementId = $scope.selectedMobileMenuItem.sys_id;
		//$scope.selectedMobileMenuItem = $scope.levelOneSelectedMobileMenuItem;
		$scope.selectedMobileMenuItem = c.data.topics[$scope.selectedMobileMenuItem.parent_topic];
		//$scope.levelOneSelectedMobileMenuItem = undefined;
		//$scope.isLevelOneMobileMegaMenu = true;
		if (!$scope.selectedMobileMenuItem.parent_topic || $scope.selectedMobileMenuItem.parent_topic == '') {
			$scope.levelOneSelectedMobileMenuItem = undefined;
			$scope.isLevelOneMobileMegaMenu = true;
		}
	};

	// Handle click on Main menu anywhere other than a navigation menu item.
	$scope.handleClickOnMainMenu = function ($event) {
		if ($event.target.className.indexOf("navigation-menu-item") < 0) {
			c.closeMegaMenu();
		}
	};

	/* There are 4 cases to handle when a main menu navigation item is clicked
       1. If simple/mega menu is already open, then close it.
       2. If there is no menu attached to this menu item, then redirect user to corresponding portal page.
       3. Whether to show simple/mega menu based on hierarchy level of root topic i.e  If there is only 1 level, show simple menu. otherwise show mega menu.
       4. Show mega menu when there are 2 levels of topic hierarchy.
    */
	$scope.handleMainMenuItemClick = function (menuItem, $event) {
		$event.stopPropagation();
		$scope.keyboardNavRowIndex = 0;
		$scope.keyboardNavColIndex = 0;
		// Case 1
		if ($scope.selectedMenuItem && $scope.selectedMenuItem.sys_id === menuItem.sys_id) {
			c.closeMegaMenu();
			return;
		}
		$scope.selectedMenuItem = menuItem;

		// Case 2
		if (!c.doesMenuItemHaveChildren(menuItem)) {
			c.closeMegaMenu();
			c.redirectToMenuItemPage(menuItem);
			return;
		}
		// Case 3
		if (c.isSingleLevelTopicHierarchy(menuItem)) {
			var computedLeftCoordinate = $event.currentTarget.offsetLeft;
			computedLeftCoordinate = (computedLeftCoordinate + c.SIMPLE_MENU_WIDTH <= $window.innerWidth) ? computedLeftCoordinate : ($window.innerWidth - c.SIMPLE_MENU_WIDTH);
			$scope.simpleMenuPosition = {
				'left': computedLeftCoordinate > 0 ? computedLeftCoordinate : 0 + 'px'
			};
			$scope.megaMenuLeftOffset = computedLeftCoordinate;
			$scope.megaMenuPosition = {
				'left': computedLeftCoordinate > 0 ? computedLeftCoordinate : 0 + 'px'
			};
			$scope.showMegaMenu = (c.data.menuItemToQuickLinks[$scope.selectedMenuItem.sys_id] && c.data.menuItemToQuickLinks[$scope.selectedMenuItem.sys_id].length > 0) ? true : false;
			return;
		}
		// Case 4
		var computedLeftCoordinate = $event.currentTarget.offsetLeft;
		computedLeftCoordinate = (computedLeftCoordinate + c.SIMPLE_MENU_WIDTH <= $window.innerWidth) ? computedLeftCoordinate : ($window.innerWidth - c.SIMPLE_MENU_WIDTH);
		$scope.megaMenuLeftOffset = computedLeftCoordinate;
		$scope.megaMenuPosition = {
			'left': computedLeftCoordinate > 0 ? computedLeftCoordinate : 0 + 'px'
		};
		$scope.showMegaMenu = true;
		$scope.selectedMenuItemRightCoordinate = $event.currentTarget.getBoundingClientRect().right;
	};

	$scope.handleMegaMenuItemClick = function ($event, megaMenuItem) {
		$($event.target).parent().tooltip('hide');
		c.closeMegaMenu();
		c.redirectToMenuItemPage(megaMenuItem);
	};

	$scope.handleQuickLinkClick = function ($event, quickLink) {
		//console.log(quickLink)
		c.closeMegaMenu();
		if (quickLink.target == '_blank') {
			$window.open(quickLink.link, '_blank');
		} else {
			$location.url(quickLink.link);
		}
	};

	$scope.browseAll = function (selectedTopic) {
		c.redirectToMenuItemPage(selectedTopic);
		if ($scope.showMegaMenu)
			$scope.showMegaMenu = false;

		if ($scope.showMobileMenuOnDesktop) {
			$rootScope.$broadcast(c.TOGGLE_MOBILE_MENU_VISIBILITY);
		}
	};

	// Returns all sub topics (under selected root topic) with no children
	$scope.getLevelOneTopicsWithNoChildren = function (selectedRootTopicId) {
		var levelOneSubTopics = c.data.menuItemToChildrenMap[selectedRootTopicId];
		$scope.levelOneTopicsWithNoChildren = levelOneSubTopics.filter(function (levelOneSubTopic) {
			return !c.doesMenuItemHaveChildren(levelOneSubTopic);
		});
		return $scope.levelOneTopicsWithNoChildren;
	};

	$scope.getLevelTwoTopicsAsGroupsOfTen = function (levelTwoSubTopics) {
		var COLUMN_SPLIT_BREAKPOINT_TOPIC_COUNT = 10,
			MAX_TOPIC_COUNT_UNDER_SUBTOPIC_GROUP = 20;
		var groupsOfLevelTwoTopics = [],
			subTopics = angular.copy(levelTwoSubTopics);
		subTopics = subTopics.splice(0, MAX_TOPIC_COUNT_UNDER_SUBTOPIC_GROUP);

		if (subTopics.length <= COLUMN_SPLIT_BREAKPOINT_TOPIC_COUNT) {
			while (subTopics.length) {
				groupsOfLevelTwoTopics.push(subTopics.splice(0, COLUMN_SPLIT_BREAKPOINT_TOPIC_COUNT));
			}
		} else {
			var columnCount = Math.ceil(subTopics.length / COLUMN_SPLIT_BREAKPOINT_TOPIC_COUNT);
			var topicCountPerColumn = Math.ceil(subTopics.length / columnCount);
			var lastColumnTopicCount = subTopics.length % topicCountPerColumn;
			if (lastColumnTopicCount !== 0) {
				while (topicCountPerColumn + lastColumnTopicCount <= COLUMN_SPLIT_BREAKPOINT_TOPIC_COUNT) {
					topicCountPerColumn++;
					lastColumnTopicCount = subTopics.length % topicCountPerColumn;
				}
			}
			while (subTopics.length) {
				groupsOfLevelTwoTopics.push(subTopics.splice(0, topicCountPerColumn));
			}
		}
		return groupsOfLevelTwoTopics;
	};

	c.isSingleLevelTopicHierarchy = function (rootTopic) {

	c.closeMegaMenu = function () {

		$scope.selectedMenuItem = undefined;

		// Checking if menu item belongs to a taxonomy. If so, then redirect to topic page else, redirect to href.
		var pageToRedirect = menuItem.template && menuItem.template.length > 0 ? menuItem.template : 'emp_taxonomy_topic';
		var searchString = menuItem.taxonomy ? "id="+  pageToRedirect + "&topic_id=" + menuItem.sys_id : menuItem.href.substring(1);

			var url_target = menuItem.url_target || '_self';

	}

	function checkEllipsis(topic) {

	function topicTooltip() {

			'.mega-menu-item span:not(.icon)',
			'.browse-button span',

			'.mobile-mega-menu__quick-link a',
			'.quick-links-container a',
			'.level-one-topic-name',
			'.level-two-topic-name'
		].join()
					  );
		topics.each(function (_index, topic) {
			if (checkEllipsis(topic)) {
				$(topic).tooltip('enable');
			}
		});

		name: $scope.user.name,

//     });

    // Hide tooltip when focus is lost. This is done explicitly as we are using trigger: 'manual' in tooltip options.
//     $(document).on('mouseleave blur', getCommaSeparatedListOfSelectors(), function () {
//         var $this = $(this);
//         var currentThis = this;
//         // Blur event is not fired on span elements. So using currentThis to check for
//         // ellipsis condition when a quick link is focused during keyboard navigation.
//         if ($this.find('.quick-link-title').length > 0) {
//             currentThis = $this.find('.quick-link-title')[0];
//         }
//         $(currentThis).tooltip('hide');
//     });

    /* Check for ellipsis on parent of the focused mega menu link and add a right border to it.
    This is needed as right border is not visible due to overflow: hidden on parent element */
    $(document).on('focus', '.level-one-topic-name, .level-two-topic-name', function () {
        var parent = $(this).parent().get(0);
        if (parent.offsetWidth < parent.scrollWidth || parent.offsetHeight < parent.scrollHeight) {
            $(this).parent().addClass('focused-link-parent');

            if ($(this).hasClass('level-two-topic-name') || $(this).closest('.orphan-list').length > 0) {
                $(this).parent().addClass('link-with-margin');
            }
        }
    });

    // Remove right border, margin (`link-with-margin` class) on elements that have one due to `focused-link-parent` class.
    $(document).on('blur', '.level-one-topic-name, .level-two-topic-name', function () {
        $('.focused-link-parent').removeClass('focused-link-parent');
        $('.link-with-margin').removeClass('link-with-margin');
    });

    var rateLimitedCallback = debounce(function () {
        scope.$apply(function () {
            // update current scope based on the new innerWidth and let angular update the view.
            scope.isWindowResized = true;
            scope.isMobileView = controller.data.isMobile || (window.innerWidth <= controller.MOBILE_DEVICE_SCREEN_WIDTH);
            if (scope.isMobileView) {
                controller.closeMegaMenu();
            }
        });
    }, 250);

    $(window).resize(rateLimitedCallback);

    // This helper returns a function, that, as long as it continues to be invoked, will not
    // be triggered. The function will be called after it stops being called for
    // N milliseconds. If `immediate` is passed, trigger the function on the
    // leading edge, instead of the trailing.
    function debounce(func, wait, immediate) {
        var timeout;
        return function () {
            var context = this,
                args = arguments;
            var later = function () {
                timeout = null;
                if (!immediate) func.apply(context, args);
            };
            var callNow = immediate && !timeout;
            clearTimeout(timeout);
            timeout = setTimeout(later, wait);
            if (callNow) func.apply(context, args);
        };
    }

    // This helper function is used to control the keyboard arrow key navigation throughout the mega menu
    // KeyCode mappings - https://www.cambiaresearch.com/articles/15/javascript-char-codes-key-codes
    function arrowNavigation(e) {
        var target = e.target;
        var querySelector;
        if ($(target).hasClass('mega-menu-item'))
            querySelector = target.localName + '.mega-menu-item';
        else if ($(target).hasClass('dropdown-menu-item'))
            querySelector = target.localName + '.dropdown-menu-item';
        if (target.localName === 'li') {
            var currentMenuItem = $(target);
            var parentUL = currentMenuItem.parents('ul');
            var items, index;

            if (e.keyCode === 38 || e.keyCode === 40) {
                e.preventDefault();
                if (parentUL.length) {
                    items = $(parentUL).find(querySelector);
                    if (!items.length)
                        return;

                    index = items.index(items.filter(':focus'));
                    if (index === -1) return;

                    //for continued navigation in ECHeader mobile view
                    if (index === items.length - 1) {
                        if (e.keyCode == 38) {
                            index = (index - 1);
                            items[index].focus();
                        }
                        else if (e.keyCode === 40) {
                            if($('li.main-header-item>a').length !== 0)
                                $('li.main-header-item>a').get(0).focus();
                        }
                    } //for navigation within Megamenu mobile (ECNavigation)
                    else {
                        if (e.keyCode === 38) {
                            index = index > 0 ? index - 1 : 0;
                        }
                        else if (e.keyCode === 40){
                            index = (index + 1);
                        }
                            items[index].focus();
                    }
                }
            } else if (querySelector === 'li.dropdown-menu-item' && (e.keyCode === 37 || e.keyCode === 39)) {
                var currElem = $('div.selected-item');
                closeMenu(e, true, true);
                parentUL = $(currElem).parents('div.main-menu');
                if (parentUL.length) {
                    items = $(parentUL).find('div.navigation-menu-item');
                    if (!items.length)
                        return;

                    index = items.index(items.filter(':focus'));
                    if (index === -1) return;

                    if (e.keyCode == 37)
                        index = (index + items.length - 1) % items.length;
                    else
                        index = (index + 1) % items.length;
                    items[index].focus();
                }
            } else if ((e.keyCode === 9 || e.keyCode === 27) && querySelector === 'li.dropdown-menu-item')
                closeMenu(e, true, true);
            else if (querySelector === 'li.mega-menu-item' && (e.keyCode === 32 || e.keyCode === 13)) {
                if ($(target).hasClass('mobile-mega-menu__quick-link')) {
                    $(target).find('a')[0].click();
                    return;
                }
                e.preventDefault();
                $(target).click();
                if (!$(target).hasClass('menu-link')) {
                    if (!$(target).hasClass('back-container'))
                        $('.back-container').first().focus();
                    else
                        $("li.mobile-menu-item-" + scope.lastSelectedElementId + ":first").focus();
                }
            }
        }
    }

    $(element).on('keydown', '.mega-menu-item, .dropdown-menu-item', arrowNavigation);

    $(element).on('keydown', '.navigation-menu-item', function (e) {
        var target = e.target;
        if (target.localName === 'div') {
            var currentMenuItem = $(target);
            var parentMenu = $(target).parents('div.main-menu');
            var items = parentMenu.children('div.navigation-menu-item');
            var index;

            if (e.keyCode === 37 || e.keyCode === 39) {
                closeMenu(e, true, false);

                if (parentMenu.length) {
                    if (!items.length)
                        return;

                    index = items.index(items.filter(':focus'));
                    if (index === -1) return;

                    if (e.keyCode == 37)
                        index = (index + items.length - 1) % items.length;
                    else
                        index = (index + 1) % items.length;
                    items[index].focus();
                }
            } else if ((e.keyCode === 38 || e.keyCode === 9 || e.keyCode === 27) && scope.selectedMenuItem) {
                closeMenu(e, false, false);
            } else if (e.keyCode === 40 || e.keyCode === 13 || e.keyCode === 32) {
                e.preventDefault();
                if (!scope.selectedMenuItem && (!currentMenuItem.hasClass('menu-link') || (currentMenuItem.hasClass('menu-link') && (e.keyCode !== 40))))
                    target.click();
                if (scope.selectedMenuItem) {
                    var dropdownMenu = parentMenu.siblings('#menu_' + scope.selectedMenuItem.sys_id);
                    if (dropdownMenu.hasClass('simple-menu'))
                        dropdownMenu.find('ul.simple-list li:first').focus();
                    else if (dropdownMenu.hasClass('mega-menu'))
                        dropdownMenu.find('a.level-one-topic-name:first').focus();
                }
            }

        }
    });

    // Closing the level 2 mega-menu when Shift+ Tab key pressed
    controller.shiftKeyPressed = false;
    $(element).on('keydown', '.level-one-first-item', function (e) {
        if (e.keyCode === 9 && controller.shiftKeyPressed)
            closeMenu(e, true, true);
    });

    // Closing the mega-menu when tab key is pressed on the Browse Button or escape key is pressed.
    $(element).on('keydown keyup', function (e) {
        if (e.keyCode === 16)
            controller.shiftKeyPressed = (e.type === 'keydown');
        else if (e.type === 'keydown') {
            if (e.keyCode === 9 && !controller.shiftKeyPressed && $(e.target).hasClass('browse-button'))
                closeMenu(e, true, true);
            else if (e.keyCode === 27 && $(e.target).is('.browse-button, .level-one-topic-name, .level-two-topic-name, .quick-links-container>ul>li>a'))
                closeMenu(e, true, true);
        }
    });

    // Helper function to close Mega menu and focus the parent topic if needed and prevent the default behaviour if needed
    function closeMenu(e, preventDefault, focusParentTopic) {
        if (preventDefault) e.preventDefault();
        if (focusParentTopic) $('div.selected-item').focus();
        scope.$apply(function () {
            controller.closeMegaMenu();
        });
    }
}]]></link><name>Chameleon Employee Center Navigation</name><option_schema/><public>false</public><roles/><script><![CDATA[(function () {
	data.topic_id = $sp.getParameter('topic_id');

	if (input && input.action == 'getTopicId') {
		return;
	}

	data.topics = {};
	var taxonomyId = $sp.getTaxonomies();
	var topicsData = {
		rootTopics: [],
		topicToSubTopicsMap: {},
		rootTopicToQuickLinkMap: {}
	};

	options.headingTemplate = options.headingTemplate ||'cham-sk-sidebar-heading-v2.html';

	if (taxonomyId) {
		var session = gs.getSession();
		var userID = gs.getUserID();
		var megaMenuTopics = [];
		var topicMenuItems = session.getClientData('taxonomy_topic_menu_items');
		var menuItems = JSON.parse(topicMenuItems);	
// 		var portalTaxonomy = new sn_taxonomy.Taxonomy(taxonomyId);
		var portalTaxonomy = new sn_hr_sp.ChamTaxonomyUtil();
		if (menuItems && taxonomyId === menuItems.taxonomyId && menuItems.userID === userID) {
			megaMenuTopics = menuItems.topicMenuItems;

 		} else {
			megaMenuTopics = portalTaxonomy.getTaxonomyTopics(taxonomyId, 10);//getTopics(false, 2, false);
// 			megaMenuTopics = portalTaxonomy.getTopics(true, 2, false);
			var stringifiedTopicMenuItems = JSON.stringify({
				userID: userID,
				topicMenuItems: megaMenuTopics,
				taxonomyId: taxonomyId
			});
			session.putClientData('taxonomy_topic_menu_items', stringifiedTopicMenuItems);
		}
		topicsData = parseTopics(megaMenuTopics);
 	}

	var spMainMenu = $sp.getWidgetFromInstance($sp.getValue('sp_rectangle_menu'));
	var nonTopicMenuItems = spMainMenu.data && spMainMenu.data.menu ? spMainMenu.data.menu.items : [];
	var configOptions = {};
	if(spMainMenu.options && spMainMenu.options.widget_parameters) {
		configOptions = JSON.parse(spMainMenu.options.widget_parameters);
	}
	var moreItemsSysId = (configOptions.enable_more_items && configOptions.enable_more_items.sysId) || '';

	// Removing My Items from the sub header menu items list and restricting label size to 60 characters
	nonTopicMenuItems = nonTopicMenuItems.filter(function (nonTopicMenuItem) {
		nonTopicMenuItem.label = nonTopicMenuItem.label.substr(0, 60);
		return nonTopicMenuItem.sys_id !== moreItemsSysId;
	});

	// Populate 'data' object
	data.isMobile = gs.isMobile();
	data.nonTopicMenuItems = nonTopicMenuItems;
	data.menuItemToChildrenMap = topicsData.topicToSubTopicsMap;
	data.menuItems = topicsData.rootTopics;
	data.menuItemToQuickLinks = topicsData.rootTopicToQuickLinkMap;
	data.portalSuffix = $sp.getPortalRecord().getDisplayValue("url_suffix");

	nonTopicMenuItems.forEach(function(nonTopicItem) {
		if (nonTopicItem.items && nonTopicItem.items.length)
			data.menuItemToChildrenMap[nonTopicItem.sys_id] = nonTopicItem.items;
	});

	/*
       Sample input (megaMenuTopics): Array of topics as below
       [
        {
        "sys_id": "5a0d9826eb003010ed7966d6475228e0",
        "parent_topic": "",
        "name": "root topic 1",
        "active": true,
        "taxonomy": "5c1dd826eb003010ed7966d647522873",
        "order": ""
        },
        {
        "sys_id": "03449953eb403010ed7966d64752288a",
        "parent_topic": "5a0d9826eb003010ed7966d6475228e0",
        "name": "sub topic 1.1",
        "active": true,
        "taxonomy": "5c1dd826eb003010ed7966d647522873",
        "order": ""
        }
       ]
      Sample output (topicsData) for above input:
      {
        rootTopics: [
         {
           "sys_id": "5a0d9826eb003010ed7966d6475228e0",
           "parent_topic": "",
           "name": "root topic 1",
           "active": true,
           "taxonomy": "5c1dd826eb003010ed7966d647522873",
           "order": ""
          }
        ],
        topicToSubTopicsMap: {
         "5a0d9826eb003010ed7966d6475228e0":
           [
             {
               "sys_id": "03449953eb403010ed7966d64752288a",
               "parent_topic": "5a0d9826eb003010ed7966d6475228e0",
               "name": "sub topic 1.1",
               "active": true,
               "taxonomy": "5c1dd826eb003010ed7966d647522873",
               "order": ""
             }
           ]
        }
      }
    */

	function parseTopics(megaMenuTopics) {
		megaMenuTopics.forEach(function (topic) {
			if (!topic.active)
				return;

			data.topics[topic.sys_id] = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(topic));

			if (!topic.parent_topic) {
				topicsData.rootTopics.push(topic);
				topic.icon = getIconForTopic(topic);
				var quickLinksList = portalTaxonomy.fetchQuicklinksForTopic(topic.sys_id);
// 				var quickLinksList = new sn_ex_sp.QuickLinkUtil().fetchQuicklinksForTopic(topic.sys_id);
				if(quickLinksList)
					topicsData.rootTopicToQuickLinkMap[topic.sys_id] = quickLinksList;
			}
			else {
				var isParentTopicAlreadyInMap = (topic.parent_topic in topicsData.topicToSubTopicsMap);
				topicsData.topicToSubTopicsMap[topic.parent_topic] = isParentTopicAlreadyInMap ? topicsData.topicToSubTopicsMap[topic.parent_topic].concat(topic) : [topic];
			}
		});
		return topicsData;
	}

	function getIconForTopic(topic) {
		var topicGr = new GlideRecord('topic');
		topicGr.get(topic.sys_id);
		return topicGr.getDisplayValue('icon');
	}
})();]]></script><servicenow>false</servicenow><sys_class_name>sp_widget</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>mc.admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-03-06 10:41:38</sys_created_on><sys_id>d01b843283c4e210c0fb56d6feaad351</sys_id><sys_mod_count>6</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Chameleon Employee Center Navigation</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Employee Center Core" source="sn_hr_sp">3d1da2705b021200a4656ede91f91ab6</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Employee Center Core">3d1da2705b021200a4656ede91f91ab6</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sp_widget_d01b843283c4e210c0fb56d6feaad351</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>mc.admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-03-06 13:55:34</sys_updated_on><template><![CDATA[<div class="employee-center-navigation" role="navigation">
  <div class="cham-sidebar-heading" ng-include="options.headingTemplate"> </div>  
  <div class="navigation--xs">
    <div class="flex-row justify-end menu-header">
      <img class="open-menu-btn no-padder" src="cham-open-side-nav.svg" width="34" height="24"/>

      <button class="back-menu-button gap-10"
              ng-click="goBackOnMobileView()"
              aria-label="${Back}"
              role="menuitem"
              tabindex="0"
              ng-if="showMobileMegaMenu">
        <img src="cham-left-arrow.svg" width="24" height="24"/>
      </button>

      <h2 class="h4 font-800 m-none">${Topics}</h2>

      <!--<button class="close-menu-button gap-10 menu__item__label"
              ng-click="c.closeSideNav()"
              aria-label="${Close}"
              role="menuitem"
              tabindex="0"
              >
        <img src="cham-close-icon.svg" width="24" height="24"/>
      </button>-->
    </div>

    <!-- topic-based mobile navigation menu -->
    <ul class="mobile-main-menu items-end gap-5" role="menu" ng-if="!showMobileMegaMenu">
      <li class="cham-divider-line" tabindex="-1"></li>
      <li ng-repeat="item in data.menuItems | orderBy: ['order','name'] track by item.sys_id"
          class="mobile-navigation-menu-item mega-menu-item {{'mobile-menu-item-' + item.sys_id}} gap-15"
          ng-click="handleMobileMainMenuItemClick(item)"
          aria-label="{{item.name ? item.name : item.label}}"
          ng-class="{'menu-link': !c.doesMenuItemHaveChildren(item)}"
          ng-attr-aria-expanded="{{ c.doesMenuItemHaveChildren(item) ? ((selectedMenuItem && item.sys_id === selectedMenuItem.sys_id) || false) : undefined}}"
          role="menuitem"
          tabindex="0">
        <img class="menu__item_img" ng-src="{{item.icon?item.icon:'5937e67beb9570104a299f671352282f.iix'}}" width="34" height="24"/>
        <div class="flex">
          <span class="menu__item__label text-md font-700">{{item.name ? item.name : item.label}}</span>
        </div>
        <!--<i class="fa fa-chevron-right menu__item_chevron" aria-hidden="true" ng-if="c.doesMenuItemHaveChildren(item)"></i>-->
        <img src="cham-right-chevron.svg" class="menu__item_chevron" ng-if="c.doesMenuItemHaveChildren(item)"/>
        <!-- <img class="menu__item_chevron" ng-src="double-chevron.png" width="15" height="10"/> -->
      </li>
    </ul>

    <ul class="mobile-main-menu items-end resources-list" role="menu" ng-if="!showMobileMegaMenu">
      <li class="cham-divider-line" tabindex="-1"></li>
      <li ng-repeat="item in ::data.nonTopicMenuItems | orderBy: ['order','label']"
          class="mobile-navigation-menu-item mega-menu-item gap-15" 
          ng-click="handleMobileMainMenuItemClick(item)"
          role="menuitem"
          tabindex="0" aria-label="{{item.name ? item.name : item.label}}">
        <img class="resources-list__header__heading-image" ng-src="{{item.u_image?item.u_image:'5937e67beb9570104a299f671352282f.iix'}}" width="34" height="24"/>
        <span class="menu__item__label text-md font-700">{{item.sys_name}}</span>
      </li>
    </ul>

    <ul class="list-unstyled mobile-main-menu__subtopic-list gap-5" ng-if="showMobileMegaMenu" role="menu">

      <li class="selected-topic-name" aria-hidden="true">
        {{selectedMobileMenuItem.name ? selectedMobileMenuItem.name : selectedMobileMenuItem.label}}
      </li>
      <li ng-repeat="item in data.menuItemToChildrenMap[selectedMobileMenuItem.sys_id] | orderBy: ['order','name'] track by item.sys_id"
          class="mobile-mega-menu__item mega-menu-item {{'mobile-menu-item-' + item.sys_id}}"
          ng-click="handleMobileMegaMenuItemClick(item)"
          aria-label="{{item.name ? item.name : item.label}}"
          role="menuitem"
          tabindex="0">
        <img class="menu__item_img" ng-src="{{item.icon?item.icon:'5937e67beb9570104a299f671352282f.iix'}}" width="34" height="24"/>
        <div class="flex">
        	<span class="menu__item__label">{{item.name ? item.name : item.label}}</span>
        </div>
        <!--<i class="fa fa-chevron-right menu__item_chevron" aria-hidden="true" ng-if="c.doesMenuItemHaveChildren(item)"></i>-->
        <img src="cham-right-chevron.svg" class="menu__item_chevron" ng-if="c.doesMenuItemHaveChildren(item)"/>
       <!-- <img  ng-src="double-chevron.png" width="15" height="10"/>-->
      </li>

      <li class="browse-all mega-menu-item m-t-lg padder-b-lg flex-row"
          role="menuitem">
        <div aria-label="{{ '${Browse }' + (c.isSingleLevelTopicHierarchy(selectedMobileMenuItem) ? '${all} ' : '') + selectedMobileMenuItem.name}}" tabindex="0" ng-click="browseAll(selectedMobileMenuItem)" class="btn btn-primary flex font-800">
          <span aria-hidden="true">
            ${Browse} {{selectedMobileMenuItem.name}}
          </span>
        </div>      
      </li>

      <!-- Quick Links section -->
      <li class="mobile-main-menu__subtopic-list__quicklinks">
        <ul class="list-unstyled">
          <li ng-if=" c.data.menuItemToQuickLinks[selectedMobileMenuItem.sys_id].length " class="mobile-mega-menu__quick-links-title" aria-hidden="true">${Quick Links}</li>
          <li class="mobile-mega-menu__quick-link mobile-mega-menu__item" role="menuitem" tabindex="0"
              ng-repeat="link in c.data.menuItemToQuickLinks[selectedMobileMenuItem.sys_id] | limitTo: 5">
            <a  ng-href="{{link.url}}"
               target ="{{link.target}}"
               aria-label="{{link.title}} - ${Quick Links}"
               tabindex="-1">
              <span class="menu__item__label" ng-attr-title="{{ c.isIE ? link.title : undefined }}">{{link.title}}</span>
              <span class="icon fa fa-external-link fa-align-bottom" title="${External link}"

                    ng-if="(link.target == '_blank')">
              </span>
            </a>
          </li>

        </ul>
      </li>
    </ul>
  </div>
</div>]]></template></sp_widget></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sp_angular_provider"><sp_angular_provider action="DELETE"><name>chamBookmark</name><script><![CDATA[function(userPreferences, spUtil, $rootScope, $http, $q) {
	var currentlyFetchingUserFavorites = false;
	var favoritesPrefName = 'cham.bookmarks';
	var localCache = {};
		
	function initFavorites(sys_id) {
		// If the prefs are in the cache get them from there.
		if (localCache.userFavorites) 
			return localCache.userFavorites;

        // Check if they're being fetched asynch already, if so the broadcast below will update the directives. 
        if (!currentlyFetchingUserFavorites) {
            currentlyFetchingUserFavorites = true;
            _fetchUserFavorites().then(function(favorites) {
                // When the prefs return broadcast to ALL directives, cache the prefs locally. 
                $rootScope.$broadcast('cham.userFavorites', favorites);
                localCache.userFavorites = favorites;
                currentlyFetchingUserFavorites = false;
            })
        }

        // Return false because the broadcast will update the directives. 
        return false;
		
	} 
	
	function _fetchUserFavorites() {	
		var def = $q.defer();
		var endpointURL = 'https://' + window.location.host + '/api/x_nero_rocketfuel/rocketfuel/getUserPreference';
		var postBody = {
			preferenceName: favoritesPrefName,
		};
			
		$http({
			method: 'POST',
			url: endpointURL,
			data: postBody,
			headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'}
		}).then(function (response) {
			def.resolve(response.data.result);
		}, function(error) {
			def.resolve(false);
		})
		
		return def.promise;
	}
	
	function toggleBookmark(sys_id, table, title, created_on, order){
		var newUserPrefObj = {"id": sys_id, "t": table, "n": title, "c": created_on, "o": order};
		var payload = {
			action: '',
			sys_id: sys_id
		};

		var endpointURL = 'https://' + window.location.host + '/api/x_nero_rocketfuel/rocketfuel/userPreference';
		var postBody = {
				preferenceName: favoritesPrefName,
				value: newUserPrefObj
		};
		
		$http({
			method: 'POST',
			url: endpointURL,
			data: postBody,
			headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'}
		}).then(function (response) {
			var updatedPrefs = response.data.result.updatedPrefs;
			payload.action = response.data.result.action;
			// 'updateBookmark' is deault listener passed to scripted list to refresh list of favorites. 
			$rootScope.$broadcast('updateBookmark', payload);
			$rootScope.$broadcast('cham.updatedBookmarks', updatedPrefs);
			localCache.userFavorites = updatedPrefs;
		}, function(error) {
			spUtil.addInfoMessage("User must be logged in to save favorites.");
		})
	}

	function getUserFavorites() {
		var def = $q.defer();

		// If in local cache
		if (localCache.userFavorites) {
			def.resolve(localCache.userFavorites);
		}

        if (!currentlyFetchingUserFavorites) {
            // If they're not already being fetched fetch it. 
            _fetchUserFavorites().then(function(favorites){
                def.resolve(favorites);
            })
        } else {
            // Return false if favorites are already going to be broadcast
            def.resolve(false);
        }

		return def.promise;
	}


	return {
		toggleBookmark: toggleBookmark,
		initFavorites: initFavorites,
		getUserFavorites: getUserFavorites,
	};
}]]></script><sys_class_name>sp_angular_provider</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>a.gonzales</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-03-19 09:28:28</sys_created_on><sys_id>2cd6b63283dc2a50c0fb56d6feaad37e</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>chamBookmark</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Employee Center Core" source="sn_hr_sp">3d1da2705b021200a4656ede91f91ab6</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Employee Center Core">3d1da2705b021200a4656ede91f91ab6</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sp_angular_provider_2cd6b63283dc2a50c0fb56d6feaad37e</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>a.gonzales</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-03-19 09:28:28</sys_updated_on><type>service</type></sp_angular_provider></record_update>

		}).then(function (response) {
			def.resolve(response.data.result);
		}, function(error) {
			def.resolve(false);
		})
		
		return def.promise;
	}
	
	function toggleBookmark(sys_id, table, title, created_on, order){
		var newUserPrefObj = {"id": sys_id, "t": table, "n": title, "c": created_on, "o": order};
		var payload = {
			action: '',
			sys_id: sys_id
		};

		var endpointURL = 'https://' + window.location.host + '/api/x_nero_rocketfuel/rocketfuel/userPreference';
		var postBody = {
				preferenceName: favoritesPrefName,
				value: newUserPrefObj
		};
		
		$http({
			method: 'POST',
			url: endpointURL,
			data: postBody,
			headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'}
		}).then(function (response) {
			var updatedPrefs = response.data.result.updatedPrefs;
			payload.action = response.data.result.action;
			// 'updateBookmark' is deault listener passed to scripted list to refresh list of favorites. 
			$rootScope.$broadcast('updateBookmark', payload);
			$rootScope.$broadcast('nr.updatedBookmarks', updatedPrefs);
			localCache.userFavorites = updatedPrefs;
		}, function(error) {
			spUtil.addInfoMessage("User must be logged in to save favorites.");
		})
	}

	function getUserFavorites() {
		var def = $q.defer();

		// If in local cache
		if (localCache.userFavorites) {
			def.resolve(localCache.userFavorites);
		}

        if (!currentlyFetchingUserFavorites) {
            // If they're not already being fetched fetch it. 
            _fetchUserFavorites().then(function(favorites){
                def.resolve(favorites);
            })
        } else {
            // Return false if favorites are already going to be broadcast
            def.resolve(false);
        }

		return def.promise;
	}


	return {
		toggleBookmark: toggleBookmark,
		initFavorites: initFavorites,
		getUserFavorites: getUserFavorites,
	};
}]]></script><sys_class_name>sp_angular_provider</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>mc.admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-03-09 17:48:50</sys_created_on><sys_id>5b9905bf83cc2a10c0fb56d6feaad3e5</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>chamBookmark</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Employee Center Core" source="sn_hr_sp">3d1da2705b021200a4656ede91f91ab6</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Employee Center Core">3d1da2705b021200a4656ede91f91ab6</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sp_angular_provider_5b9905bf83cc2a10c0fb56d6feaad3e5</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>mc.admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-03-09 17:48:50</sys_updated_on><type>service</type></sp_angular_provider></record_update>
