<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sp_angular_provider"><sp_angular_provider action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><name>chamEqualizeHeight</name><script><![CDATA[function ($timeout, $interval, $rootScope) {
	return {

		link: function(scope, element, attr) {
			var me = this;	
			var parent = element;

			// eqSelector is the property passed in from the directive
			var eqSelector = attr.chamEqualizeHeight;
			
			// Exit method if EQ CSS Selector is not defined.
			if(!eqSelector)
				return;
			
			// Standalone widget uses target-body attribute
			if (attr.targetBody=='true')
				parent = $('body');

			// Equalize height based on eqSelector
			if(eqSelector && eqSelector.length > 0) {		
				$timeout(function(){
					var eqElements = parent.find(eqSelector);

					if (eqElements.length > 0) {
						me.setElementsHeight(eqElements);	
					}
					else {

						// Allow up to two seconds for the content to appear.
						var interval = $interval(function(i){							
							eqElements = parent.find(eqSelector);	

							if(eqElements.length > 0) {		
								me.setElementsHeight(eqElements);
								$interval.cancel(interval);	
							}

							// end of Loop
							if(i === 100) {
								console.warn('chamEqualizeHeight: element (' + eqSelector + ') not found');
							}							
						}, 100, 100);
					}

				}, 0, false);
			}
			
			// Trigger the equalizer and element query again if the event is triggered
			$rootScope.$on("cham.data.changed", function(){
				$timeout(function(){					
					var eqElements = parent.find(eqSelector);
					me.setElementsHeight(eqElements);	
				}, 0);
			});
			
		},

		setElementsHeight: function(elements) {
			var me = this;			
			elements.height("auto");	
			var max = me.findMax(elements);							
			elements.height(max);

			// Attach a resize event in case the page changes sizes	
			$(window).resize(function(){
				clearTimeout(me.resizeTimer);
				me.resizeTimer = setTimeout(function(){
					me.setElementsHeight(elements);
				}, 200);								
			});
		},

		findMax: function(elements) {
			var elem = elements.sort(function(a, b) { return $(b).height() - $(a).height();});
			var first = elem.first();
			var height = elem.first().height();			
			return height;
		}
	};
}; ]]></script><sys_class_name>sp_angular_provider</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>mc.admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-03-09 18:08:34</sys_created_on><sys_id>642e097b83006a10c0fb56d6feaad31c</sys_id><sys_mod_count>1</sys_mod_count><sys_name>chamEqualizeHeight</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Employee Center Core" source="sn_hr_sp">3d1da2705b021200a4656ede91f91ab6</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Employee Center Core">3d1da2705b021200a4656ede91f91ab6</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sp_angular_provider_642e097b83006a10c0fb56d6feaad31c</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>mc.admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-03-09 18:15:35</sys_updated_on><type>directive</type></sp_angular_provider></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sp_css"><sp_css action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><css>.modal-content {

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sp_angular_provider"><sp_angular_provider action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><name>chamDatetime</name><script><![CDATA[function chamDatetime() {
	function formatDatetime(scope) {
		return moment(scope.dt).format(scope.format);
	}

	return {
		restrict: "E",
		template: "{{datetime}}",
		scope: {
			datetime: "=",
			format: "="
		},
		link: function(scope, ele, attrs) {
			if (typeof scope.format != "string")
				return;

			scope.datetime = formatDatetime(scope);
		}
	};
}]]></script><sys_class_name>sp_angular_provider</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>mc.admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-03-09 18:08:34</sys_created_on><sys_id>9c2e097b83006a10c0fb56d6feaad318</sys_id><sys_mod_count>1</sys_mod_count><sys_name>chamDatetime</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Employee Center Core" source="sn_hr_sp">3d1da2705b021200a4656ede91f91ab6</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Employee Center Core">3d1da2705b021200a4656ede91f91ab6</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sp_angular_provider_9c2e097b83006a10c0fb56d6feaad318</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>mc.admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-03-09 18:15:05</sys_updated_on><type>directive</type></sp_angular_provider></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sp_angular_provider"><sp_angular_provider action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><name>chamWidget</name><script><![CDATA[//Use this to embed a widget client-side
//useful for cases when you need to embed a widget with dynamic options in the ng-repeat directive.
//Note that the only thing that will be passed to the embedded widget server script is the input object 
angular.directive = function() {
	return {
		template: '<sp-widget widget=c.widget></sp-widget>',
		restrict: 'AE',
		transclude: true,
		scope: {
			widgetId: '@widgetId',
			payload: '<widgetInput',

		},
		controller: function ($scope, spUtil) {
			var c = this;
			if(!$scope.widgetId) return;
			spUtil.get($scope.widgetId, $scope.payload).then(function (response) {
				c.widget = response;
				//  options are overriden so we reassign it to the widget model 
				if($scope.payload.options) {
					response.options = Object.assign({}, response.options, $scope.payload.options);
				}
			});
		},
		controllerAs: 'c',
	};
};]]></script><sys_class_name>sp_angular_provider</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>mc.admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-03-09 18:08:34</sys_created_on><sys_id>a02e097b83006a10c0fb56d6feaad338</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>chamWidget</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Employee Center Core" source="sn_hr_sp">3d1da2705b021200a4656ede91f91ab6</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Employee Center Core">3d1da2705b021200a4656ede91f91ab6</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sp_angular_provider_a02e097b83006a10c0fb56d6feaad338</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>mc.admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-03-09 18:08:34</sys_updated_on><type>directive</type></sp_angular_provider></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sp_angular_provider"><sp_angular_provider action="DELETE"><name>chamBookmark</name><script><![CDATA[function(userPreferences, spUtil, $rootScope, $http, $q) {
	var currentlyFetchingUserFavorites = false;
	var favoritesPrefName = 'cham.bookmarks';
	var localCache = {};
		
	function initFavorites(sys_id) {
		// If the prefs are in the cache get them from there.
		if (localCache.userFavorites) 
			return localCache.userFavorites;

        // Check if they're being fetched asynch already, if so the broadcast below will update the directives. 
        if (!currentlyFetchingUserFavorites) {
            currentlyFetchingUserFavorites = true;
            _fetchUserFavorites().then(function(favorites) {
                // When the prefs return broadcast to ALL directives, cache the prefs locally. 
                $rootScope.$broadcast('cham.userFavorites', favorites);
                localCache.userFavorites = favorites;
                currentlyFetchingUserFavorites = false;
            })
        }

        // Return false because the broadcast will update the directives. 
        return false;
		
	} 
	
	function _fetchUserFavorites() {	
		var def = $q.defer();
		var endpointURL = 'https://' + window.location.host + '/api/x_nero_rocketfuel/rocketfuel/getUserPreference';
		var postBody = {
			preferenceName: favoritesPrefName,
		};
			
		$http({
			method: 'POST',
			url: endpointURL,
			data: postBody,
			headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'}
		}).then(function (response) {
			def.resolve(response.data.result);
		}, function(error) {
			def.resolve(false);
		})
		
		return def.promise;
	}
	
	function toggleBookmark(sys_id, table, title, created_on, order){
		var newUserPrefObj = {"id": sys_id, "t": table, "n": title, "c": created_on, "o": order};
		var payload = {
			action: '',
			sys_id: sys_id
		};

		var endpointURL = 'https://' + window.location.host + '/api/x_nero_rocketfuel/rocketfuel/userPreference';
		var postBody = {
				preferenceName: favoritesPrefName,
				value: newUserPrefObj
		};
		
		$http({
			method: 'POST',
			url: endpointURL,
			data: postBody,
			headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'}
		}).then(function (response) {
			var updatedPrefs = response.data.result.updatedPrefs;
			payload.action = response.data.result.action;
			// 'updateBookmark' is deault listener passed to scripted list to refresh list of favorites. 
			$rootScope.$broadcast('updateBookmark', payload);
			$rootScope.$broadcast('cham.updatedBookmarks', updatedPrefs);
			localCache.userFavorites = updatedPrefs;
		}, function(error) {
			spUtil.addInfoMessage("User must be logged in to save favorites.");
		})
	}

	function getUserFavorites() {
		var def = $q.defer();

		// If in local cache
		if (localCache.userFavorites) {
			def.resolve(localCache.userFavorites);
		}

        if (!currentlyFetchingUserFavorites) {
            // If they're not already being fetched fetch it. 
            _fetchUserFavorites().then(function(favorites){
                def.resolve(favorites);
            })
        } else {
            // Return false if favorites are already going to be broadcast
            def.resolve(false);
        }

		return def.promise;
	}


	return {
		toggleBookmark: toggleBookmark,
		initFavorites: initFavorites,
		getUserFavorites: getUserFavorites,
	};
}]]></script><sys_class_name>sp_angular_provider</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>a.gonzales</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-03-06 14:15:03</sys_created_on><sys_id>b6bb7c3283c8e210c0fb56d6feaad306</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>chamBookmark</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Employee Center Core" source="sn_hr_sp">3d1da2705b021200a4656ede91f91ab6</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Employee Center Core">3d1da2705b021200a4656ede91f91ab6</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sp_angular_provider_b6bb7c3283c8e210c0fb56d6feaad306</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>a.gonzales</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-03-06 14:15:03</sys_updated_on><type>directive</type></sp_angular_provider></record_update>

    border-left: 4px solid transparent;

    &.filter-active {
    border-color: $brand-primary;
  }
  }*/
  }

  .filter-active {
    background: #F1F1F1 !important; /* OOB rule is 6 selectors deep */
    color: $text-primary;
  }

  .filters li {
    height: fit-content !important; /* OOB rule is 6 selectors deep */
    font-size: $font-size-small !important; /* OOB rule is 6 selectors deep */
    font-weight: $font-weight-semibold;
    color: $text-primary;

    &:hover {
      color: $brand-primary; 
    }

    span {
      padding: 15px 7px;
    }
  }

  #sort_by_label, #s2id_autogen1-label {
    font-size: $font-size-xs;
    font-weight: $font-weight-bold;
    text-transform: capitalize;
  }

  #tab-card {
    border-right: 1px solid $border-color;
    padding-right: 8px;
  }

  .favorite-card-container {
    grid-gap: 30px !important;
  }



  .favorite-card {
    @include content-card-panel(true);
    background: $background-primary;

    .content-card-body {
      padding: 0; 
    }

    .card-badge {
      font-weight: $font-weight-bold;
    }

    .type-padding {
      padding-left: 10px;
    }

    .item-title {
      font-size: $font-size-md;
    }

    .item-description {
      font-size: $font-size-small;
      color: $text-primary;
    }

    .text-ellipsis-four-line {
      -webkit-line-clamp: 3; /* Overwriting to respect the bigger padding */
    }
  }
  .favorite-card:hover {
    @include content-card-hover(true);
  }

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sp_angular_provider"><sp_angular_provider action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><name>chamLoadTemplate</name><script><![CDATA[function ($templateCache, $compile) {
	return {
		link: function (scope, el, attrs) {
			var html = $templateCache.get(attrs.cham);
			if (!!html) {
				var content = $compile(html)(scope);
				el.replaceWith(content);
			}
		}
	};
}
]]></script><sys_class_name>sp_angular_provider</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>mc.admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-03-09 18:08:34</sys_created_on><sys_id>e02e097b83006a10c0fb56d6feaad323</sys_id><sys_mod_count>1</sys_mod_count><sys_name>chamLoadTemplate</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Employee Center Core" source="sn_hr_sp">3d1da2705b021200a4656ede91f91ab6</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Employee Center Core">3d1da2705b021200a4656ede91f91ab6</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sp_angular_provider_e02e097b83006a10c0fb56d6feaad323</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>mc.admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-03-09 18:13:59</sys_updated_on><type>directive</type></sp_angular_provider></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sp_angular_provider"><sp_angular_provider action="DELETE"><name>chamSharedService</name><script><![CDATA[function(spUtil, $rootScope, $http, $templateCache, $cacheFactory, $timeout) {
	/*
		Methods in this service have the ability to be overwritten by a service that 'extends' this one. 
		That service will have this one as an angular provider and both will be providers to the same widget,
		NOT NECESSARILY THE WIDGET CALLING THE METHOD, most likely the portals Header.
		The nrDebug methods below will help find those quickly. 
	*/

	var cache = $cacheFactory.get("nr_cache") || $cacheFactory("nr_cache");
	var stateEnum = {
		UNINITALIZED: "UNINITALIZED",
		INITIALIZED: "INITIALIZED",
		FETCHING: "FETCHING"
	}

	var utilities = {
		postRequest: function(endpoint, body, onSuccess, onError) {				
			return $http({
				method: "POST",
				url: endpoint,
				data: body,
				headers: {"Content-Type": "application/json"}
			}).then(onSuccess, onError);
		},

		cacheAndBroadcast: function(property, value) {
			$rootScope.$broadcast(property, value);
			cache.put(property, value);
		},

		/* 
		This can be used to overwrite any method in this service. 
		Pass which object, which method and the function to replace it with. 
		Calling this from an Extension service will allow overwriting the methods of this service from another application scope.
		*/
		override: function(serviceObject, property, newValue) {
			if (!serviceObject || !property || !newValue) {
				return;
			}

			serviceObject[property] = newValue;
		}
	}

	var favorites = {
		FavoritesPrefName: "cham.bookmarks",
		AllFavoritesEndpoint: window.location.origin + "/api/x_nero_rocketfuel/v2/rocketfuel/allFavorites",
		FavoriteEndpoint: window.location.origin + "/api/x_nero_rocketfuel/v2/rocketfuel/favorite",

		state: stateEnum.UNINITALIZED,

		broadcast: function() {
			switch(this.state) {
				case stateEnum.INITIALIZED:
					var userFavorites = cache.get(this.FavoritesPrefName);

					$rootScope.$broadcast(this.FavoritesPrefName, userFavorites);
					$rootScope.$broadcast("nr.userFavorites", userFavorites); //additional broadcast with this name is for backwards compatability of nrBookmarkBtn Directive
					break;
				case stateEnum.UNINITALIZED:
					var postBody = {
						preferenceName: this.FavoritesPrefName,
					};
					
					this.synchronize(postBody);
					break;
				default: 
					return;
			}
		},

		update: function(favoritesToUpdate) {
			// When ng-repeat "track by" isn"t used, Angular adds HashKeys which could pollute our favorites obj
			favoritesToUpdate = widgetUtilities.removeHashKey(favoritesToUpdate);

			var postBody = {
				preferenceName: this.FavoritesPrefName,
				favoritesToUpdate: favoritesToUpdate
			};

			this.synchronize(postBody);
		},

		synchronize: function(postBody) {
			this.state = stateEnum.FETCHING;
				
			function onSuccess(response) {
				favorites.state = stateEnum.INITIALIZED;
				var updatedFavorites = response.data.result;

				$rootScope.$broadcast("nr.userFavorites", updatedFavorites); // broadcast is for backwards compatability with nrBookmarkBtn directive
				utilities.cacheAndBroadcast(favorites.FavoritesPrefName, updatedFavorites);
			}

			function onError(error) {
				favorites.state = stateEnum.UNINITALIZED;			
			}
	
			utilities.postRequest(this.AllFavoritesEndpoint, postBody, onSuccess, onError);
		},

		toggle: function(sys_id, table, title, created_on, order, propsObj) {
			try{
				propsObj = JSON.parse(propsObj);
			} catch (error) {
				propsObj = {};
			}
			
			var newUserPrefObj = {"id": sys_id, "t": table, "n": title, "c": created_on, "o": order, p:$rootScope.portal.url_suffix, "props": propsObj};
			var postBody = {
					preferenceName: this.FavoritesPrefName,
					value: newUserPrefObj
			};

			function onSuccess(response) {
				var updatedFavorites = response.data.result.updatedFavorites;
				var payload = {
					action: response.data.result.action,
					sys_id: sys_id
				};

				$rootScope.$broadcast("updateBookmark", payload); // broadcast is for backwards compatability with nrBookmarkBtn directive
				utilities.cacheAndBroadcast(favorites.FavoritesPrefName, updatedFavorites);
			}

			function onError(error) {
				if (error.status === 401) {
					spUtil.addErrorMessage("User must be logged in to save favorites");
				}
				favorites.state = stateEnum.UNINITALIZED;			
			}
			
			utilities.postRequest(this.FavoriteEndpoint, postBody, onSuccess, onError);
		},

		sort: function(favorites, fieldToOrderBy, isNestedProp) {
			if (isNestedProp) {
				favorites = this._validatePropExists(favorites, fieldToOrderBy);
			}

			return favorites.sort(function(a,b) {
				var numA = isNestedProp ? parseInt(a.props[fieldToOrderBy]) : parseInt(a[fieldToOrderBy]); 
				var numB = isNestedProp ? parseInt(b.props[fieldToOrderBy]) : parseInt(b[fieldToOrderBy]);
				if (numA && numB) {
					return numA - numB;
				}

				var textA = isNestedProp ? a.props[fieldToOrderBy].toUpperCase() : a[fieldToOrderBy].toUpperCase();
				var textB = isNestedProp ? b.props[fieldToOrderBy].toUpperCase() : b[fieldToOrderBy].toUpperCase();
				return (textA < textB) ? -1 : (textA > textB) ? 1 : 0;
			});
		},

		/* _validatePropExists ensures that an object prop used for sorting exists */
		_validatePropExists: function (array, fieldToOrderBy) {
			array.forEach(function(obj, index) {
				if (obj.props[fieldToOrderBy]) {
					return;
				}
				
				obj.props[fieldToOrderBy] = ((index + 1) * 10);
			});
	
			return array;
		},
	}

	var widgetUtilities = {
		TemplateEndopoint: window.location.origin + '/api/x_nero_rocketfuel/rocketfuel/getTemplate',
		filterByValues: function(items, values, prop) {
			var filteredItems = [];
				
			values.forEach(function(value) {
				items.forEach(function(item) {
					if (item[prop] === value)
						filteredItems.push(item);
				})
			});
	
			return filteredItems;
		},

		/* 
		ng-repeat with no trackBy adds a $hashKey value to each object
		this can be used to sanatize an object of $hashKey values
		*/
		removeHashKey: function(items) {
			items.forEach(function(item) {
				if (item.$$hashKey) {
					delete item.$$hashKey
				}
			})
	
			return items;
		},

		/* Helper function for UI Sortable */
		fixWidthHelper: function(e, ui) {
			ui.children().each(function() {
				$(this).width($(this).width());
			});
			return ui;
		},

		getTemplate: function (templateId) {
			/* 
			Takes any template and puts it in the $templateCache 
			Once a template is in the $templateCache it can be used by any widget on the page,
			regardles of which widget the template is originally associated with.
			*/
			if ($templateCache.get(templateId)){
				return $templateCache.get(templateId);
			}

			var postBody = {
				templateId: templateId
			};

			function onSuccess(response) {
				var template = response.data.result.template;
				$rootScope.$broadcast(templateId, template);
				$templateCache.put(templateId, template);
			}

			function onError(error) {
				console.log("TEMPLATE FETCH ERROR: " + JSON.stringify(error));
				return false;
			}

			utilities.postRequest(this.TemplateEndopoint, postBody, onSuccess, onError);

			return false;
		}
	}
	
	var data = {
		MethodEndpoint: window.location.origin + "/api/x_nero_rocketfuel/v2/rocketfuel/method",

		/* Maintains the state of each data requested using each config's cacheProp */
		state: {},

		broadcast: function (config) {
			if (!config || !config.options.script_include || !config.method || !config.cacheProp) {
				return;
			}
			
			if (!this.state[config.cacheProp] || config.options.cacheBust) {
				this.state[config.cacheProp] = stateEnum.UNINITALIZED;
			}

			switch(this.state[config.cacheProp]) {
				case stateEnum.INITIALIZED:
					var cacheData = cache.get(config.cacheProp);
					
					/* timeout is because widget reinstantiation on navigation broadcasts too fast before listeners are registered */
					setTimeout(function() { $rootScope.$broadcast(config.cacheProp, cacheData)}, 0);
					break;
				case stateEnum.UNINITALIZED:
					this._fetchData(config).then(function(retrievedData) {
						if (retrievedData) {
							data.state[config.cacheProp] = stateEnum.INITIALIZED;
							utilities.cacheAndBroadcast(config.cacheProp, retrievedData);
						}
					});
					break;
				case stateEnum.FETCHING:
				default:
					return;
			}
		},

		_fetchData: function(config) {
			if (!config || !config.options.script_include || !config.method || !config.cacheProp) {
				return;
			}

			this.state[config.cacheProp] = stateEnum.FETCHING;

			var postBody = {
				api: config.options.script_include,
				method: config.method,
				options: config.options
			};

			if (config.options) {
				postBody.options = config.options;
			}

			function onSuccess(response) {
				return response.data.result;
			}
			
			function onError(error) { 
				data.state[config.cacheProp] === stateEnum.UNINITALIZED
			}
			
			return utilities.postRequest(this.MethodEndpoint, postBody, onSuccess, onError);
		}
	}

	var nrDebug = {
		serviceName: 'nrSharedService',
		PrintMethodEndpoint: window.location.origin + '/api/x_nero_rocketfuel/v2/rocketfuel/printMethod',

		printProviderExtensions: function(angularProviderName) {
			var name = angularProviderName || nrDebug.serviceName;
			/* 
			Used to print a list of angular providers to the console that have this Service as a provider.
			Any services in the list have the ability to overwrite methods in this Service
			*/
			var body = {
				provider: name,
				method: 'getProviderExtensions'
			};

			var onSuccess = function(response) {
				var providers = response.data.result.values;
				if (providers.length > 0) {
					console.group('Providers using ' + name + " :");
					providers.forEach(function(prov) {
						console.table(prov);
					})
					console.groupEnd();
				} else {
					console.log("No providers have " + name + "as a provider.");
				}
			}

			var onError = function(error) {
				console.log("Error printing Providers : ", error);
			}

			utilities.postRequest(this.PrintMethodEndpoint, body, onSuccess, onError);
		},

		printWidgetsUsingProvider: function(angularProviderName) {
			var name = angularProviderName || nrDebug.serviceName;
			/* 
			Used to print a list of angular providers to the console that have this Service as a provider.
			Any services in the list have the ability to overwrite methods in this Service
			*/
			var body = {
				provider: name,
				method: "getWidgetsUsingProvider"
			};

			var onSuccess = function(response) {
				var widgets = response.data.result.values;
				if (widgets.length > 0) {
					console.group("Widgets using " + name + " :");
					widgets.forEach(function(widget) {
						console.table(widget);
					})
					console.groupEnd();
				} else {
					console.log("No Widgets have " + name + "as a provider.");
				}
			}

			var onError = function(error) {
				console.log("Error printing widgets : ", error);
			}

			utilities.postRequest(this.PrintMethodEndpoint, body, onSuccess, onError);
		},

		printCacheValue: function(cacheProperty) {
			/*
			Offers additional console formating to printing values from the Cache rather than 
			console.log(nrSharedService.cache.get(value));
			*/
			if (!cacheProperty) {
				console.log("You must pass a property to check the cache for.");
				return;
			}

			if (!cache.get(cacheProperty)) {
				console.log("The cache does not contain a value for " + cacheProperty + ".");
				return;
			}

			var value = cache.get(cacheProperty);
			if (typeof value === 'function') {
				console.log("The value at " + cacheProperty + "is a function : ", value);
			} else {
				console.group("Cache Value for : " + cacheProperty);
				console.log(value);
				console.groupEnd();
			}

		},
		
		printDataState: function() {
			console.log(data.state);
		}
	}
	
	/* Attaches nrDebug methods to window they can be called from the console as nrDebug.methodName() */
	window.nrDebug = nrDebug;

	return {
		cache: cache,
		utilities: utilities,
		favorites: favorites, 
		widgetUtilities: widgetUtilities,
		data: data,
		nrDebug: nrDebug
	};
}
]]></script><sys_class_name>sp_angular_provider</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>mc.admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-03-09 18:08:34</sys_created_on><sys_id>e02e097b83006a10c0fb56d6feaad32a</sys_id><sys_mod_count>1</sys_mod_count><sys_name>chamSharedService</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Employee Center Core" source="sn_hr_sp">3d1da2705b021200a4656ede91f91ab6</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Employee Center Core">3d1da2705b021200a4656ede91f91ab6</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sp_angular_provider_e02e097b83006a10c0fb56d6feaad32a</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>dditan</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-03-17 10:00:51</sys_updated_on><type>service</type></sp_angular_provider></record_update>

	/*

            chamSharedService.favorites.toggleBookmark = function() {

            }
			
		OR use the method override function provided in the utilities object
		
		chamSharedService.utilities.override(chamSharedService.chamDebug, 'newFunctionName', function(){
			// your new code

        To use or update the cache use it's methods:

    */

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sp_angular_provider"><sp_angular_provider action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><name>chamUtil</name><script><![CDATA[function cham($rootScope, $interpolate) {
	return {
		getValue: getValue,
		setValue: setValue,
		getValues: getValues
	};

	function getValue(key) {
		if ($rootScope.hasOwnProperty(key)) {
			return $rootScope[key];
		}
		return false;
	}

	function setValue(key, value) {
		$rootScope[key] = value;
	}

	function getValues(scope, cb) {
		scope.$watch('$root["counts"]', function(newVal, oldVal) {
			if (!!newVal) {
				cb(newVal);
			}
		}, cb);
	}

}]]></script><sys_class_name>sp_angular_provider</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>mc.admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-03-09 18:08:34</sys_created_on><sys_id>e82e097b83006a10c0fb56d6feaad334</sys_id><sys_mod_count>1</sys_mod_count><sys_name>chamUtil</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Employee Center Core" source="sn_hr_sp">3d1da2705b021200a4656ede91f91ab6</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Employee Center Core">3d1da2705b021200a4656ede91f91ab6</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sp_angular_provider_e82e097b83006a10c0fb56d6feaad334</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>mc.admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-03-09 18:12:31</sys_updated_on><type>factory</type></sp_angular_provider></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sp_css"><sp_css action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><css>/* Article Body */
.article-details {
  @include panel-default-styles(true);
  margin-bottom: 30px;
  padding: 30px;

  .panel.panel-default.kb-desktop {
    padding: 0 0 20px;
    border: none !important;
  }
  hr.kb-permalink-separator {
    margin-top: 30px;
  }
  .kb-panel-heading.panel-heading {
    bottom: 0 !important;
  }

  /* Comments */
  div.v077810090be432004ce28ffe15673adb .kb-desktop .kb-comments-header {
    padding: 30px 0;
  }
  div.v077810090be432004ce28ffe15673adb .fa {
    color: $brand-primary;
  }
  div.v077810090be432004ce28ffe15673adb .show-all-btn i.fa {
    color: inherit;
  }

  span.commentor-info.pad-left10,
  div.v077810090be432004ce28ffe15673adb .feedback-button,
  div.v077810090be432004ce28ffe15673adb .liked, 
  div.v077810090be432004ce28ffe15673adb .green,
  div.v077810090be432004ce28ffe15673adb .expand-button {
    color: $text-primary;

    &:focus {
      box-shadow: none;
      outline: none;
    }
  }
}

@media (max-width: 62em) {
  .article-container {
    padding-left: 5.5rem;
    padding-right: 5rem !important;
  }
  .article-info {
    padding: 0;
  }
}

@media (min-width: 62em) {	
  .article-container {	
    padding-left: 5.5rem !Important;	
  }
  .article-info {
    padding-left: 3rem;
    padding-right: 4rem;
  }
}

/* Article Info Panel */
.cham-article-info-default .cham-article-info-panel {
  @include panel-secondary-styles;

  .panel-body {
    padding: 20px 0;
  }
  i.glyphicon.glyphicon-star,
  i.glyphicon.glyphicon-star-empty{
    color: $brand-secondary;
  }
  .col-sm-6.help-section {
    padding: 0;
  }
}

/* Article Attachments */
div.v405cf5910ba832004ce28ffe15673aff {
  .panel-default {
    background-color: $background-primary;
    border: 0;
    border-radius: $border-radius-large;
    box-shadow: $box-shadow-10;
  }
  .panel-title {
    margin-bottom: $m-lg;
  }
  .panel-body {
    padding: 0;
  }
  .sp-attachment-manager .attached-file a {
    color: $text-color;

    &:hover {
      color: $link-hover-color;
    }

    .fa {
      color: $brand-primary;
    }
  }
}</css><name>CHAM - Knowledge Article Page</name><sys_class_name>sp_css</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>mc.admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-03-04 13:33:24</sys_created_on><sys_id>053f528e83442210c0fb56d6feaad3ed</sys_id><sys_mod_count>1</sys_mod_count><sys_name>CHAM - Knowledge Article Page</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Employee Center Core" source="sn_hr_sp">3d1da2705b021200a4656ede91f91ab6</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Employee Center Core">3d1da2705b021200a4656ede91f91ab6</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sp_css_053f528e83442210c0fb56d6feaad3ed</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>mc.admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-03-04 16:01:28</sys_updated_on><turn_off_scss_compilation>false</turn_off_scss_compilation></sp_css></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sp_css"><sp_css action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><css>/* Survey To-Do */
div.v5cbb8f1053313010561cddeeff7b1272 {
  .survey-intro-block {
    @include panel-default-styles(true);
  }
}
.cham-hrm-todos-summary #todo-right-panel .task-content .panel.survey-intro-block {
  @include panel-default-styles(true);
  padding: 25px;
}

.asmt-modal-layout .field-label {
  font-size: $font-size-small;
  color: $text-primary;
}
.sp-asmt-auto-focus.asmt-img-scale.full-md-width {
  margin: 0 10px 0 0!important;
  width: auto;
}
.asmt-img-size {
  width: 48px;
  height: 48px;
}


/* Standard Ticket Page */
/*header*/
div.v8face42a131d0810da297ad66144b0e2 {
  .panel {
    @include panel-default-styles(true);
  }
  h2#short-desc {
    color: $text-primary;
  }

  .panel-body {
    padding: 0;
  }
}

/* Ticket Tab */
div.vd1cfa4ea131d0810da297ad66144b091 {
  .std-uib-tabset {
    background: transparent;
  }
  .nav-tabs {
    margin-bottom: $m-lg;
  }
  .panel.b.wrapper {
    @include panel-default-styles(true);
  }
}

/* Ticket Tab Details Wrapper */
div.v6155d8cb5b1313003bbcefe5f0f91ac8 {
  #isLE {
    background-color: $background-primary;
  }
  .content-wrap.b.row-eq-height {
    border-color: $border-color;
  }
}

/* Ticket Tab Details Internal Panels */
div.v6155d8cb5b1313003bbcefe5f0f91ac8 .b.panel {
  padding: 0;
}

/* Filter Panel */
div.vb99a3e553bdb13004d3b695593efc4b5 {
  .panel-title .title {
    margin-top: 0;
  }
  .task-tabs .avatar-container {
    height: 24px;
    width: 24px;
    margin: -1px 15px 1.5px 0;
  }
  #todos-type-filter button#btn-type-filter .arrow-icon {
    border-top-color: $brand-primary !important;
    border-right: 6px solid transparent;
    border-left: 6px solid transparent;

/*.cham-ticketdetails-container {
.cham-ticket-detail-image-container {
@include panel-shadow;

.cham-ticketdetails-actions {
display: flex;
gap: 20px;

}*/

.cham-ritm-details-tabs-container .ticket_conversation .timeline-badge.success {
  background: $text-primary;
}

.cham-hrm-todos-summary {
  padding: 25px;
  background-color: $panel-primary-bg;
  border-radius: 8px;
  border: $border-default;

  .page-title {
    display: none;
  }

  #todo-panel {
    padding: 25px;
    background: #ffffff;
    border: none;
    border-radius: 4px;
    min-height: 600px !important
  }

  .nav > li > a {
    padding-bottom: 8px;
  }

  .nav > li.tab > a:hover {
    background: transparent;
    color: $text-secondary;
  }

  .nav > li.tab > a:focus {
    background: transparent;
    border-top: 1px solid $brand-primary !important;
    border-right: 1px solid $brand-primary !important;
    border-left: 1px solid $brand-primary !important;
    color: $text-primary;
  }

  .nav-tabs li.active > a {
    border-bottom: 3px solid $brand-primary !important;
  }

  #todo-left-panel {
    background: transparent;
    border: $border-default;
    border-radius: 4px;
    padding: 0 25px 25px !important;

    .nav-tabs {
      background: transparent;
      font-weight: $font-weight-semibold;
      border-bottom: none;
    }

    .todos-list {
      &.selected{
        background-color: rgba(241, 241, 241, .6);
      }
      &:hover {
        background-color: rgba(241, 241, 241, .6);
        cursor: pointer;
      }
    }

    .task-title {
      padding-bottom: 10px;
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: $font-weight-semibold;
    }

    .link-text {
      color: $text-primary;
    }

    .todo-status {
      font-weight: $font-weight-bold;
      color: $brand-danger;
    }

    .tab-content {
      border-top: 2px solid transparent;
      //top: 8.8rem !important;
      padding: 0 25px;
    }

    #todo-right-panel {
      border: none;

      .task-content .panel {
        padding: 0 30px;
      }

      .task-content .panel-heading {
        padding-top: 0px;
        padding-left: 0px;
        padding-right: 0px;
        margin-bottom: 15px;

        .task-title {
          font-size: 24px; 
          font-weight: $font-weight-bold;
          padding-bottom: 25px;
          border-bottom: 1px solid #CCD9E6;
        }

        .case-title {
          margin-top: 25px !important;
          margin-bottom: 5px;

          a {
            color: $text-primary;
            &:hover {
              color: $link-hover-color;
              text-decoration: underline;
            }
          }
        }
      }

      #todo-requested-item-approval-panel {
        .panel-default {
          border: 0; 
        }
      }

      .status > span {
        font-size: 12px !important;
        font-weight: $font-weight-bold;
        color: $text-primary;

        &.todo-label-due-date {
          color: $brand-danger;
        }
      }


      ul#ahc-task-tabs {
        background: transparent;  
      }
      #ahc_info_tabs ul#ahc-task-tabs {
        border-bottom: none;

        li.header-sub-components a {
          padding: 0px;
          padding-bottom: 8px;
          margin-right: 24px;
          font-weight: $font-weight-semibold;
        }
      }

      .todo-line-item-wrap {
        padding-right: 0px !important;
        padding-left: 0px !important;
      }

      .task-content .panel-body {
        padding-top: 10px !important;
      }

      #sand {
        padding: 0px;
      }

      .ticket_conversation .flex-dir {
        height: 40px;
        padding-left: 0px;

        .post-btn {
          min-width: 157px;
        }
      }

      .form-control {
        border-radius: 3px;
      }

      .btn {
        border-radius: 20px;
      }

      div.timeline-panel {
        box-shadow: none;
      }

      .timeline {
        width: 50%;
        float: right;
      }

      .timeline-badge {
        background-color: $background-secondary;
      }

      .timeline-badge > span {
        text-transform: uppercase;
        font-size: 14px;
        font-weight: 700;
        color: $text-primary;
      }
    }
  }

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sp_css"><sp_css action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><css>.cham-ticket-heading-with-state {
  display: flex;
  gap: 10px;
  align-items: center;
  .label {
    padding: 2px 5px;
    color: $text-white;
    font-size: 12px;
  }
}

.cham-ticket-list-item .ticket-heading {
  padding: 18px 10px !important;
  border-bottom: 1px solid $border-tertiary !important;
  background-color: unset !important;
  .ticket-number {
    font-size: $font-size-base;
    color: $text-primary;
    font-weight: $font-weight-semibold;
    &:hover {
      color: $link-color;
      text-decoration: underline;
    }
  }
}

.cham-ticket-list-item {
  .ticket-label, .cham-text-bold {
    font-weight: $font-weight-bold;
    font-size: $font-size-xs;
    color: $text-primary;
    text-transform: capitalize;
  }

  .cham-text-tertiary {
    font-weight: $font-weight-normal;
    font-size: $font-size-xs;
    color: $text-primary;
    text-transform: capitalize;
  }

  .fa-chevron-right {
    color: $brand-primary !important; 
  }

  a.list-group-item {
    transition: all .25s ease;
    &:hover {
      /* TODO: Why does this require important? */
      /*background-color: #edecf2 !important;*/
      background-color: rgba(241, 241, 241, .6) !important;
    }
  }
}

.cham-ticket-options {
  .panel-default {
    @include panel-secondary-styles;
    padding: 20px;
    > .panel-body {
      padding: 20px 0;
      border-color: $border-tertiary;
      .panel-title {
        @include h4-styles;
      }
      &:first-child {
        padding: 0;
        border-bottom: 0;
        .panel-title {
          @include h2-styles;
          padding-bottom: 20px;
          margin-bottom: 20px !important;
          border-bottom: 1px solid $border-tertiary;
        }
      }
      &:last-child {
        border-bottom: 0;
        padding-bottom: 0;
      }
    }
    .form-control {
      color: #1D4D52;
    }
  }

  .fa-minus, .fa-plus {
    color: $brand-primary; 
  }

  .checkbox > label:hover > .option-text {
    text-decoration: underline;
  }
}</css><name>CHAM - My Tickets Page</name><sys_class_name>sp_css</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>mc.admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-03-04 13:33:23</sys_created_on><sys_id>383f528e83442210c0fb56d6feaad3c3</sys_id><sys_mod_count>1</sys_mod_count><sys_name>CHAM - My Tickets Page</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Employee Center Core" source="sn_hr_sp">3d1da2705b021200a4656ede91f91ab6</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Employee Center Core">3d1da2705b021200a4656ede91f91ab6</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sp_css_383f528e83442210c0fb56d6feaad3c3</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>mc.admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-03-04 15:58:09</sys_updated_on><turn_off_scss_compilation>false</turn_off_scss_compilation></sp_css></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sp_css"><sp_css action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><css>.input-group-btn:last-child > .btn {
  border-radius: 0 4px 4px 0;
  height: 36px;
  padding: 8px 24px;
}

.input-group-btn:last-child > .btn.disabled {
  border-color: $border-tertiary;
  background-color: $background-secondary;
  opacity: unset;
  color: $text-tertiary-light;
}

/* -- My Account -- */
.cham-my-account-container {
  .cham-my-account {
    padding-left: 0;

    @media only screen and (max-width: 765px) {
      padding-left: 20px;
      padding-right: 20px;
    }
  }

  .cham-my-account {
    & > .panel-heading {
      display: none;
    }
  }

  .cham-my-account-avatar {
    font-size: 16px;
    font-weight: 700;

    button {
      height: 160px;
      width: 160px;
      border: 0;
      border-radius: 50%;
      pointer-events: none;
      background-position: center;

      @media only screen and (min-width: 767px) and (max-width: 1170px) {
        height: 100px;
        width: 100px;
      }
    }

    /*&:hover .layover {
    border-radius: 50%;
    padding-top: 45px;
    font-size: 50px;
  }*/
  }

  .cham-my-account-tabs li > a {
    font-size: 14px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    border-bottom: 0 !important;
    border-left: 4px solid transparent !important;
  }

  .mobile-tabs {
    .current {
      background-color: $brand-primary-10;
    }

    .panel {
      padding: 0 10px;
    }
  }

  .cham-my-account-tabs li.active > a,
  .cham-my-account-tabs li > a:hover,
    .cham-my-account-tabs li.active > a:focus {
      border-left: 4px solid $brand-primary !important;
      background-color: $cham-my-account-tab-active !important;
      color: $text-primary !important;

      @media only screen and (max-width: 765px) {
        border-left: none !important;
      }
  }

  /* -- Content Panel -- */
  .cham-my-account-tab-content {
    .panel {
      padding-top: 0;
      border: 0 !important;
      min-height: 592px;

      @media only screen and (max-width: 765px) {
        padding-left: 0;
        padding-right: 0;
      }
    }
    .panel-footer {
      display: none;
    }
  }

  .cham-empty-state {
    img {
      width: 40px;
      height: 40px;
      filter: grayscale() brightness(1.4);
    }
  }

  /* -- About -- */
  .cham-my-account-widget {
    .btn-primary {
      @include button-secondary(true);
    }
    .field-has-reference .add-on {
      pointer-events: none;
      background-color: $background-secondary;
      cursor: not-allowed;

      span.fa.fa-info-circle {
        color: $text-tertiary-light;
      }
    }
  }

  /* -- My Team -- */
  /* TODO: Fix until RF Widget is Updated */
  .cham-my-account-team {
    .list-group-item {
      padding: 20px 0;
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .avatar-container {
      height: 40px;
      width: 40px;
    }

    .sub-avatar,
    .avatar-container {
      background-color: $icon-color center;
      background-size: cover;
      font-size: 14px !important;
      line-height: 3 !important;
    }

    .media {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;

      .media-heading {
        margin: 0;
      }
      .pull-right {
        order: 3;
        display: flex;
        .fa {
          color: $brand-secondary;
          font-size: 18px;
        }
        & > a {
          pointer-events: auto;
          &:first-child {
            padding-right: 8px;
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }

  /* -- My Assets -- */
  .cham-my-assets-container {
    .list-group-item {
      padding: 20px 0;
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .list-group-item:not(first-child) {
      /*border-top: 1px solid $border-color-dark;*/
      border: none;
    }
  }

  /* -- My Delegates -- */
  .cham-my-account-delegates {

    .btn-primary {
      @include button-secondary(true);
    }

    .list-group-item {
      padding: 20px 0;
      border-top: 1px solid $border-color !Important;

      a {
        margin-left: auto;
      }
    }

    /*.list-group-item:not(first-child) {
    border-top: 1px solid $border-color-dark;
  }*/

    .fa-plus {
      display: none;
    }
  }
}
</css><name>CHAM - My Account Styles</name><sys_class_name>sp_css</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>mc.admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-03-04 13:33:24</sys_created_on><sys_id>4d3f928e83442210c0fb56d6feaad327</sys_id><sys_mod_count>4</sys_mod_count><sys_name>CHAM - My Account Styles</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Employee Center Core" source="sn_hr_sp">3d1da2705b021200a4656ede91f91ab6</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Employee Center Core">3d1da2705b021200a4656ede91f91ab6</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sp_css_4d3f928e83442210c0fb56d6feaad327</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>a.gonzales</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-03-17 10:01:20</sys_updated_on><turn_off_scss_compilation>false</turn_off_scss_compilation></sp_css></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sp_css"><sp_css action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><css>h1 {
  @include h1-styles;
}

h2 {
  @include h2-styles; 
}

h3 {
  @include h3-styles; 
}

h4 {
  @include h4-styles; 
}

h5 {
  @include h5-styles; 
}

#uiNotificationContainer .dismiss-notifications {
  color: #fff; 
}

/* Sets select box dropdown arrow to an svg. Not supported in IE */
select {
  -webkit-appearance: none;
  background: url('cham-chevron-down-svg.svg') no-repeat right !important;
  background-position-x: calc(100% - 12px) !important;
}

/* -- Sidebar Nav -- */
--link-color: $text-primary;

/* Side Nav */
section.page {
  padding-left: 85px;
}

@media (max-width: 767px) {
  section.page {
    padding-left: 0px;
  }
}

/* Page Padding for Side Nav */
.row {
  margin-right: -12px;
}

@media (max-width : 62em) {
  .container {
    width : 100%;
    padding-right: 4rem !important;
  }
  .col-md-4 {
    width : 100%
  }
  .col-md-8 {
    width : 100%
  }
  .left-column, .left-c{
    padding-left: 2.4rem;
    padding-right: 1rem;	
  }	
  .right-column, .right-c {
    padding-left: 2.4rem;
    padding-right: 1rem;	
  }
  .r-pad {
    padding-right: 1rem;
  }
}

@media (min-width: 62em) {	
  .container {	
    padding-left: 1.2rem !important;	
    padding-right: 1.2rem !important;	
  }	
  .left-column, .left-c {
    padding-left: 4rem !important;
  }	
  .right-column, .right-c {
    padding-left: 1.4rem;
    padding-right: 4rem;
  }	
  .r-pad {
    padding-right: 4rem;
  }
}



/* -- General -- */
body {
  font-family: "Acumin Pro", sans-serif;
}

body .padding-top {
  padding-top: 0px !important;
}

.b {
  border: 1px solid $border-tertiary;
}

.b-t,
.b-b,
.b-l,
.b-r {
  border-color: $border-tertiary;
}

.sp-page-loader {
  text-align: center;
  top: 45vh;
}
.sp-page-loader-mobile {
  top: 6%;
  left: 93%;
}

.sp-loading-indicator {
  color: $brand-primary;
}

.cham-favorite-button .fa,
.cham-sidebar-menu-item .fa,
.bookmark-container .fa {
  color: $icon-color;
}

.input-group .btn-default {
  border-color: $input-border;
}

/* -- Typography -- */
.link {
  font-size: 16px;
  font-weight: normal;
}

/* -- Buttons --*/
.btn {
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 700;
  border-radius: 20px;
  padding: 10px 24px 8px;
  text-transform: uppercase;

  &:active, &:focus {
    border-radius: 20px;
  }
}

.btn-success, .btn-danger {
  border-radius: 20px !important; 
}

.btn-primary {
  border-color: $btn-primary-border;
  box-shadow: $btn-primary-box-shadow;

  &:hover {
    background-color: $btn-primary-hover;
    border-color: $btn-primary-hover;
  }

  &:active {
    background-color: $btn-primary-active;
    border-color: $btn-primary-active;
  }

  &.disabled, &[disabled] {
    opacity: .65;
    background-color: $btn-primary-active !important;
    border-color: $btn-primary-active !important;
    color: $text-primary !important;
  }
}

.btn.btn-default:hover,
.btn.btn-default:active {
  border-color: $btn-default-border;
  background-color: $btn-default-color;
  color: $inverse-text-color;
}

.btn-secondary {
  border-color: $btn-secondary-border;
  background-color: $btn-secondary-bg;
  color: $btn-secondary-color;
  box-shadow: $btn-secondary-box-shadow;

  &:hover, &:active {
    background-color: $btn-secondary-hover;
    border-color: $btn-secondary-hover;
    color: $btn-secondary-color;
  }
}

/* -- Container -- */
.container {
  width: 100% !important;
  max-width: 1660px !important;
  padding-left: 30px;
  padding-right: 30px;
  margin: auto;
}

.container-fluid {
  padding-left: 30px;
  padding-right: 30px;
  margin: auto;
}

@media (max-width: 767px) {
  .container,
  .container-fluid {
    padding-left: 15px;
    padding-right: 15px;
  }
}

/* -- Home hero image -- */
.home-hero {
  padding: 20px 0 0;
  margin-bottom: 100px;

  @media (max-width: 991px) {
    margin-bottom: 30px;
  }
}

.home-hero .cham-title * {
  color: $inverse-text-color;
}

@media only screen and (max-width: 767px) {
  .home-hero {
    /*padding: 10px 0 30px;*/
    margin-bottom: 15px;
  }
  /* Shrink search on mobile */
  .input-group-lg > .form-control,
  .input-group-lg > .input-group-addon,
  .input-group-lg > .input-group-btn > .btn {
    height: 34px;
    padding: 6px 12px;
    font-size: 14px;
    line-height: 1.42857143;
    border-radius: $border-radius-base;
  }
}

/* -- Page Headings -- */
.page-heading {
  color: $cham-heading-text;
  background-color: $cham-heading-bg;
  padding: 30px 0;
  margin-bottom: 30px;
  border-bottom: solid 1px $cham-heading-bg;
  min-height: 146px;
  h1.title-text {
    margin-bottom: 0;
  }
}

@media only screen and (max-width: 767px) {
  .page-heading {
    margin-bottom: 15px;
  }
}

.page-heading a,
.page-heading a:hover,
.page-heading .fa,
.page-heading .cham-favorite-button a:active,
.cham-favorite-button a:focus {
  color: $cham-heading-text;
}

/* Overwrite Accent Colors to match theme branding if supported */
@supports (accent-color: $brand-primary) {
  a:focus {
    outline: 5px auto $brand-primary;
  }

  input[type="range"], input[type="checkbox"], input[type="radio"] {
    accent-color: $brand-primary;
  }

  :focus-visible {
    outline: 1px auto $brand-primary;
  }
}

/* -- Sticky footer -- */
footer {
  /*display: none;*/ /*Hiding on all pages and placing diplay: block on home page css*/
}

section.page {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  display: -ms-flexbox;
  -ms-flex-direction: column;
}

section.page > main.body,
section.page > section.body {
  flex-grow: 1;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  -ms-flex-positive: 1;
}

/* -- RF Title with fading line -- */
.cham-title-container {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: flex-start;
  align-items: center;
  flex-wrap: nowrap;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.cham-title-separator {
  width: 100%;
  height: 1px;
  background: linear-gradient(
    90deg,
    $brand-primary 0%,
    rgba(23, 107, 174, 0) 100%
  );
}

/* -- Search -- */
form[ng-submit="c.submitSearch()"] input.input-typeahead {
  border-radius: $border-radius-base 0px 0px $border-radius-base !important;
  box-shadow: none;
}
form[ng-submit="c.submitSearch()"] button[type="submit"] {
  border-radius: 0px $border-radius-base $border-radius-base 0 !important;
  border-left: 0px solid transparent;
  padding-right: 20px;
}

/* -- FIX: search suggestion hover over font color -- */
.dropdown-menu > .active > a,
.dropdown-menu > .active > a:hover,
.dropdown-menu > .active > a:focus {
  color: $text-color;
}

/* -- Tabs -- */
.nav-tabs {
  border-bottom: none;
  padding-bottom: 3px;
}

.nav-tabs .badge {
  margin-left: 5px;
}

.nav-tabs > li > a {
  color: $text-muted;
  font-size: 16px;
  font-weight: bold;
  padding-left: 0;
  padding-right: 0;
  margin-right: 15px;
  border-left: none;
  border-right: none;
  border-bottom: 3px solid transparent;
}

.nav-tabs > li > a:hover,
.nav-tabs > li > a:focus,
.nav-tabs > li.active > a,
.nav-tabs > li.active > a:hover,
.nav-tabs > li.active > a:focus {
  color: $text-primary;
  background-color: transparent;
  border-color: transparent;
  border-bottom: 3px solid $brand-primary;
  border-left: none;
  border-right: none;
  box-shadow: none;
}

/* -- Panels -- */
.panel {
  /*-webkit-box-shadow: $box-shadow-webkit;
  -moz-box-shadow: $box-shadow-moz;
  box-shadow: 0 2px 3px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);*/
  box-shadow: none;
  padding: $panel-padding;
  border: 1.5px solid $border-tertiary;
  border-radius: $border-radius-large;
  margin-bottom: $panel-border-bottom;
}

.panel.b {
  border-color: $border-color;
}

.panel-heading {
  border: none;
}

.panel .panel-heading,
.panel .panel-footer {
  background-color: $panel-bg;
}

.panel-title {
  font-size: 24px;
  color: $text-color;
  text-transform: capitalize;
}

.list-group-item {
  padding: 15px;
}

.list-group a,
a.list-group-item .item-title {
  color: $text-color;
}

/* Panel Default */
.panel-default .panel-heading {
  border-bottom: 1px solid $border-color;
  border-color: $border-color;
}

.panel-default .panel-footer {
  border-top: 1px solid $border-color;
}

.panel-default {
  @include panel-default-styles(false); 
  > .panel-body {
    padding-left: 0;
    padding-right: 0;
  }
}

.panel-secondary {
  @include panel-secondary-styles();
  > .panel-body {
    padding-left: 0;
    padding-right: 0;
  }
}

/* Contextual Panels  */
.panel-primary {
  border-top: 3px solid $brand-primary !important;
}

.panel-success {
  border-top: 3px solid $brand-success !important;
}

.panel-info {
  border-top: 3px solid $brand-info !important;
}

.panel-warning {
  border-top: 3px solid $brand-warning !important;
}

.panel-danger {
  border-top: 3px solid $brand-danger !important;
}

/* cham Panels Empty State */
.cham-empty-state {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: center;
  align-items: center;
  text-align: center;
  height: 136px;
  padding: 20px;
  i {
    color: $panel-empty-icon-color;
    font-size: 35px;
    padding-bottom: 15px;
  }
  color: $text-muted;
  background-color: $panel-empty-state-background-color;
}

/* -- Modals -- */
.modal-content {
  .fa-times::before {
    content: $close-icon;
  }
}

/* -- Navigation Elements -- */
@mixin nav-caret {
  color: $brand-primary;
  border-top: 8px dashed;
  border-right: 6px solid transparent;
  border-left: 6px solid transparent;
  border-radius: 1px;
}

/* -- Form Styles -- */
.form-control {
  box-shadow: none !important;
}

.select2-container .select2-choice {
  border-color: $input-border !important;
  border-radius: $input-border-radius;
}

div.select2-container .select2-choice > .select2-chosen {
  color: #1D4D52;
}

.select2-container .select2-choice .select2-arrow {
  border: 0;
}

.select2-container .select2-choice .select2-arrow b {
  @include nav-caret;
  background-image: none !important;
  display: inline-block;
  margin-top: 13px;
  margin-left: 5px;
  width: auto;
  height: auto;
}

.select2-container.select2-container-disabled .select2-choice {
  border: 0 !important;
  background-color: $background-secondary;

  .select2-arrow {
    background-color: $background-secondary;
  }

  .select2-arrow b {
    color: $text-tertiary-light;
  }
}

/* Forms - Read Only - Most fields accounted for */
@if $readonly-styles {
  input[readonly="readonly"],
  button[disabled],
  html input[disabled],
  .select2-container-disabled .select2-choice,
  .select2-container-disabled {
    background-color: transparent !important;
    border: 0 !important;
    padding-left: 0;

    .select2-arrow,
    .input-group-btn .btn[disabled] {
      display: none;
      background-color: transparent;
    }
  }

  .ref-picker-container .btn[disabled],
  .input-group-btn .btn[disabled] {
    display: none;
  }
}

/* cham See All link */
@if $see-all-icon {
  .cham-see-all-link::after {
    font-family: FontAwesome;
    content: url($see-all-icon);
    margin-left: 5px;
    vertical-align: middle;
  }

  /* FIX: My items list (approvals and tickets without panel) */
  .cham-my-items .cham-see-all-link.padder-md {
    padding-right: 0px !important;
    padding-left: 0px !important;
  }
  .cham-see-all-link {
    color: $text-primary;
    font-size: 14px;
    font-weight: 600;
  }
}

.cham-see-all-link i {
  display: none; /* Remove hardcoded icon and replace it with the theme level icon*/
}

/* cham Panel Card View */
.card-view.panel {
  box-shadow: $panel-box-shadow;
  padding: $cham-card-view-panel-padding;
}

a.card-view {
  color: $text-color;
}

.card-view:hover,
.card-view:active {
  background-color: $brand-primary;
}

.card-view:hover *,
.card-view:active * {
  color: $inverse-text-color;
}

/* -- Category Buttons & Catalog Items -- */
.sc-cat-item-image.image-block {
  display: block !important;
}

.category-button,
.cham-popular-item {
  height: 196px;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.category-button-image {
  margin-bottom: 12px;
}

.sc-cat-item.card-view,
.category-button {
  text-align: center;
}

.category-button-text {
  text-align: left;
}

.sc-cat-item.card-view:hover,
.category-button:hover {
  border-top: 4px solid $brand-primary;
  box-shadow: 0 0 30px 0px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);
}

.sc-cat-item-image-container {
  border-bottom-width: 0px !important;
}

.sc-cat-item-text,
.sc-cat-item-price {
  text-align: left;
}

.slick-slide a {
  height: 220px;
}

.sc-sticky-item-header {
  display: none;
}

.sc-fixed {
  width: 100% !important;
  position: static !important;
}

.sc-item-error-messages {
  width: calc(100% - 30px) !important;
}

/* -- Category Items -- */
@media only screen and (min-width: 768px) {
  a.card-view.sc-cat-item {
    height: 240px;
  }
}

/*FIX: Faceted search disable color */
div.sp-facet-list .disabled {
  color: $text-muted;
}

/* FIX: elements dysplaying on top of drop downs */
.sc-sticky-item-header,
.cart-table th {
  z-index: 1 !important;
}

/* FIX: Remove vertical scroll bar from Cat Item Required Information */
.sc-item-error-messages {
  max-height: initial !important;
}

/* FIX: Make badges round */
.nav .badge {
  line-height: 1 !important;
  vertical-align: bottom;
  border-radius: 10px;
  min-width: 25px;
  padding: 3px 5px 3px;
}

/* FIX: Fix timeline badge padding because of ServiceNow error */
.timeline-container .timeline-item .timeline-badge {
  padding-bottom: 58px;
}

/* FIX: Adjusting z-index for timeline on order guides */
div.timeline-container{
  z-index: 1 !important;
}

/* -- Ticket List -- */
.cham-ticket-list-item.panel {
  padding: 0px;
  border-left-width: 5px !important;
}
.panel-heading.ticket-heading {
  background-color: #e1edf9;
}

.ticket-badge.badge {
  background-color: $brand-primary-light;
  color: $brand-primary;
  border-radius: $border-radius-base;
  font-weight:900;
  font-size: 10px;
  padding: 2px 15px;
}

/* -- Ticket Details Page -- */
.cham-ticketdetails-container .panel > .wrapper-lg {
  padding: 0px !important; /* FIX: padding should be consistent with all ther panels */
}
.cham-ticketdetails-actions {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-evenly;
  .action-btn {
    flex: 1;
    &:not(:last-of-type) {
      margin-right: 5px;
    }
  }
}

.ticket-detail-options-footer {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
}

.ticket-time-updated{
  color: #C4C4C4
}

/* -- Overflow -- */
.cham-category-button-small .panel-title {
  display: -webkit-box;
  overflow: hidden;
  -webkit-line-clamp: 1;
  -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
}

.ellipses-1 {
  display: -webkit-box;
  overflow: hidden;
  -webkit-line-clamp: 1;
  -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
}

div.panel-title,
.media-heading,
.item-title,
.sc-cat-item-title,
.ellipses-2 {
  display: -webkit-box;
  overflow: hidden;
  -webkit-line-clamp: 2;
  -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
}

.card-description,
.sc-cat-item-text,
.approval-description,
.ellipses-3 {
  display: -webkit-box;
  overflow: hidden;
  -webkit-line-clamp: 3;
  -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
}

.cham-label{
  color: $brand-primary;
  font-family: $font-family-base;
  font-style: normal; 
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 700;
}

/* Attachments tab fix in uib tabs */
.ticket_conversation {
  .input-group {
    width: 100%;
    position: relative;
    > textarea {
      min-height: 58px;
      padding: 16.5px 10px;
      padding-right: 120px;
      border-color: $border-tertiary;
      border-radius: 4px;
    }
    > span.input-group-btn {
      position: absolute;
      right: 10px;
      top: 8px;
      width: unset;
      z-index: 3;
      > .btn {
        background-color: $brand-primary;
        padding: 10px 29px;
        border-radius: 20px;
        border-color: $brand-primary;
        margin: 0;
        height: auto;
        color: $text-white;
        &:hover {
          background-color: darken($brand-primary, 10%); 
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

.tab-content > .tab-pane > div[sn-atf-area="Ticket Attachments"],
.cham-tabbed-content .tab-pane > div >  div[sn-atf-area="Ticket Attachments"] {
  > .panel {
    padding-top: 25px;
    position: relative;
  }
  .sp-attachment-add {
    position: absolute;
    top: -25px;
    right: 0;
    font-size: 24px;
  }
}


sn-search-results-container, sn-search-facets {
  --mv9-kWzzvm--XZATrZO--krZt--JvjvZ : $brand-primary !important;
  --mv9-kWzzvm--XZATrZO--krZt--JvjvZ--8vstZ: $brand-primary !important;


}

.cham-related-cham-item-link {
  > * {
    color: $brand-primary;
    &:hover {
      text-decoration: underline;
      color: darken($brand-primary, 5%);
    }
  }
}

.cham-content-container > .article {
  padding: 0;
  padding-bottom: 30px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid $border-tertiary;
}

.cham-content-container .cham-comments {
  padding-top: 30px;
  .panel, .panel-body {
    padding: 0;
    border: 0;
  }
  .cham-comment, .cham-comment-new-button {
    border: 1px solid #ddd;
    border-radius: 4px; 
    padding: 20px !important;
  }

  .panel:last-child {
    margin-bottom: 0; 
  }

  .fa-trash {
    color: $brand-primary; 
  }

  .cham-cham-comment-user-name {
    color: $text-primary;
    font-weight: $font-weight-normal;
  }

  .cham-comment {
    margin-bottom: 0 !important; 
  }
}



[accessibility] .navbar-brand:focus, [accessibility] .navbar-nav > li > a:focus, [accessibility] .skip-link:focus, [accessibility] .btn.btn-primary:focus, [accessibility] .btn.btn-danger:focus, [accessibility] .navbar-inverse .navbar-toggle:focus{
  border-radius: 20px;
}

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sp_css"><sp_css action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><css>/* -- Service Outages -- */

/* Outer container */
div#x7017b34c87b329d098264b59dabb3551 {
  .carousel-container .item {
    border-radius: $border-radius-base;
    background: $brand-danger;
  }
  .carousel > .carousel-controls {
    top: 35%;
    right: 40px;
  }
  .dismiss-btn {
    top: 5px;
    right: 10px;
  }

  .fa-chevron-left, .fa-chevron-right {
    width: 2.5rem;
    height: 2.5rem;
    font-size: $font-size-xl;
    line-height: 2.5rem;
    text-align: center;

    &:hover {
      background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, .25);
      border-radius: 0.25rem;
    }
  }
  .fa-chevron-left:before {
    content: "\f104";
  }
  .fa-chevron-right:before {
    content: "\f105";
  }
}

.cham-alert-scroller, .cham-outage-scroller {
  .fa-exclamation-triangle {
    color: $brand-danger;
  }

  &.alert, .alert {
    padding: $pad-sm $pad-md;
    margin: $m-sm 0;
    border: none;
    color: $text-white;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: row;
    justify-content: flex-start;
    align-items: center;
    align-content: center;
    column-gap: 2rem;
    position: relative;
    border-radius: $border-radius-base !important;

    .b-r {
      border-right-color: white;
    }

    .btn {
      padding: 0;
      font-size: $font-size-base;
      line-height: 3.2rem;
      width: 3.2rem;
      height: 3.2rem;
      border-radius: 50%;
      text-align: center;
      border: none;
      background-color: $background-primary;
    }
    .text-danger {
      color: $label-danger-bg;
    }
  }

  .btn-info:hover {
    background-color: $label-info-bg;
  }

  .btn-danger:hover {
    background-color: $label-danger-bg;
  }

  .btn-warning:hover {
    background-color: $label-warning-bg;
  }

  .carousel-inner {
    min-height: 7.2rem;

    .item {
      opacity: 0 !important;
      transition: .25s ease-in-out;
    }

    .item.active {
      opacity: 1 !important;
      z-index: 5;
    }

    .text-center {
      text-align: left;
    }

    .alert {
      .info {
        font-size: $font-size-xs;
        line-height: 1.2;
        margin-right: 8.8rem;

        strong {
          font-size: $font-size-base;
          line-height: 1;
        }
      }
    }
  }

  /* -- Start cham-carousel-controls.html styling -- */
  .carousel-controls {
    position: absolute;
    top: 2.375rem;
    right: $m-lg;
    z-index: 5;

    .slide-numbers {
      color: $text-white;
      width: 3.5rem;
      text-align: center;
      font-size: $font-size-base;
      display: inline-block;
      vertical-align: bottom;
      padding-bottom: 3px;
    }

    a {
      z-index: 10;
      color: $text-white;

      i {
        width: 2.5rem;
        height: 2.5rem;
        font-size: $font-size-xl;
        line-height: 2.5rem;
        text-align: center;

        &:hover {
          background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, .25);
          border-radius: 0.25rem;
        }
      }
    }
  }
  /* -- End cham-carousel-controls.html styling -- */

  .carousel-control {
    display: unset !important;
    background-image: none !important;
    text-shadow: none !important;
    opacity: 1 !important;
    width: 2.5rem !important;
    height: 2.5rem !important;
    top: 2.375rem;
    font-size: $font-size-base !important;
    z-index: 10;

    &:hover {
      background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, .25);
      border-radius: 0.25rem;
    }

    .glyphicon-chevron-left, .glyphicon-chevron-right, .icon-prev, .icon-next {
      width: 2.5rem !important;
      height: 2.5rem !important;
      font-size: $font-size-base !important;
      margin-top: -0.75rem
    }

    .glyphicon-chevron-left, .icon-prev {
      margin-left: -1.25rem;
    }

    .glyphicon-chevron-right, .icon-next {
      margin-right: -1.25rem;
    }
  }

  .carousel-control.left {
    left: unset;
    right: 4.5rem;
  }

  .carousel-control.right {
    right: 2rem;
  }
}

.cham-outage-scroller.alert {
  margin: 0; 
}

.home-hero .carousel-container {
  margin: $m-sm 0; 
  .carousel-controls .chevron-right {
    padding-left: 0 !important;
    margin-left: 10px;
  }
  .carousel-controls {

  }
}

.cham-outage-scroller {
  /*padding-right: 100px !important; */
  .title {
    a, span {
      word-break: break-word;
    }
  }
}

@media only screen and (max-width: 767px) {
  .v3d264094dba17b0026e49474db961956 {
    .cham-alert-scroller, .cham-outage-scroller {
      padding-right: 20px !important;
      padding-bottom: 40px;
    }
    .carousel-controls {
      text-align: center;
      top: calc(100% - 35px) !important;
      right: unset !important;
      left: 50%;
      transform: translateX(-50%); 
    }
  }
}

.cham-outage-scroller .alert.btn-info {
  background-color: #0F75DB !important;
  border-color: #0F75DB !important;
  &:hover {
    background-color: #0F75DB !important;
    border-color: #0F75DB !important;
  }

}

.cham-outage-scroller .alert.btn-danger {
  background-color: #DF302A !important;
  border-color: #DF302A !important;
  &:hover {
    background-color: #DF302A !important;
    border-color: #DF302A !important;
  }
}

@media only screen and (max-width: 767px) {
  .cham-outage-scroller .alert {
    padding-bottom: 40px; 
  }

  .cham-outage-scroller .info {
    margin-right: 0 !important;
  }

  .cham-outage-scroller .carousel-controls {
    top: unset !important;
    right: unset !important;
    left: 50%;
    bottom:10px;
    transform: translateX(-50%);
  }

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sp_css"><sp_css action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><css>// TODO: Move helper classes to global utilities stylesheet. This stylesheet is needed for showing approval actions on hover.

.cham-approvals-list.with-hover-actions,
.cham-ticket-list-item.with-hover-actions {
  .approval-inline-actions {
    position: absolute;
    right: 15px;
    top: 50%;
    transform: translateY(-50%);
    min-width: 150px;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 15px;
    display: none;

  }

  &:hover,
  .list-group:hover{
    cham-approval-actions .approval-inline-actions {
      display: flex; 
    }
  }

  cham-approval-actions:hover {
    .approval-inline-actions {
      display: flex;
    }
  }

  .absolute1515 {
    position: absolute;
    top: 15px;
    left: 15px;
  }

  .m-negative-md {
    margin: -15px;
  }

  .gap-10 {
    gap: 10px; 
  }

  .gap-30 {
    gap: 30px; 
  }

  .relative {
    position: relative; 
  }

  .padding-15 {
    padding: 15px; 
  }

  @media only screen and (min-width: 992px) {
    &:hover {
      .list-group .list-group-item {
        padding-right: 175px !important; 
      }
    }
    .list-group:hover .list-group-item {
      padding-right: 175px !important; 
    }

    .list-group-item .cham-approvals-list-item-details > div {
      min-width: 175px;
      max-width: 175px;
    }
  }

  @media only screen and (max-width: 991px) {
    .flex-dir-col-md {
      flex-direction: column;
    }
    .gap-10-md {
      gap: 10px; 
    }
  }

}

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sp_css"><sp_css action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><css>/* -- Popular Topics -- */
.popular-topic-panel {
  @include panel-default-styles(true);

  .popular-topic-panel-body {
    
    .popular-topic-body-container, .popular-topic-body-container:not(.fixed) {
      padding: 25px 0 0;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(25rem, 1fr)) !important;
      grid-gap: 2rem;

      .popular-topic-body {
        @include topic-card;
        background-color: $background-primary !important;

        &:hover {
          @include content-card-hover;
        }
		
        .popular-topic-favorite-container{
        	z-index:1000;
         }
        .popular-topic-link {
          display: flex;
          padding: $pad-md;
          font-size: $font-size-base;
          gap: 10px;
          align-items: center;
          position: relative;
          z-index: 1;


          > img {
            margin: 0; 
            max-width: 24px;
            max-height: 24px;
          }

          .popular-topic-caption {
            padding: 0 !important;
            margin: 0 !important;
            display: flex;
            width: 100%;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            &:after {
              @include see-all-icon;
              -webkit-mask-image: url($card-chevron);
              mask-image: url($card-chevron);
              height: 14px;
              width: 14px;
              position:relative;
              right:10px;
            }

            .popular-topic-title {
              text-align: left;
              display: -webkit-box;
              overflow: hidden;
              -webkit-line-clamp: 1;
              -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
              font-weight: $font-weight-semibold;
            }
          }

          &:hover {
            .popular-topic-caption:after {
              /*background-color: $text-primary;*/
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}</css><name>CHAM - Popular Topics</name><sys_class_name>sp_css</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>mc.admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-03-04 13:33:23</sys_created_on><sys_id>a43f528e83442210c0fb56d6feaad375</sys_id><sys_mod_count>9</sys_mod_count><sys_name>CHAM - Popular Topics</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Employee Center Core" source="sn_hr_sp">3d1da2705b021200a4656ede91f91ab6</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Employee Center Core">3d1da2705b021200a4656ede91f91ab6</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sp_css_a43f528e83442210c0fb56d6feaad375</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>a.gonzales</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-03-11 09:12:24</sys_updated_on><turn_off_scss_compilation>false</turn_off_scss_compilation></sp_css></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sp_css"><sp_css action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><css>div.v7b5142bbdbf38c10d5c45c55dc9619c5 {
  /*Carousel Parent*/
  .cham-carousel {
    margin-bottom: -65px;
    @media (max-width: 991px) {
      margin-bottom: 0px;
    }
    @media (max-width: 1172px) {
      .btn-primary {
        margin-top: 20px;
      }
    }
  }

  @media (min-width: 992px) {
    h1.carousel-title {
      overflow: hidden;
      text-overflow: ellipsis;
      display: -webkit-box;
      -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
      -webkit-line-clamp: 1;
    }
  }

  .cham-edit-button {
    top: 10px;
    right: 0;
    padding: 2px 7px 0;
    font-size: 12px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    border-color: $btn-primary-border;
    background-color: $btn-primary-bg;
    box-shadow: $btn-primary-box-shadow;
    color: $btn-primary-color;
    border-radius: 20px;
  }

  .carousel {
    background: transparent;

    /* Carousel Details */
    .carousel-inner {
      overflow: visible;
    }

    .carousel-slide {
      color: $inverse-text-color;
      padding: 40px 0 0;

      @media (max-width: 991px){
        min-height: 235px;
      }
    }

    .carousel-image-height {
      border-radius: $border-radius-large;
      box-shadow: 0px 4px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15);
      height: 300px;
    }

    /* Carousel Controls & Indicators */
    .slide-controls {
      position: absolute;
      bottom: 95px;
      z-index: 5;

      @media (max-width: 991px){
        bottom: 30px;
      }
    }
    .carousel-indicators {
      position: relative;
      bottom: unset;
      left: unset;
      margin-left: 0;
    }
    .carousel-indicators .dot {
      background: #fff;
      border-radius: 50%;
      height: 10px;
      width: 10px;
      display: inline-block;
      margin: 0px 5px 0px;
      opacity: 0.4;

      &.active {

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sp_css"><sp_css action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><css>.cham-esc-tabbed-content {
  .panel-title {
    @include h2-styles;
  }
  .item-image {
    object-fit: contain;
  }
  .item-description {
    color: $text-color !important;
    font-size: $font-size-xs !important;
    margin-bottom: 8px;
  }
  .item-additional-info {
    font-size: 12px;
    color: $text-muted;
    font-weight: $font-weight-bold;
  }
  .favorite .btn.btn-favorite:hover {
    background-color: transparent !important;
  }
  .favorite .btn.btn-favorite:focus {
    background-color: transparent !important;
  }

  /* -- Home Popular tab -- */
  .recommendations-dashboard-section {
    background-color: transparent !important;
    box-shadow: none !important;
    border: 0 !important;
    padding: 20px 0 0;
    
    > .panel-heading {
      display: none; 
    }
    .panel-body {
      padding: 0 !important;
    }
    .auto-margin-left {
      top: 13px;
      right: 12px;
    }
    .contents-section {
      grid-gap: $pad-lg;
      overflow: visible !important;
      padding: 0;
      .card-list {
        padding: 0 !important;
        .card-border {
          border: none;
        }
        .flex-item-card,
        .flex-display {
          display: flex;
          height: 100%;
          & > div:first-of-type {
            flex: 1;
          }
        }
        .content-card-container {
          height: 100% !important;
          @include content-card-panel(true);
          &:hover {
            @include content-card-hover(true);
          }
          .header-container {
            margin-top: 0;
            margin-bottom: 0;
            .card-badge {
              @include card-badge(true);
              align-items: baseline;
            }
          }
          .item-title {
            font-size: $font-size-base !important;
          }
          /* create border transparent c */
          .item-additional-info {
            font-size: 12px;
            color: $text-muted;
            font-weight: $font-weight-bold;
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }

  /* -- Home Recently Viewed tab -- */
  .cham-mini-myitems {
    .cham-recently-viewed {
      padding-top: 2rem;
      .cham-card-list {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(258px, 1fr));
        grid-gap: $pad-lg;
        .flex-display {
          display: flex;
          height: 100%;
        }
        .cham-content-card {
          @include content-card-panel(true);
          border-radius: .4rem !important;
          position: relative;
          min-height: 13.4rem;
          max-height: 18.5rem;
          height: 100%;
          &:hover {
            @include content-card-hover(true);
          }
          .card-header {
            color: $text-color;
            @include card-badge(true);
            font-size: $font-size-xs;
            padding-bottom: $pad;
            text-transform: capitalize;
            .recent-card-icon {
              font-size: $font-size-md;
            }
            .cham-esc-favorites-wrapper {
              margin-left: auto;
              display: flex;
              align-items: center;
              column-gap: 0.4rem;
              position: absolute;
              top: 0.8rem;
              right: 0.6rem;
              min-height: 3.2rem;
            }
          }
          .item-title {
            color: $text-primary;
            font-size: $font-size-base !important;
            font-weight: $font-weight-semibold;
            margin-bottom: 8px;
          }
          .item-description {
            font-size: $font-size-xs !important;
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

@media screen and (min-width: 576px) {
  .cham-mini-myitems .cham-card-list {
    grid-auto-rows: 1fr !important;
  }
}</css><name>CHAM - Recommended For You</name><sys_class_name>sp_css</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>mc.admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-03-04 13:33:22</sys_created_on><sys_id>a83f528e83442210c0fb56d6feaad36b</sys_id><sys_mod_count>7</sys_mod_count><sys_name>CHAM - Recommended For You</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Employee Center Core" source="sn_hr_sp">3d1da2705b021200a4656ede91f91ab6</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Employee Center Core">3d1da2705b021200a4656ede91f91ab6</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sp_css_a83f528e83442210c0fb56d6feaad36b</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>a.gonzales</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-03-10 14:54:52</sys_updated_on><turn_off_scss_compilation>false</turn_off_scss_compilation></sp_css></record_update>
