<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sp_css"><sp_css action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><css>/* -- Chat Button -- */
.sp-ac-root button.sp-ac-btn {
  margin-bottom: 30px;
}

/* -- General Modal Styles -- */
.modal .panel {
  border: none;
}

/* -- Avatar -- */
.avatar-container .avatar.soloAvatar .sub-avatar {
  color: $text-primary;
  background-color: rgba(221, 221, 221, 0.5);
}
/* -- FAQs variables -- */
$faq-item-padding: 15px;
$adjusted-panel-padding: calc($panel-padding - $faq-item-padding);

/* -- FAQs -- */
.cham-faq-container {
  .faq-widget.panel {
    box-shadow: $panel-box-shadow;
    padding-top: $adjusted-panel-padding;
    padding-bottom: $adjusted-panel-padding;
  }

  .cham-faq-default-v2 {
    padding-top: $faq-item-padding;
    padding-bottom: $faq-item-padding;
  }

  .cham-faq-default-v2:hover .faq-default-short-description-v2 {
    text-decoration: underline;
  }

  .faq-default-label-v2 {
    color: $brand-primary;
    font-size: 12px;
    font-weight: 700;
  }

  .faq-default-short-description-v2 {
    font-size: 16px;
    font-weight: 700;
  }

  .faq-default-img-v2 {
    width: 35px;
    height: 35px;
  }
}

/*--- Popular Items --*/
span.text-left .cham-popular-items-image-container.cham-anicard-content {
  text-align: left;
}

a.card-view div.cham-popular-items-image {
  width: 35px; 
  height: 35px; 
  background-size: cover;
}
/*
.cham-popular-item .cham-favorite-button-wrapper {
  position: absolute;
  top: $cham-card-view-panel-padding;
  right: $cham-card-view-panel-padding;
}

 -- General Bookmarks -- */
.bookmark-container {
  i {
    margin: -10px; 
    padding: 10px;
    cursor: pointer;
  }
}

/* -- Page Headings with Bookmarks -- */
.page-heading {
  .reset-icon-width {
    width: $cham-page-favorites-icon-width !important;
  }
  .cham-favorite-button {
    .btn-default {
      font-size: $cham-page-favorites-icon-width;
      padding-left: 7px;
      position: relative;
      z-index: 4;
      background-color: transparent;
      border: none;
      .fa {
        color: $inverse-text-color;
      } 
    }
    @media screen and (max-width: 480px) {
      .btn-default {
        padding-top: 0px !important;
      }
    }
    .cham-favorite-button-label {
      display: none;
    }
  }
}

/* My Bookmarks Lists */
.cham-my-items,
.cham-favorites-list {
  /* switch to x on hover */
  .bookmark-container:hover{
    .active-favorite{
      color: transparent;
      background-image: url(cham-lp-times-icon.svg);
      background-position: inherit;
      background-repeat: no-repeat;
      background-size: contain;
      background-origin: content-box;
    }

  }
}

/* -- Title -- */
@media screen and (max-width:480px) {
  .cham-title-container {
    justify-content: space-between;
  }
  .cham-title-separator {
    display: none;
  }
  .cham-title-mobile h2,h3,h4,h5,h6 {
    max-width: 70vw;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
  }
}</css><name>CHAM - Components</name><sys_class_name>sp_css</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>mc.admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-03-04 13:33:22</sys_created_on><sys_id>ac3f528e83442210c0fb56d6feaad341</sys_id><sys_mod_count>2</sys_mod_count><sys_name>CHAM - Components</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Employee Center Core" source="sn_hr_sp">3d1da2705b021200a4656ede91f91ab6</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Employee Center Core">3d1da2705b021200a4656ede91f91ab6</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sp_css_ac3f528e83442210c0fb56d6feaad341</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>a.gonzales</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-03-11 08:30:45</sys_updated_on><turn_off_scss_compilation>false</turn_off_scss_compilation></sp_css></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sp_css"><sp_css action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><css>.cham-tabs-panel {
  @include panel-secondary-styles;
}

/* -- RF Tabbed Content: My Items (Tickets, Approvals, To Dos) -- */
.cham-my-items {
  .item {
    transition: all 0.25s ease;
    padding: 1rem;
    margin: auto -1rem;
    > a {
      display: block;
      padding: 1rem;
      margin: -1rem;
    }

    &:hover {
      background-color: rgba(241, 241, 241, .6);
      border-radius: .3rem;
    }
  }

  .item-icon {
    height: 3.6rem;
    width: 3.6rem;
    display: block;
    background-size: cover;
    margin-right: 1.75rem;
  }

  .cham-my-items-title h4 {
    color: $text-primary;
    @include ellipsis;
    -webkit-line-clamp: 1;
    padding-right: .75rem;
  }

  .time-ago {
    font-weight: $font-weight-medium;
  }

  .label {
    font-size: $font-size-xs;
    color: $inverse-text-color;
    padding: 5px;
  }

  .btn {
    width: 100%;
    box-shadow: 8px 8px 16px rgba(6, 29, 48, 0.04);
    border-radius: 20px;

  }

  a p {
    color: $text-primary;
    font-size: 12px;
  }

  .cham-approval-item {
    border-top: solid 1px $border-color;
    margin-top: $m-md;
    padding-top: $panel-pad;

    &:first-child {
      border-top: none;
      margin-top: 0;
      padding-top: $pad-sm;
    }

    a .cham-label {
      color: $text-primary;
    }
  }

  .overdue-count.ng-binding.ng-scope {
    background: rgba(229, 85, 79, 0.2);
    border-radius: 5px;
    padding: 10px 10px 8px;
  }
}</css><name>CHAM - My Items Homepage</name><sys_class_name>sp_css</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>mc.admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-03-04 13:33:23</sys_created_on><sys_id>b03f528e83442210c0fb56d6feaad37f</sys_id><sys_mod_count>1</sys_mod_count><sys_name>CHAM - My Items Homepage</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Employee Center Core" source="sn_hr_sp">3d1da2705b021200a4656ede91f91ab6</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Employee Center Core">3d1da2705b021200a4656ede91f91ab6</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sp_css_b03f528e83442210c0fb56d6feaad37f</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>mc.admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-03-04 15:40:10</sys_updated_on><turn_off_scss_compilation>false</turn_off_scss_compilation></sp_css></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sp_css"><sp_css action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><css>/* -- Banner -- */
.topic-heading-text {
  color: $inverse-text-color;
}

/* -- Sub-Topics -- */
.sub-topics-widget-container {
  width:100% !important;

  .browse-elevation {
    @include panel-default-styles(true);
    padding: 25px !important;
    margin: 30px 15px 0 0 !important;


    h3 {
      font-size: $font-size-xl;
      padding-left: 0 !important;
      margin-top: 0 !important;
      margin-bottom: calc($m-lg + $m-xs);

    }
  }

  .main-container {
    padding: 0 0 0 0 !important;
    display: unset !important;

    .show-more {
      display: none;
    }

    .subtopics-container {
      padding-top: 0 !important;
      padding-left: 0 !important;
      height: unset !important;
      display: grid !important;
      /*grid-auto-rows: 1fr !important;*/
      grid-gap: 3rem !important;
      /*overflow: unset !important;*/
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(28.2rem, 1fr)) !important;

      div {
        padding-right: 0 !important;
        padding-bottom: 0 !important;

        .subtopics {
          @include topic-card;
          padding-right: $pad-md !important;
          padding-left: $pad-md !important;
          min-width: unset !important;
          height: 7.2rem !important;



          &:hover {
            @include content-card-hover;

            /*&::after {
            background-color: $text-primary;
          }*/
          }

          .item-image {
            max-width: 3.2rem !important;
            height: 3.2rem !important;
            margin-right: 1.2rem !important;
          }

          .item-name {
            padding-right: 15px;
            font-size: $font-size-base !important;
            font-weight: $font-weight-semibold !important;
            -webkit-line-clamp: 1 !important;
            flex: 1;
            &::after {
              /*@include see-all-icon;*/
              content: "\f054";
              font-family: fontAwesome;
              font-size: $font-size-small;
              color: $brand-primary;
              position: absolute;
              right: 20px;
              top: 50%;
              transform: translateY(-50%);
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}


.topic-content {
  margin-top: $m-xl;
}


/* -- Topic Content (Left column) -- */
.topic-content {
  .browse-content-container {
    margin: 0 !important;

    .feature-badge {
      padding: 2px 8px;
      border-radius: 3px;
      background: $brand-secondary;
      color: $text-primary;
      font-weight: $font-weight-semibold;
    }

    .browse-elevation {
      background: transparent !important;
      -webkit-box-shadow: none !important;
      box-shadow: none !important;
      padding: 0 !important;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      /*display: flex;*/

      .btn-loadmore {
        background: $btn-default-bg !important;
        border-color: $btn-default-border !important;
        color: $btn-default-color !important;
        padding: $pad-sm $pad-lg;
        margin-top: 0 !important;
        margin-bottom: 30px !important;

        &:hover {
          background-color: $btn-default-color !important;
          color: $text-white !important;
        }
      }

      .box-header-title.p-v-2 {
        flex: unset;
      }

      .box-header-title {
        margin: 0 !important;
        padding: 0 !important;
        flex: 1;
        align-self: flex-start;

        .view-controls {
          .fa {
            border-right: solid 1px $border-color;
            padding-right: 8px;
            color: $text-tertiary;

            &:last-child {
              padding-right: unset;
              border-right: solid 4px transparent;
            }
          }

          .fa.active {
            color: $brand-primary;
          }
        }

        h3 {
          font-size: $font-size-xl;
          display: unset !important;
          margin-top: 7px !important;
          margin-bottom: 0;
        }

        .title-item-filters {
          justify-content: unset;

          label {
            font-size: $font-size-xs;
            font-weight: $font-weight-bold;
          }

          .m-r-auto {
            margin-right: unset;
          }

          .filter-search {
            align-items: unset;

            .filter-padding {
              padding: 0;
            }
          }
        }

        .form-control {
          display: inline-block;
          background-color: $background-primary !important;
          color: #1D4D52;
        }
      }
      .box-header-title:first-child .title-item {
        display: none !important; 
      }
    }

    .grid-test-auto-wrap, .list-view-block {
      flex-basis: 100%;
      margin-top: $m-md;
      margin-bottom: $m-lg;
      grid-auto-rows: 1fr !important;
      grid-gap: 3rem !important;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(28.2rem, 1fr)) !important;

      + div {
        flex: 1;
        text-align: center;
      }
    }

    .list-view-block .flex-item-card{
      margin-bottom: $m-xl !important;
    }

    .flex-item-card {
      background-color: $background-primary;
      box-shadow: none !important;
      margin: 0 !important;
      border: 0 !important;



      .content-card-container {
        @include content-card-panel(true);

        .card-badge {
          font-weight: $font-weight-bold;

          .type-padding {
            padding-left: $pad-sm;
          }
        }

        .item-image {
          min-width: 6.4rem;
          height: unset;
          max-height: 6.4rem;
          max-width: 6.4rem;
          border-radius: 0.25rem;
          margin-right: $m-md;
        }

        .card-text-container {
          .item-title {
            font-size: $font-size-base;
          }

          .item-description {
            font-size: $font-size-sm;
            color: $text-primary;
          }

          .item-additional-info {
            color: $text-muted;
          }
        }
        &:hover {
          @include content-card-hover(true);
        }
      }
    }
  }

  /* No Results Image */
  .content-align-center img {
    content: url(cham-topic-no-results.svg);
    height: auto;
    width: 100px;
    margin-bottom: 20px;
  }
}


/* -- Topic Sidebar: Topic Announcements -- */
.topic-content .topic-side {
  .cham-carousel {
    margin: 0px 15px;

    .cham-edit-button {
      padding: 2px 7px 0;
      font-size: 12px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      border-color: $btn-primary-border;
      background-color: $btn-primary-bg;
      box-shadow: $btn-primary-box-shadow;
      color: $btn-primary-color;
      border-radius: 20px;
    }
  }
  .cham-carousel-template {
    @include panel-secondary-styles;
    padding: 20px;

    .slick-prev {
      background: url('cham-topic-chevron-left.svg');
      padding: 11px;
    }
    .slick-next {
      background: url('cham-topic-chevron-right.svg');
      padding: 11px;
    }
    .slick-dots li button:before {
      content: "\f111";
      color: #DDDDDD;
    }
    .slick-dots li.slick-active button:before {
      color: $brand-primary;
    }
    .cham-carousel__footer p {
      display: none;
    }
  }
  .cham-topic-announcement-link:hover {
    h3 {
      color: $link-color !important;
      text-decoration: underline;
    }
  }

}


/* -- Topic Sidebar: Topic Quick Links -- */
.topic-content .topic-side {
  .link-container {
    h3 {
      font-size: $font-size-xl;
      padding-left: 0 !important;
      margin-top: 0 !important;
      text-transform: capitalize;
    }

    .content-container {
      .card-title {
        font-weight: $font-weight-semibold;
        color: $text-primary;
        font-size: $font-size-md;

        &::before {
          content: url('cham-quick-link.svg');
          padding-right: 10px;
        }

        &:hover {
          color: $link-hover-color !important;
          /*text-decoration: underline;*/
        }
      }

      .icon-container .fa {
        /*font-size: $font-size-base !important;*/
        display: none;
      }
    }
  }
}


/* -- Topic Sidebar: My Applications -- */
.topic-content .topic-side {
  .app-launcher-panel {
    margin: 0 0 $m-xl $m-md !important;

    .app-launcher-body-container {
      padding-top: 0;
    }

    .link-container {
      border-top: solid 1px $border-color;
      margin: 0 calc($m-lg + $m-xs);
      padding-top: $pad;
      border-radius: unset !important;

      .view-all {
        margin-right: unset;
        padding-right: unset;

        i {
          display: none;
        }

        &::after {
          @include see-all-icon;
          margin-left: $m-xs;
          display: inline-block;
        }

        &:hover {
          color: $brand-primary;
          text-decoration: underline;
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

/*.topic-side.col-md-4 {
width: unset;
}*/


/* -- Media Queries -- */

@media only screen and (min-width : 576px) {
  .topic-content .browse-content-container .browse-elevation .box-header-title .title-item-filters .filter-search .filter-padding {
    padding: 0;
  }
}

@media only screen and (min-width : 768px) {
  .sub-topics-container .main-container .subtopics-container {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(28.2rem, 1fr)) !important;
  }
  .topic-content .browse-content-container .browse-elevation .box-header-title .title-item-filters .filter-search {
    margin-left: 0;
  }
}

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sp_css"><sp_css action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><css>.cham-approval-modal-container {
  .modal-header {
    border: none;
    padding: 25px;
    padding-bottom: 0px;

    .close {
      margin-left: auto;
      font-size: 24px;
      font-weight: 500;
    }
  }

  .modal-body {
    label {
      font-size: $font-size-xs;
      font-weight: $font-weight-bold;
    }
  }

  .modal-title:after {
    margin-top: 10px;
  }

  .modal-body {
    padding: 25px;
  }

  .panel-footer {
    padding: 25px 0px;
    margin: 0px 25px;
    background: transparent;
  }
}

.cham-approvals-record .panel,
.approval-tabs .panel {
  padding: 0; 
}

.cham-approval-details-lpv2 {
  .fa-caret-down, .fa-caret-up {
    color: $brand-primary; 
  }
  .cham-approval-ritm {
    color: $link-color;
    font-weight: 700;
    font-size: 12px;
    line-height: 14.4px;
    &:hover {
      color: $link-hover-color;
      text-decoration: underline;
    }
  }

  .approval-tabs {
    .uib-tab {
      a {
        color: #56595B;
        padding: 8px 0px;
        margin-right: 15px;
        border: 0;
        border-bottom: 3px solid transparent;
        &:hover {
          color: $text-primary;
          background: transparent; 
        }
      }

      &.active {
        a {
          color: $text-primary;
          border: none;
          border-bottom: 3px solid $brand-primary;
        }
      }
    }

    .panel {
      background: transparent;
      border: none;
      box-shadow: none;
    }

    .panel-body {
      padding: 0px;
    }

    .padder-b-none {
      padding-top: 0px;
    }

    .sp-attachments-header {
      display: none;
    }

    .sp-attachment-add {
      padding: 0px;
      color: $brand-primary;
    }

    .sp-drop-area {
      background: $background-primary;
      border: 1px dashed #1D4D52 !important;
      border-radius: $border-radius-large;
    }

    .ticket_conversation {
      .panel-heading {
        display: none;
      }

      .panel-body {
        padding: 25px 0px;
      }

      .timeline-panel {
        background: $background-primary;
      }

      .sub-avatar {
        background-color: #00ACCE;
      }

      .timeline-badge {
        text-transform: uppercase;
        font-weight: $font-weight-bold;

        &.success {
          background-color: #005776;
        }
      }
    }
  }

  .cham-approval-item-details {
    background: $background-primary;
    padding: 25px;
    border-radius: 8px;
    border: $border-default;
  }

  .approval-item-title {
    font-size: $font-size-xl;
    margin-bottom: 15px;
  }

  .approvals-details-header-info {
    display: flex;
    flex-flow: column;
    width: fit-content;

    span {
      font-size: $font-size-xs;
      font-weight: $font-weight-bold;
    }

    .cham-approval-badge {
      background-color: $brand-primary;
      color: $text-white;
      width: fit-content;
      padding: 2px 10px;
      border-radius: 3px;
      margin-top: 6px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }
  }

  .cham-approval-btns {
    border-top: 1px solid $border-tertiary;
    border-bottom: 1px solid $border-tertiary;
    margin-top: 25px;
    padding-top: 25px;
    padding-bottom: 25px;

    .btn {
      width: 100%;
    }
  }

  .cham-approvals-record {
    .panel.panel-default {
      margin-top: 25px;
      margin-bottom: 0px;
      border: none;
    }

    .panel-body {
      padding: 0px;
    }

    .cham-approval-field {
      span {
        color: $text-primary;
      }
    }

    .list-group-item {
      padding: 10px 0px;
    }

    .label-as-badge {
      width: fit-content;
      padding: 2px 10px;
      border-radius: 3px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .cham-header-text {
      font-size: $font-size-xs;
      font-weight: $font-weight-bold;
    }

    .cham-approval-options {
      .cham-options-title {
        font-weight: $font-weight-semibold;
      }

      .fa {
        margin-left: 15px;
      }
    }

    .approval-item-variables {
      margin-top: 10px;
    }

    .cham-approval-variable-container {
      margin-top: 15px;
    }

    .panel-footer {
      padding: 25px 0px 0px 0px;
      background-color: transparent;
    }
  }

  .sub-avatar {
    cursor: default; 
  }
}</css><name>CHAM - Approval Detail Page</name><sys_class_name>sp_css</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>mc.admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-03-04 13:33:24</sys_created_on><sys_id>c53f528e83442210c0fb56d6feaad3e3</sys_id><sys_mod_count>1</sys_mod_count><sys_name>CHAM - Approval Detail Page</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Employee Center Core" source="sn_hr_sp">3d1da2705b021200a4656ede91f91ab6</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Employee Center Core">3d1da2705b021200a4656ede91f91ab6</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sp_css_c53f528e83442210c0fb56d6feaad3e3</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>mc.admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-03-04 16:00:15</sys_updated_on><turn_off_scss_compilation>false</turn_off_scss_compilation></sp_css></record_update>

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="DELETE"><access>public</access><active>true</active><api_name>sn_hr_sp.ChameleonAPI</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description/><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>ChameleonAPI</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[var ChameleonAPI = Class.create();
ChameleonAPI.prototype = Object.extendsObject(x_nero_rocketfuel.NewRocketAPI, {
	
	getItemsCount: function(options) {
		var count = 0;
		var queries = NRConstants.MY_ITEMS_QUERIES;
		for (var e in queries) {
			var ga = new GlideAggregate(e);
			ga.addEncodedQuery(queries[e]);
			ga.addQuery('active', true);
			ga.addAggregate('COUNT');
			ga.query();
			
			if (ga.next())
				count+= Number(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'));
		}
		
		return count;
	},
	
	//Gets Topic Page data to display a custom heading for Topic Pages
	getTopicPageData: function(options){
		if (!options)
			options = {};

		try {
			var results = [];
			var topicID = $sp.getParameter('topic_id');

			var z = new GlideRecord('topic');
			z.get(topicID);

			var a = {};
			a.title = z.getDisplayValue('name');
			a.description = z.getDisplayValue('description');
			a.icon = z.getDisplayValue('icon');
			a.banner_image = z.getDisplayValue('banner_image');
			if(a.banner_image == ""){
				a.banner_image = this.getBannerImage(topicID);
			}

			results.push(a);

			return results;

		} catch (e) {
			gs.error('getTopicPageData failed: ' + e.message);
			return [];
		}

	},

	//Returns image string - called from getTopicPageData
	getBannerImage: function(sysId){
		var topic = new GlideRecord("topic");
		if(topic.get(sysId)){
			var image = topic.getDisplayValue('banner_image');
			var parent = topic.getValue('parent_topic');

			if(image != ""){
				return image;
			}else if(parent != ""){
				return this.getBannerImage(parent);
			}else{
				return "bhsf-topic-default.jpg";
			}
		}else{
			return "bhsf-topic-default.jpg";
		}
	},

	// Returns array of requests and incidents
	getItems: function(options) {
		if (!options) options = {};

		var results = this._getSortedResults([
			this._getIncidents(options),
			this._getRequests(options),
			this._getHRCases(options),
			this._getChangeRequests(options),
			this._getProblems(options)
			//this._getFacilitiesRequests(options)
		]);

		if (options.limit)
			results = results.slice(0, options.limit);

		return results;
	},

	_getChangeRequests: function(options) {
		var results = [];
		var z = new GlideRecord('change_request');
		if (options.change_query) {
			z.addEncodedQuery(options.change_query);
		} else {
			z.addEncodedQuery(NRConstants.MY_ITEMS_QUERIES.change_request);
		}
		if (options.active_only)
			z.addActiveQuery();
		if (options.filters && options.filters['active'])
			z.addEncodedQuery(this._getActiveQuery(options));
		if (options.filters && options.filters['date_updated_query'])
			z.addEncodedQuery(options.filters['date_updated_query'].value);
		z.orderByDesc('sys_updated_on');
		if (options.limit)
			z.setLimit(options.limit);
		z.query();
		while (z.next()) {
			var a = {};
			a.columns = [
				{ "name": "short_description", "label": "Description", "class": "col-sm-6 col-xs-12" },
				{ "name": "u_approval_stage_dv", "label": "Approval Stage", "class": "col-sm-3 col-xs-6" },
				{ "name": "end_date_dv", "label": "End Date", "class": "col-sm-3 col-xs-6" }
			];

			this._setPrimaryFields(a, z);
			a.u_approval_stage_dv = z.getDisplayValue('u_approval_stage');
			a.end_date = z.getValue('end_date');
			a.end_date_dv = z.getDisplayValue('end_date');
			a.requested_for = z.getValue('requested_for');
			a.requested_for_dv = z.getDisplayValue('requested_for');
			a.rel_opened_by = (a.opened_by == this.user_id);
			a.rel_opened_for = (a.requested_for == this.user_id);
			a.rel_watching = (a.watch_list.indexOf(this.user_id) !== -1);
			a.__page = this.ticket_page;
			a.type = 'change';
			a.type_dv = 'Change';
			a.href = "?id=" + a.__page + "&table=" + a.__table + "&sys_id=" + a.sys_id;

			results.push(a);
		}

		return results;
	},

	_getProblems: function(options) {
		var results = [];
		var z = new GlideRecord('problem');
		if (options.problem_query) {
			z.addEncodedQuery(options.problem_query);
		} else {
			z.addEncodedQuery(NRConstants.MY_ITEMS_QUERIES.problem);
		}
		if (options.active_only)
			z.addActiveQuery();
		if (options.filters && options.filters['active'])
			z.addEncodedQuery(this._getActiveQuery(options));
		if (options.filters && options.filters['date_updated_query'])
			z.addEncodedQuery(options.filters['date_updated_query'].value);
		z.orderByDesc('sys_updated_on');
		if (options.limit)
			z.setLimit(options.limit);
		z.query();
		while (z.next()) {
			var a = {};
			a.columns = [
				{ "name": "short_description", "label": "Description", "class": "col-sm-6 col-xs-12" },
				{ "name": "u_requested_by_dv", "label": "Requested By", "class": "col-sm-6 col-xs-12" }
			];

			this._setPrimaryFields(a, z);
			a.requested_by = z.getValue('u_requested_by');
			a.requested_by_dv = z.getDisplayValue('u_requested_by');
			a.rel_opened_by = (a.opened_by == this.user_id);
			a.rel_opened_for = (a.requested_for == this.user_id);
			a.rel_watching = (a.watch_list.indexOf(this.user_id) !== -1);
			a.__page = this.ticket_page;
			a.type = 'problem';
			a.type_dv = 'Problem';
			a.href = "?id=" + a.__page + "&table=" + a.__table + "&sys_id=" + a.sys_id;

			results.push(a);
		}

		return results;
	},

	_getRequests: function(options) {
		var results = [];
		var z = new GlideRecord('sc_req_item');
		if (options.request_query)
			z.addEncodedQuery(options.request_query);
		else {
			z.addEncodedQuery(NRConstants.MY_ITEMS_QUERIES.sc_req_item);
		}
		if (options.active_only)
			z.addActiveQuery();
		if (options.filters && options.filters['active'])
			z.addEncodedQuery(this._getActiveQuery(options));
		if (options.filters && options.filters['date_updated_query'])
			z.addEncodedQuery(options.filters['date_updated_query'].value);
		z.orderByDesc('sys_updated_on');
		if (options.limit)
			z.setLimit(options.limit);
		z.query();
		while (z.next()) {

			var a = {};
			a.columns = [
				{ "name": "short_description", "label": "Description", "class": "col-sm-6 col-xs-12" },
				{ "name": "stage_dv", "label": "Stage", "class": "col-sm-3 col-xs-6" },
				{ "name": "delivery_date_dv", "label": "Delivery Date", "class": "col-sm-3 col-xs-6" }
			];

			this._setPrimaryFields(a, z);
			a.stage = z.getValue('stage');
			a.stage_dv = z.getDisplayValue('stage');
			a.delivery_date = z.getValue('due_date');
			a.delivery_date_dv = z.getDisplayValue('due_date');
			a.requested_for = z.getValue('requested_for');
			a.requested_for_dv = z.getDisplayValue('requested_for');
			a.rel_opened_by = (a.opened_by == this.user_id);
			a.rel_opened_for = (a.requested_for == this.user_id);
			a.rel_watching = (a.watch_list.indexOf(this.user_id) !== -1);
			a.__page = this.ticket_page;
			a.type = 'request';
			a.type_dv = 'Request';
			a.href = "?id=" + a.__page + "&table=" + a.__table + "&sys_id=" + a.sys_id;

			if (z.getValue("cat_item")) {
				var catItemGR = z.cat_item.getRefRecord();
				a.picture = catItemGR.getDisplayValue('picture');
			}

			results.push(a);
		}
		return results;
	},

	getTodos: function(options) {
		var limit = options && options.limit ? options.limit : 3;
		var todoUtil = new sn_hr_sp.todoPageUtils();
		var tds = todoUtil.getMyTodos(limit, null);
		return tds.recordsToShow.open || [];
	},

	_getHRCases: function(options) {
		var results = [];
		var z = new GlideRecord('sn_hr_core_case');
		if (!z.isValid())
			return results;

		if (options.hr_case_query)
			z.addEncodedQuery(options.hr_case_query);
		else {
			z.addEncodedQuery(NRConstants.MY_ITEMS_QUERIES.sn_hr_core_case);
		}

		if (options.active_only)
			z.addActiveQuery();
		if (options.filters && options.filters['date_updated_query'])
			z.addEncodedQuery(options.filters['date_updated_query'].value);
		z.orderByDesc('sys_updated_on');
		if (options.limit)
			z.setLimit(options.limit);
		z.query();
		
		while (z.next()) {
			var a = {};
			a.columns = [
				{"name":"short_description", "label": "Description", "class": "col-md-6"},
				{"name":"assignment_group", "label": "Assignment Group", "class": "col-md-3"},
				{"name":"priority", "label": "Priority", "class": "col-md-3"}
			];
			this._setPrimaryFields(a, z);
			a.picture = "nr-hr-icon.png";
			a.assignment_group = z.getDisplayValue('assignment_group');
			//a.__page = this.ticket_page;
			a.__page = 'hrm_ticket_page';
			a.type = 'hr_case';
			a.type_dv = 'HR Case';
			a.href = "?id=" + a.__page + "&table=" + a.__table + "&sys_id=" + a.sys_id;
			results.push(a);
		}
		return results;
	},

	_getFacilitiesRequests: function(options) {
		var results = [];
		var z = new GlideRecord('facilities_request');
		if (!z.isValid())
			return results;
		z.addEncodedQuery("opened_byDYNAMIC90d1921e5f510100a9ad2572f2b477fe^ORopened_forDYNAMIC90d1921e5f510100a9ad2572f2b477fe");
		if (options.active_only)
			z.addActiveQuery();
		if (options.filters && options.filters['date_updated_query'])
			z.addEncodedQuery(options.filters['date_updated_query'].value);
		z.orderByDesc('sys_updated_on');
		if (options.limit)
			z.setLimit(options.limit);
		z.query();
		while (z.next()) {
			var a = {};
			a.columns = [
				{"name":"short_description", "label": "Description", "class": "col-md-6"},
				{"name":"category", "label": "Category", "class": "col-md-3"},
				{"name":"priority", "label": "Priority", "class": "col-md-3"}
			];
			this._setPrimaryFields(a, z);
			a.picture = "nr-fac-icon.png";
			a.category = z.getDisplayValue('category');
			a.__page = this.ticket_page;
			a.type = 'facilities';
			a.type_dv = 'Facilities Request';
			a.href = "?id=" + a.__page + "&table=" + a.__table + "&sys_id=" + a.sys_id;
			results.push(a);
		}
		return results;
	},

	getECFavoritesCount: function(portalId){
		var types = this.getFavCategories();
		var results = {};
		results.all = {"count": 0,
					   "name": "all"};
		for(var i=0; i<types.length; i++){
			var a = {};
			var fav = new GlideAggregate('sn_ex_sp_st_favorite');
			fav.addQuery("portal", portalId);
			fav.addQuery("category", types[i].sys_id);
			fav.addAggregate('COUNT');
			fav.query();
			var count = 0;
			a.name = types[i].type;
			a.sys_id = types[i].sys_id;

			if(fav.next()){
				count = fav.getAggregate('COUNT');
			}
			a.count = parseInt(count);
			results.all.count += a.count;
			results[a.name] = a;
		}
		return results;
	},

	getFavCategories: function(options){
		var results = [];
		var type = new GlideRecord('sn_ex_sp_favorite_content_type');
		type.addQuery("active", true);
		type.query();

		while(type.next()){
			var a = {};
			a.type = type.getDisplayValue('name');
			a.sys_id = type.getUniqueValue();
			results.push(a);
		}

		return results;

	},

	// Will fetch OOB favorites for the current user and portal.
	getECFavorites: function (options) {
		var favoritesGr = new GlideRecord('sn_ex_sp_st_favorite');
		favoritesGr.addQuery("portal", options.portal);		

		if (options.limit_num)
			options.limit = options.limit_num;
		// 		if (options.limit)
		// 			favoritesGr.setLimit(options.limit);
		if (options.category) 
			favoritesGr.addQuery("category", options.category);
		favoritesGr.query();

		var favorites = [];

		while (favoritesGr.next() && favorites.length < options.limit) {

			var type = favoritesGr.getDisplayValue("category");
			var secondaryVal = favoritesGr.getValue("secondary_display");

			var favorite = {
				"sysId": favoritesGr.getUniqueValue() || '',
				"tableName": favoritesGr.getValue("table_name") || '',
				"iconClass": favoritesGr.getValue("badge_icon") ? 'fa-' + favoritesGr.getValue("badge_icon") : '',
				"type": type || '',
				"primaryField": favoritesGr.getDisplayValue("primary_display") || '',
				"image": favoritesGr.getDisplayValue("fav_image") || '',
				"secondaryField": favoritesGr.getValue("secondary_display") || '',
				"href": favoritesGr.getValue("url") || '',
				"target": favoritesGr.getValue("target") || '',
				"end": favoritesGr.getValue("end") || ''
			};

			//limit character length on secondary field for kb
			if (type == "Article" && secondaryVal) {
				if(secondaryVal.length > 112)
				favorite.secondaryField = secondaryVal.trim().substring(0, 112) + "...";
			} else {
				favorite.secondaryField = favoritesGr.getValue("secondary_display") || '';
			}

			favorites.push(favorite);

		}

		return favorites;

	},

	//Retrieves recently viewed Catalog Items and Knowledge Articles
	//Returns data as an array
	getRecentItems: function(options) {
		if (!options) 
			var options = {};

		try {
			var limit = options.limit_num ? options.limit_num : 8;
			var results = [];
			var ids = [];

			var logGR = new GlideRecord('sp_log');
			logGR.addEncodedQuery('type=KB Article View^ORtype=Cat Item View^userDYNAMIC90d1921e5f510100a9ad2572f2b477fe^sys_created_onRELATIVEGT@month@ago@6');

			logGR.orderByDesc('sys_created_on');
			logGR.query();

			while (logGR.next()) {
				if (results.length === limit)
					break;

				var id = logGR.getValue('id');
				if (this.isAlreadyAdded(id, ids))
					continue;

				var params = {
					sys_id: id,
					type: logGR.getDisplayValue('type'),
					table: logGR.getValue('table')
				};

				if (this.isNotActive(params))
					continue;

				var type = logGR.getDisplayValue('type');

				if(type == "Cat Item View"){
					var item = this.getItemDataSC(params);
				}else if(type == "KB Article View"){
					var item = this.getItemDataKB(params);
				}else{
					continue;
				}

				results.push(item);
				ids.push(id);
			}
			return results;
		} catch (e) {
			gs.error('ChameleonAPI - getRecentItems failed: ' + e.message);
			return [];
		}
	},

	//Called from getRecentItems - checks if the item is active
	//Returns boolean value
	isNotActive: function(item){
		var grActive = new GlideRecord(item.table);
		grActive.get(item.sys_id);

		var active = grActive.getDisplayValue('active');
		return active === false ? true : false;
	},

	//Called from getRecentItems - checks if the item is already in the list
	//Returns boolean value
	isAlreadyAdded: function(item, array) {
		return array.indexOf(item) === -1 ? false : true;
	},

	//Called from getRecentItems - Returns values for Catalog Items
	//Returns as object
	getItemDataSC: function(options) {
		var sc_item = {};
		var scGR = new GlideRecord(options.table);
		scGR.get(options.sys_id);

		sc_item.sys_id = options.sys_id;
		sc_item.type = 'Request';
		sc_item.iconClass = "fa-pencil-square-o";
		sc_item.table = options.table;
		if(options.table == "sc_cat_item_guide")
			sc_item.url = '?id=sc_cat_item_guide&sys_id=' + sc_item.sys_id;
		if(options.table != "sc_cat_item_guide")
			sc_item.url = '?id=sc_cat_item&sys_id=' + sc_item.sys_id;
		sc_item.title = scGR.getDisplayValue('name');
		sc_item.description = scGR.getDisplayValue('short_description');
		sc_item.delivery_time = scGR.getDisplayValue('delivery_time');
		sc_item.show_delivery_type = scGR.getValue('u_delivery_type') == 'auto' ? true : false;
		sc_item.topic = scGR.getDisplayValue("taxonomy_topic");
		return sc_item;
	},

	//Called from getRecentItems - Returns values for Knowledge Articles
	//Returns as object
	getItemDataKB: function(options) {
		var kb_item = {};
		var kbGR = new GlideRecord(options.table);
		kbGR.get(options.sys_id);

		kb_item.sys_id = options.sys_id;
		kb_item.type = 'Article';
		kb_item.iconClass = "fa-file-text-o";
		kb_item.table = options.table;
		kb_item.url = '?id=kb_article&sys_id=' + kb_item.sys_id;
		kb_item.title = kbGR.getDisplayValue('short_description');
		var description = kbGR.getDisplayValue('text');
		kb_item.description = description.replace(/<\/?[^>]+(>|$)/g, "");
		kb_item.topic = kbGR.getDisplayValue("taxonomy_topic");

		return kb_item;
	},
	
	getApprovals: function(options) {	
		var esigRequiredMap = options.check_esignature ? this._getEsigs() : {};

		var results = [];

		var z = new GlideRecord('sysapproval_approver');

		var myApprovals = global.getMyApprovals();
		z.addQuery("approver", myApprovals);
		if (options.encoded_query) {
			z.addEncodedQuery(options.encoded_query);
		}
		if (options.filters && options.filters['state']) {
			var query = this._getStateQuery(options);

			if (query) {
				z.addEncodedQuery(query);
			}
		}
		if (options.filters && options.filters['date_updated_query']) {
			z.addEncodedQuery(options.filters['date_updated_query'].value);
		}
		if (options.limit) {
			z.setLimit(options.limit);
		}
		z.orderBy("sys_created_on");

		z.query();
		while (z.next()) {

			var a = {};
			a.columns = [
				{ "name": "record_opened_by", "label": "Opened By", "class": "col-md-2" },
				{ "name": "record_requested_for", "label": "Requested For", "class": "col-md-2" },
				{ "name": "record_opened_date", "label": "Open Date", "class": "col-md-2" },
				{ "name": "record_short_description", "label": "Short Description", "class": "col-md-6"}
			];
			this._setPrimaryFields(a, z);

			a.type = 'approval';
			a.type_dv = 'Approval';
			a.href = "?id=" + this.approval_page + "&table=sysapproval_approver&sys_id=" + a.sys_id;
			a.approver = z.getValue('approver');
			a.approver_dv = z.getDisplayValue('approver');
			a.delagated_approval = z.getValue("approver") != gs.getUserID();

			var recordGR = this.getRecordBeingApproved(z);
			if (!recordGR.isValidRecord())
				continue;

			a.record_opened_date = recordGR.getDisplayValue('sys_created_on').split(' ')[0];
			a.record_number = recordGR.getDisplayValue();
			a.record_sys_id = recordGR.getUniqueValue();
			a.record_table = recordGR.getTableName();
			a.record_table_label = recordGR.getLabel();
			a.record_short_description = recordGR.getDisplayValue("short_description");
			a.e_sig_required = esigRequiredMap[a.record_table];

			if (recordGR.isValidField("opened_by") && !recordGR.opened_by.nil())
				a.record_opened_by = recordGR.opened_by.getDisplayValue();

			if (recordGR.isValidField("requested_by") && !recordGR.requested_by.nil())
				a.record_opened_by = recordGR.requested_by.getDisplayValue();
			
			if (recordGR.isValidField("requested_for") && !recordGR.requested_for.nil())
				a.record_requested_for = recordGR.requested_for.getDisplayValue();
			else if (recordGR.isValidField("u_requested_for") && !recordGR.u_requested_for.nil())
				a.record_requested_for = recordGR.u_requested_for.getDisplayValue();
			
			if (a.record_table == "sc_request") {
				var itemsGR = new GlideRecord("sc_req_item");
				itemsGR.addQuery("request", a.record_sys_id);
				itemsGR.query();
				if (itemsGR.getRowCount() > 1) {
					a.record_short_description = itemsGR.getRowCount() + " " + gs.getMessage("requested items");
				} else {
					itemsGR.next();
					a.record_short_description = itemsGR.short_description.toString();
				}
			}

			results.push(a);

		}

		return this._getSortedResults([results]);

	},

	type: 'ChameleonAPI'
});]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>a.gonzales</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-03-07 07:43:15</sys_created_on><sys_id>ef6aa80f834c2610c0fb56d6feaad380</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>ChameleonAPI</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Employee Center Core" source="sn_hr_sp">3d1da2705b021200a4656ede91f91ab6</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Employee Center Core">3d1da2705b021200a4656ede91f91ab6</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_ef6aa80f834c2610c0fb56d6feaad380</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>a.gonzales</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-03-07 07:43:15</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include><sys_es_latest_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><id>ef6aa80f834c2610c0fb56d6feaad380</id><sys_created_by>a.gonzales</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-03-07 07:43:14</sys_created_on><sys_id>bcdba80f834c2610c0fb56d6feaad376</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>a.gonzales</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-03-07 07:43:14</sys_updated_on><table>sys_script_include</table><use_es_latest>true</use_es_latest></sys_es_latest_script></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sp_header_footer"><sp_header_footer action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><category>custom</category><client_script><![CDATA[function escHeaderController($rootScope, $scope, $window, spUtil, $location, $uibModal, cabrillo, $timeout, i18n, spContextManager, snRecordWatcher) {
	var c = this;

	spUtil.get('cham-cham-ec-sidebar-pane').then(function(res) {
		c.sideBarWidget = res;
	});
	spUtil.get('sophie-button').then(function(res) {
		c.sophieButton = res;
	});
	spUtil.get('cham-profile-with-drop-down', {
		profile_url: c.data.link,
		show_xs_avatar: false
	}).then(function(res) {
		c.avatarDropDown = res;
	});

	$scope.counts = c.data.counts;
	$rootScope.approvals_count = c.data.counts.approvals;
	$rootScope.tickets_count = c.data.counts.tickets;
	$rootScope.todos_count = c.data.todoCount;
	c.todos_count = c.data.todoCount;
	for(var e in c.data.counts.favorites){
		$rootScope["favorites_"+e] = c.data.counts.favorites[e].count;
	}
	$rootScope.$broadcast('cham.updateCounts', $scope.counts);

	c.showSearch = false;

	c.toggleDrawer = function (event_name) {
		$rootScope.$broadcast(event_name);
	};

	$scope.avatarProfile = {
		userID: $scope.user.sys_id,
		name: $scope.user.name,
		initials: $window.NOW.user_initials
	};

	if ($window.NOW.user_avatar) {
		$scope.avatarProfile.userImage = $window.NOW.user_avatar;
	}

	$scope.$on("$sp.service_catalog.cart.count", function ($evt, count) {
		$scope.cartItemCount = count;
		$rootScope.cartCount = count;
	});

	// Events fired from/to $rootScope for responsive mobile view.
	c.SHOW_MOBILE_MEGA_MENU = 'showMobileMegaMenu';
	c.SHOW_MOBILE_MENU_ON_DESKTOP = 'showMobileMenuOnDesktop';
	c.TOGGLE_MOBILE_MENU_VISIBILITY = 'toggleMobileMenuVisibility';
	c.INITIAL_TIMEOUT = 500;
	$rootScope.isHeaderInMobileView = false;

	c.evaluateSearchWidgetVisibility = function () {
		if (c.data.hideSearchOnHomepage) {
			var currentUrl = $location.url();
			var params = $location.search();

			// hide on home page
			if ((params && params.id && params.id === c.data.dashboardSuffix) || (params && !params.id && currentUrl.includes(c.data.portalSuffix))) {
				$scope.showSearchBar = false;
				$scope.showViewAsHeader = false;
			} else
				$scope.showSearchBar = true;
			// show ViewAs header on viewAsPages  
			if ((params && params.id && currentUrl.includes("ec_view_as")))
				$scope.showViewAsHeader = true;
		}
	};

	function addDeferScript(src,callback) {
		var s = document.createElement('script');
		s.setAttribute('src',src);
		s.setAttribute('defer', true);
		s.onload=callback;
		document.body.appendChild(s);
	}

	if(c.data.isPersonalizedAnswer) {
		addDeferScript("/scripts/app-ex-integrated-answers-components/app-ex-integrated-answers-components.min.js");
	}

	$scope.$on('sp_loading_indicator', function(e, value) {
		$scope.loadingIndicator = value;
		// Evaluate search bar visibility once the page has completed loading.
		if(!value)
			c.evaluateSearchWidgetVisibility();
	});

	$scope.showSearchBar = true;
	$scope.userID = $scope.user.sys_id;
	$scope.todosPopupId = c.data.isMobile ? '#popup_todos_mobile' : '';
	$scope.casesPopupId = c.data.isMobile ? '#popup_cases_mobile' : '';
	$scope.popupType = c.data.isMobile ? 'collapse' : 'dropdown';
	$scope.expanded = false;
	$scope.isMobileViewOnDesktopExpanded = false;
	$scope.loadingIndicator = $rootScope.loadingIndicator;
	$scope.cartItemCount = 0;

	/* Below 2 scope variables (showMobileMenuOnDesktop, showMobileMegaMenu) have counterparts in EC Navigation widget also.
     So whenever we set these variables, make sure to emit an event on rootScope to update them in the former widget as well. */

	// Determines whether to show mobile view on desktop due to oveflow of items in sub navigation bar of header.
	$scope.showMobileMenuOnDesktop = false;
	// Used to hide global navigation tools on mobile while showing mega menu topics in right panel.
	$scope.showMobileMegaMenu = false;

	c.todoCountTranslation = i18n.format(c.data.todoCountLabel, String(c.data.todoCount));
	c.toursTranslation = "${Tours}";

	c.MOBILE_DEVICE_SCREEN_WIDTH = 814; //767;
	$scope.mobileDevice = ($window.innerWidth <= c.MOBILE_DEVICE_SCREEN_WIDTH || $scope.mobileDevice || c.data.isMobile );

	if (cabrillo.isNative())
		$scope.isViewNative = true;

	// initially for first load, if the calculated width is in mobile view then update
	// isHeaderInMobileView so that Employee Center Navigation widget also goes into mobile mode
	$scope.$watch("mobileDevice", function() {
		$rootScope.isHeaderInMobileView = $scope.mobileDevice;
		$rootScope.$broadcast('isHeaderInMobileView', $scope.mobileDevice);
	}); 

	$scope.$watch('isMobileViewOnDesktopExpanded', function (oldVal, newVal) {
		if (oldVal && !newVal) {
			$timeout(c.registerClickEventHanlderOnCart, c.INITIAL_TIMEOUT);
		}
	});

	c.registerClickEventHanlderOnCart = function  () {
		$('a#cart-dropdown').on('click', function (event) {
			if ($window.innerWidth > c.MOBILE_DEVICE_SCREEN_WIDTH && $scope.isMobileViewOnDesktopExpanded) {
				$location.search({id: 'sc_cart'});
				$scope.toggleMobileMenuVisibility();
			}
		});
	}

	$scope.$on("$locationChangeSuccess", function (event, data) {
		if (c.data.isMobile) {
			if ($('div#popup_todos_mobile').is(":visible"))
				$('li > a#todos_popup').click();
			else if ($('div#popup_cases_mobile').is(":visible"))
				$('li > a#cases_popup').click();
		} else {
			$('li.open > a#cases_popup').click();
			$('li.open > a#todos_popup').click();
		}
	});

	c.processWatchers = function (watcher) {
		setTimeout($scope.reloadHeader, 20);
	};

	/* Record Watchers */
	if (c.data.recordWatchers && c.data.recordWatchers.length > 0) {
		angular.forEach(c.data.recordWatchers, function (watcher) {
			spUtil.recordWatch($scope, watcher.table, watcher.filter, c.processWatchers);
		});
	}

	$scope.reloadHeader = function (actionName) {
		c.data.action = actionName || c.data.ACTION_TODO_COUNT;
		if (c.data.action == c.data.ACTION_TODO_COUNT)
			c.server.get({
				action: c.data.action
			}).then(function (resp) {
				c.data.todoCount = resp.data.todoCount;
				c.todos_count = resp.data.todos_count;
				c.todoCountTranslation = i18n.format(c.data.todoCountLabel, String(c.data.todoCount));
			});
		else
			c.server.update();
	};

	$scope.openLogin = function () {
		$scope.modalInstance = $uibModal.open({
			templateUrl: 'modalLogin',
			scope: $scope
		});
	};

	$rootScope.$on("update.searchpage", function (e, searchPage) {
		$scope.searchPage = searchPage;
	});

	$rootScope.$on('sp.avatar_changed', function () {
		$scope.userID = '';
		$timeout(function () {
			$scope.userID = $scope.user.sys_id;
		});
	});

	$rootScope.$on(c.SHOW_MOBILE_MENU_ON_DESKTOP, function (event, showMobileMenuOnDesktop) {
		if (!(showMobileMenuOnDesktop || $scope.mobileDevice) && $scope.showMobileMenuOnDesktop) {
			$scope.isMobileViewOnDesktopExpanded = false;
		}
		$scope.showMobileMenuOnDesktop = showMobileMenuOnDesktop || $scope.mobileDevice;
	});

	$rootScope.$on(c.SHOW_MOBILE_MEGA_MENU, function (event, showMobileMegaMenu) {
		$scope.showMobileMegaMenu = showMobileMegaMenu;
	});

	$timeout(function() {
		$scope.calulatedNavbarWidth();
		resizeObserverForTopNav();
	},c.INITIAL_TIMEOUT);

	function resizeObserverForTopNav() {
		var headerSearch = document.querySelector(".header-search");
		var navbarBrand = document.querySelector(".navbar-brand-logo > img");
		var navbarRight = document.querySelector(".navbar-right > div"); 
		//fix for firefox/chrome on cmd + text zoom increase
		if(window.ResizeObserver) {
			var resizeObserver = new ResizeObserver(function(entries) {
				if(entries) {
					$scope.calulatedNavbarWidth();
				}
			});

			if(headerSearch)
				resizeObserver.observe(headerSearch);

			if(navbarBrand)
				resizeObserver.observe(navbarBrand);

			if(navbarRight)
				resizeObserver.observe(navbarRight);
		}
	}

	$scope.toggleMobileMenuVisibility = function (event) {
		if (event) {
			event.stopPropagation();
		}
		$scope.isMobileViewOnDesktopExpanded = !$scope.isMobileViewOnDesktopExpanded;
		$scope.expanded = false;
		$scope.showMobileMegaMenu = false;
		$rootScope.$emit(c.SHOW_MOBILE_MEGA_MENU, false);
	};

	$rootScope.$on(c.TOGGLE_MOBILE_MENU_VISIBILITY, function() {
		$scope.toggleMobileMenuVisibility();
	});

	$scope.handleMobileViewClick = function (event) {
		if ($(event.target).text() !== c.toursTranslation) {
			event.stopPropagation();
		}
	};

	$scope.isHomepage = function () {
		if (!$scope.page.id)
			return true;

		if ($scope.page.id == $scope.portal.homepage_dv)
			return true;

		return false;
	};

	c.evaluateSearchWidgetVisibility();

	//remove nested ul to fix screen reader issue
	$timeout(function () {
		var cartToursWrapper = $('.navbar-header .v' + scope.data.top.menu.sys_id);

		if (!cartToursWrapper.length)
			return;

		var menu = cartToursWrapper.parent().parent();
		var menuItems = cartToursWrapper.children();
		menu.append(menuItems);
		cartToursWrapper.parent().remove();
	}, 1000);

	$scope.$on('sn_lp.giveFeedbackModalOpen', function() {
		$scope.toggleMobileMenuVisibility();
	});


	// Start Chameleon Enhancements
	c.toggleNav = function () {
		$rootScope.$broadcast('toggleSidebar');
	};

	spUtil.recordWatch($scope, "incident", "active=true^caller_id=javascript:gs.getUserID()", function () {
		updateCounts();
	});
	spUtil.recordWatch($scope, "sc_request", "active=true^requested_for=javascript:gs.getUserID()", function () {
		updateCounts();
	});
	spUtil.recordWatch($scope, "change_request", "active=true^assigned_to=javascript:gs.getUserID()^ORopened_by=javascript:gs.getUserID()", function () {
		updateCounts();
	});
	spUtil.recordWatch($scope, "sysapproval_approver", "approver=javascript:global.getMyApprovals()", function () {
		updateCounts();
	});
	spUtil.recordWatch($scope, "sp_favorite", "user=javascript:gs.getUserID()", function () {
		updateCounts();
	});

	c.data.action = 'getWidgets';
	$timeout(serverUpdate);

	function serverUpdate() {
		c.server.update().then(function (response) {
			updateResponse(response);
		});
	}

	function updateCounts() {
		c.data.action = 'getCounts';
		c.server.update().then(function (res) {
			c.data.action = undefined;
			broadcastCounts(res);
		});
	}

	function broadcastCounts(response) {
		$rootScope.approvals_count = response.counts.approvals;
		$rootScope.tickets_count = response.counts.tickets;
		$rootScope.todos_count = response.todoCount;

		for(var e in response.counts.favorites){
			$rootScope["favorites_"+e] = response.counts.favorites[e].count;
		}

		$scope.counts = response.counts;
		$rootScope.$broadcast('cham.updateCounts', $scope.counts);
	}

	function updateResponse(response) {
		// Calls for Drawer Widgets
		c.data.action = undefined;
		if (response.myBookmarksWidget) {
			c.myBookmarksWidget = response.myBookmarksWidget;
		}
		if (response.myItemsWidget) {
			c.myItemsWidget = response.myItemsWidget;
		}
		if (response.counts) {
			broadcastCounts(response);
		}
	}
	// End Chameleon Enhancements


}]]></client_script><controller_as>c</controller_as><css>@mixin -link-hover {
  cursor: pointer;
  background-color: transparent; /*darken($navbar-inverse-bg, 5%);*/
  border-radius: $border-radius-base;
  color: $navbar-inverse-link-hover-color;
}

@mixin -link-focus {
  outline: 1.5px solid $navbar-inverse-link-color;
  border: none;
  border-radius: $border-radius-base;
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 0.1rem #fff;
  background-color: darken($navbar-inverse-bg, 10%);
  color: $navbar-inverse-link-hover-color;
}

@mixin -focus-visible-mouse-ua {
  border: none;
  outline: none;
  box-shadow: none;
}

@mixin -focus-visible-keyboard-ua {
  outline: 1.5px solid $navbar-inverse-link-color;
  border: none;
  border-radius: $border-radius-base;
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 0.1rem #fff;
}

/* -- cham Customizations -- */
span.m-r-xs.cham-my-items-icon.fa.icon.fa-heart {
  color: $brand-primary;
}

.mobile-top-navigation.cham-mobile {
  padding-left: 15px;
  margin-right: auto;
}
.navbar-inverse .navbar-toggle .icon-bar {
  background-color: $brand-primary;
}
.navbar-inverse .navbar-toggle {
  margin-right: 0;

  &:focus {
    background: $brand-primary;

    .icon-bar {
      background-color: #fff;
    }
  }
}
/* -- END cham Customizations -- */

.navbar-inverse {
  margin-bottom: 0px;
  border-radius: 0px;
  background-color: $navbar-inverse-bg;
  position: relative;
  z-index: 7;
  box-shadow: 0px 2px 12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.14);

  .navbar-header {
    &.nav-container {
      width: 100%;
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      justify-content: end;

      .sub-navbar-overflow-entry-button {
        position: relative;
        float: right;
        margin: 1.3rem 1.5rem 1.3rem 0;
        padding: .9rem 1rem;
        background-color: transparent;
        background-image: none;
        border: .1rem solid transparent;
        border-radius: .4rem;
        border-color: $brand-primary;

        .label {
          float: right;
          margin-right: -.5rem;
          margin-top: -.7rem;
          padding: .2em .5em .2em;
        }

        .label-as-badge {
          font-size: 1.2rem;
          position: relative;
          top: -$sp-space--xxs;
          left: $sp-space--xxs;
          padding: $sp-space--xxs 5px;
          margin-left: 0;
          background-color: $badge-bg; /*$btn-danger-bg;*/
          color: $text-white;
        }

        .icon-bar {
          display: block;
          width: 2.2rem;
          height: .2rem;
          border-radius: .1rem;
          background-color: $brand-primary;
        }

        .icon-bar+.icon-bar {
          margin-top: .4rem;
        }

        &.close-icon-visible {
          margin-bottom: 0;
          padding: 0.6rem 1rem;
        }

        .fa.fa-close {
          vertical-align: -6%;
          font-size: 20px;
          width: 22px;
          color: $navbar-inverse-link-color;
        }
      }
    }

    .gt-menu-item>a,
    .gt-menu-item>div>ul>li>a,
    .navbar-nav>li>a {
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 700;

      &:hover {
        @include -link-hover;
      }

      &:focus {
        @include -link-focus;
      }

      &:focus:not(:focus-visible) {
        @include -focus-visible-mouse-ua;
      }

      &:focus-visible {
        @include -focus-visible-keyboard-ua;
      }
    }

    .mobile-view-on-desktop {
      top: 60px;
      position: absolute;
      right: 0;
      z-index: 999;
      min-height: 600px;
      max-width: 400px;
      background-color: $navbar-inverse-bg;
      box-shadow: 5px 5px 5px $navbar-inverse-link-color;
      color: $navbar-inverse-link-color;

      .mobile-view-navbar {
        list-style: none;
        padding: 0 8px;
        margin: 0;
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        border-top: 1px solid darken($navbar-inverse-link-color, 45%);

        .main-header-items {
          padding-inline-start: 0.4rem !important;
          padding-inline-end: 0.4rem !important;
          list-style: none;
          padding-top: 11px;
          margin: 0;
          display: flex;
          flex-direction: column;

          &>li>div>ul {
            width: 100%;

            &>li {
              width: 100%;

              &>a>span {

                &:hover {
                  @include -link-hover;
                }

                &:focus {
                  @include -link-focus;
                }

                &:focus:not(:focus-visible) {
                  @include -focus-visible-mouse-ua;
                }

                &:focus-visible {
                  @include -focus-visible-keyboard-ua;
                }
              }
            }
          }

          &>li:not(:nth-child(10))>a {
            display: block;
            padding: $sp-space--md;

            &:hover {
              @include -link-hover;

              &>a {
                color: $navbar-inverse-link-hover-color;
              }
            }

            &:focus {
              @include -link-focus;
            }

            &:focus:not(:focus-visible) {
              @include -focus-visible-mouse-ua;
            }

            &:focus-visible {
              @include -focus-visible-keyboard-ua;
            }

            // Cart, tours, and Wishlist (Mobile View)
            .nav.navbar-nav {
              display: flex;
              flex-direction: column;
            }
          }
        }

        .mobile-mega-menu-entry {
          margin: 0 -8px;
        }

        .separator {
          margin: 20px -8px;
          border-top: 1px solid darken($navbar-inverse-link-color, 30%);
        }

        li>a {
          color: $navbar-inverse-link-color;

          &:hover,
          &:focus {
            color: #fff !important;
            background-color: transparent;
          }

          &:focus {
            box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 0.1rem #fff;
            outline: 1.5px solid $navbar-inverse-link-color;
            border: none;
            border-radius: 4px;
          }

          &:focus:not(:focus-visible) {
            border: none;
            outline: none;
            box-shadow: none;
          }

          &:focus-visible {
            box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 0.1rem #fff;
            outline: 1.5px solid $navbar-inverse-link-color;
            border: none;
            border-radius: 4px;
          }
        }

        li.user-name {
          margin: 0 0.4rem 0 0.4rem;

          &>a {
            display: block;
            padding: 0 $sp-space--md;
            height: $sp-space--xl * 2;

            &>span.navbar-avatar {
              line-height: $sp-space--sm * 7;
            }

            &>span:not(.navbar-avatar) {
              line-height: 4.5rem;
            }
          }

          &:hover {
            @include -link-hover;

            &>a {
              color: $navbar-inverse-link-hover-color;
            }
          }

          &:focus {
            @include -link-focus;
          }

          &:focus:not(:focus-visible) {
            @include -focus-visible-mouse-ua;
          }

          &:focus-visible {
            @include -focus-visible-keyboard-ua;
          }
        }
      }

      .impersonate-and-logout {
        div>ul>li:first-child {
          & > a {
            display: none;
          }

          ul.dropdown-menu {
            width: 400px;
            display: block;
            z-index: inherit;
            background-color: $navbar-inverse-bg;
            box-shadow: none;
            border-radius: 0;
            padding-left: 2px;
            padding-bottom: 16px;

            li>a {
              margin: 0 $sp-space--md 0 $sp-space--md;
              padding: $sp-space--md;

              &:hover {
                @include -link-hover;

                &>a {
                  color: $navbar-inverse-link-hover-color;
                }
              }

              &:focus {
                @include -link-focus;

                &>a {
                  border: none;
                  box-shadow: none;
                }
              }

              &:focus:not(:focus-visible) {
                @include -focus-visible-mouse-ua;
              }

              &:focus-visible {
                @include -focus-visible-keyboard-ua;
              }
            }

            li:first-child {
              display: none;
            }
          }
        }

        div>ul>li>a {

		data.hasNativeRole = gs.hasRole('sn_hr_core.basic') || gs.hasRole('sn_hr_le.case_reader') ||gs.getUser().isMemberOf('BHSF ITIL Users');
		data.cartWidget = $sp.getWidget("sc-shopping-cart-v2", {
			cartTemplate: "small_shopping_cart_v2.html",
			auto_update_cart: options.auto_update_cart
		});

		if(!input || input.action=="getCounts"){
			data.counts = {};
			var api = new sn_hr_sp.ChameleonPadAPI();
			data.counts.tickets = api.getItemsCount();
			data.counts.approvals = api.getApprovalsCount();
			data.counts.favorites = api.getECFavoritesCount(portalId);

			var myTodosCountObject = new sn_hr_sp.todoPageUtils().getMyTodosCount();
			data.todoCount = myTodosCountObject.todoCount;
			data.todoCountLabel = gs.getMessage("{0} to-dos remaining");
			data.recordWatchers = myTodosCountObject.recordWatchers;

			if (input) return;
		}
		// Drawer Widgets
		
		if (input && input.action == 'getWidgets') {
			// My Items drawer
			var myItemsOptions = {
				event_name: 'chamToggleMyItems',
				widget_id: 'cham-tabbed-content',
				widget_options: {
					title: gs.getMessage('My Items'),
					template: "cham-tabbed-content-panel.html",
					"tabs":[
						{
							"title":"${Tickets}",
							"widget_id":"cham-mini-myitems",
							"badge_prop": "tickets_count",
							"options": {
								"limit": 6,
								"script_include":"9180587a83c4e210c0fb56d6feaad35f",
								"template": "cham-lp-tickets-list-v2.html"
							}
						},
						{
							"title":"${Approvals}",
							"widget_id":"cham-approvals-list",
							"badge_prop": "approvals_count",
							"options": {
								"limit": 1,
								"template": "cham-lp-approvals-list-v2.html"
							}
						},
						{
							"title":"${To-Dos}",
							"widget_id":"cham-mini-myitems",
							"badge_prop": "todos_count",
							"options": {
								"limit": 4,
								"script_include":"9180587a83c4e210c0fb56d6feaad35f",
								"method_name": "getTodos", 
								"template": "cham-lp-todos-list-v2.html"
							}
						}
					]
				}
			};
			data.myItemsWidget = $sp.getWidget('cham-drawer', myItemsOptions);

			var bookmarkOptions = {
				event_name: 'chamToggleBookmarks',
				widget_id: 'cham-tabbed-content',
				widget_options: {
					load_async: true,
					title: gs.getMessage('My Favorites'),
					template: "cham-esc-drawer-wrapper.html",
					"tabs": getFavoritesTabs(input)
				}
			};
			data.myBookmarksWidget = $sp.getWidget('cham-drawer', bookmarkOptions);

			return;
		}
		
	}
	// End Chameleon Enhancements


	if (data.isFavoritesEnabled) {
		var favoriteApi = new sn_ex_sp.FavoriteAPI();
		var qsConfig = $sp.getValue('quick_start_config');
		var favoriteIcon = favoriteApi.getFavoriteIcon(qsConfig);
		data.favoriteIcon = favoriteIcon.checkIcon;
	}

	//Load To-dos count
	if (!input || input.action == data.ACTION_TODO_COUNT) {
		var myTodosCountObject = new sn_hr_sp.todoPageUtils().getMyTodosCount();
		data.todoCount = myTodosCountObject.todoCount;
		data.todoCountLabel = gs.getMessage("{0} to-dos remaining");
		data.recordWatchers = myTodosCountObject.recordWatchers;

		// avoid consecutive calls 
		if (input)
			return;
	}

	data.isHrCoreActive = GlidePluginManager().isActive("com.sn_hr_core");
	if (data.isHrCoreActive && gs.getProperty('sn_hr_core.esc.create_hrprofile.override', 'true') === "true") {
		// HR Profile
		var hrProfileGr = new GlideRecord('sn_hr_core_profile');
		hrProfileGr.addQuery('user', gs.getUserID());
		hrProfileGr.setLimit(1);
		hrProfileGr.query();
		if (!hrProfileGr.hasNext() && gs.getUserID() && new GlideRecord('sys_user').get(gs.getUserID())) {
			hrProfileGr.setValue('user', gs.getUserID());
			hrProfileGr.insert();
		}
	}

	// check for listening posts voluntary feedback
	data.voluntarySurveyIsActive = false;
	data.isListeningPostsActive = GlidePluginManager().isActive("sn_lp");
	if (data.isListeningPostsActive) {
		var pulseUtils = new sn_lp.PulseUserCriteriaEvaluation();
		data.voluntarySurvey = pulseUtils.getActiveVoluntarySurvey && pulseUtils.getActiveVoluntarySurvey();

		if (data.voluntarySurvey && data.voluntarySurvey.next()) {
			data.voluntarySurveyIsActive = true;
		}
	}

	// populate the 'data' object
	//data.link = '?id=hri_user_profile&sys_id=' + gs.getUserID();
	data.link = '?id=cham_my_account&sys_id=' + gs.getUserID();

	// Defines the support queue ID that will be linked to by the Live Chat link in header
	data.login_page = $sp.getValue('login_page');

	//Initialize menu objects
	data.sub = {};
	data.top = {};
	var menu = $sp.getValue("sp_rectangle_menu");
	data.sub.menu = $sp.getWidgetFromInstance(menu);
	//data.escNavigation = $sp.getWidget("employee-center-navigation");

	//Copy sub menu to top menu, we want cart up top and menu items in the sub nav
	data.top.menu = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(data.sub.menu));

	//Fetching My Items menu item sys_id
	var configOptions = JSON.parse((data.top.menu && data.top.menu.options && data.top.menu.options.widget_parameters) || '{}');
	data.moreItemsSysId = (configOptions.enable_more_items && configOptions.enable_more_items.sysId) || '';
	var subMenu = data.sub.menu;
	var moreItems;
	if (subMenu && subMenu.data) {
		subMenu.data.replace = true;
		// Hide login if menu already has link to login
		data.hasLogin = false;
		var subMenuDataItems = (subMenu.data.menu && subMenu.data.menu.items) || [];
		for (var i in subMenuDataItems) {
			var item = subMenuDataItems[i];
			if (item.sys_id === data.moreItemsSysId)
				moreItems = item;
			if (item.type === 'page' && item.sp_page === data.login_page)
				data.hasLogin = true;
		}
	}

	if (moreItems && moreItems.items)
		data.moreItems = moreItems.items;
	if (moreItems && data.moreItems && moreItems.label) {
		// Removing items with no label
		data.moreItems = data.moreItems.filter(function(moreItem) {
			return moreItem.label;
		});

		// Truncating label of items exceeding 60 character limit
		data.moreItems.forEach(function(moreItem) {
			moreItem.shortLabel = (moreItem.label.length > 60) ? (moreItem.label.substring(0, 60) + '...') : moreItem.label;
		});
	}

	data.hideSearchOnHomepage = configOptions.exclude_search_on_homepage ? configOptions.exclude_search_on_homepage.value : false;
	data.showRequests = configOptions.enable_requests ? configOptions.enable_requests.value : true;
	data.showTodos = configOptions.enable_tasks ? configOptions.enable_tasks.value : true;
	if (data.hideSearchOnHomepage) {
		data.homepage = $sp.getValue('homepage');
		var gr = new GlideRecord('sp_page');
		gr.get(data.homepage);
		data.dashboardSuffix = gr.getValue("id");
		data.portalSuffix = $sp.getPortalRecord().getDisplayValue("url_suffix");
	}

	data.showMoreItems = (moreItems && moreItems.label && data.moreItems && configOptions.enable_more_items) ? (data.moreItems.length > 0 && configOptions.enable_more_items.value) : false;
	if (data.showMoreItems)
		data.moreItemsTitle = data.moreItems.length === 1 ? data.moreItems[0].shortLabel : moreItems.label;

	// Analytics
	data.analyticsSupportEnabled = new GlidePluginManager().isActive('com.sn_content_analytics') && new GlidePluginManager().isActive('com.sn_content_delivery') && !sn_cd.cd_ContentDelivery.isContentPreview($sp);

	//Clean up items that don't belong
	if (subMenu) {
		if (subMenu.data) {
			subMenu.data.cartWidget = {};
			subMenu.data.showTours = false;
		}
		if (subMenu.options) {
			subMenu.options.enable_cart = false;
		}
	}
	if (data.top.menu && data.top.menu.data && data.top.menu.data.menu && data.top.menu.data.menu.items)
		data.top.menu.data.menu.items = [];

	var typeAheadOptions = {};
	typeAheadOptions.refresh_page_on_search_submission = false;
	typeAheadOptions.title = gs.getMessage("Search");
	if ($sp.isAISearchEnabled())
		typeAheadOptions.disable_all_suggestions = ($sp.getParameter('disableAllSuggestions') == 'true');

	data.typeahead = $sp.getWidget('typeahead-search', typeAheadOptions);
	data.loginWidget = $sp.getWidgetFromInstance('login-modal');

	function getFavoritesTabs(obj){
		if(!obj.counts && !obj.counts.favorites)
			return [];

		var results = [];
		var all = {
			"title": gs.getMessage('All'),
			"widget_id": "cham-mini-myitems",
			"badge_prop": "favorites_all",
			"options": {
				"portal": portalId,
				"limit": 6,
				"script_include": "9180587a83c4e210c0fb56d6feaad35f",
				"method_name": "getECFavorites",
				"template": "cham-esc-favorites-drawer.html"
			}
		};
		results.push(all);

		for(var i in obj.counts.favorites){
			if(obj.counts.favorites[i].name == "all")
				continue;

			results.push({
				"title": gs.getMessage(obj.counts.favorites[i].name),
				"widget_id": "cham-mini-myitems",
				"badge_prop": "favorites_" +obj.counts.favorites[i].name,
				"options": {
					"portal": portalId,
					"category": obj.counts.favorites[i].sys_id,
					"limit": 6,
					"script_include": "9180587a83c4e210c0fb56d6feaad35f",
					"method_name": "getECFavorites",
					"template": "cham-esc-favorites-drawer.html"
				}
			});

		}
		return results;
	}
})();]]></script><servicenow>false</servicenow><static>true</static><sys_class_name>sp_header_footer</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>mc.admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-03-05 08:25:44</sys_created_on><sys_id>7352629683886210c0fb56d6feaad3eb</sys_id><sys_mod_count>51</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Chameleon Employee Center Header</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Employee Center Core" source="sn_hr_sp">3d1da2705b021200a4656ede91f91ab6</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Employee Center Core">3d1da2705b021200a4656ede91f91ab6</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sp_header_footer_7352629683886210c0fb56d6feaad3eb</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>a.gonzales</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-03-20 08:40:24</sys_updated_on><template><![CDATA[<!-- Nav bar menu items starts-->

                 aria-label="${{{data.moreItems[0].label}}}"
                 role="menuitem">
                <span ng-bind-html="'${' + data.moreItemsTitle + '}'" aria-hidden="true"></span>
              </a>
              <a href
                 ng-if="data.moreItems.length > 1"
                 id="more-items-button"
                 data-toggle="dropdown"
                 data-target="more-items-dropdown"
                 data-placement="bottom"
                 aria-label="${{{data.moreItemsTitle}}}"
                 role="menuitem">
                <span ng-bind-html="'${' + data.moreItemsTitle + '}'" aria-hidden="true"></span>
                <i class="fa collapse-margin m-l-xs fa-caret-down"></i>
              </a>
              <ul id="more-items-dropdown" ng-if="data.moreItems.length > 1" class="dropdown-menu"
                  role="menu" aria-label="${{{data.moreItemsTitle}}}">
                <li role="presentation"
                    ng-repeat="item in data.moreItems"
                    class="ng-scope dropdown-menu-line header-menu-item">
                  <a ng-if="item.label !== item.shortLabel"
                     href="{{item.href}}"
                     target="{{item.url_target}}"
                     data-toggle="tooltip"
                     data-placement="bottom"
                     data-original-title="${ {{item.label}} }"
                     aria-label="{{item.label}}"
                     role="menuitem">
                    <span ng-bind-html="'${' + item.shortLabel + '}'" aria-hidden="true"></span>
                  </a>
                  <a ng-if="item.label === item.shortLabel"
                     href="{{item.href}}"
                     target="{{item.url_target}}"
                     aria-label="{{item.label}}"
                     role="menuitem">
                    <span ng-bind-html="'${' + item.shortLabel + '}'" aria-hidden="true"></span>
                  </a>
                </li>
              </ul>
            </li>
            <!-- Avatar and its drop down (Desktop) -->
            <li class="avatar-drop-down gt-menu-item" role="menuitem">
              <sp-widget widget="c.avatarDropDown" id="avatar_drop_down" ></sp-widget>
            </li>
            <!-- Cart, tours, and Wishlist
            <li class="gt-menu-item">
              <sp-widget widget="data.top.menu" id="menu_item"></sp-widget>
            </li> -->
          </ul>

        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- LP Voluntary Feedback Widget-->
    <div ng-if="!(showMobileMenuOnDesktop || mobileDevice) && c.data.voluntarySurveyIsActive">
      <widget id="listening_posts_voluntary_feedback"></widget>
    </div>

  </div>

  <!-- Sub Navbar on Desktop 
  <div class="navbar-collapse sub-navbar clearfix collapse collapsed hidden-xs"
       ng-class="{ 'in': expanded, 'collapsed': !expanded, 'sub-navbar--mobile-view': showMobileMenuOnDesktop }">

//.vdae53627530030101865ddeeff7b12be .all-card-container-left{
.all-card-container-left{
  padding-top: 20px !important;
  display: grid !important;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr !important;
  gap: 30px !important;

  @media (max-width: 991px) {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr !important; 
  }
  @media (max-width: 767px) {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr !important; 
  }
}
//.vdae53627530030101865ddeeff7b12be .card-thumbnail-align-left.card-medium{

  display: flex !important;
  align-items: center !important;

  @include topic-card;
  max-height: 87px !important;
  height: 87px !important;
  min-height:87px !important;
  &:hover {
    @include content-card-hover; 
  }
}
//.vdae53627530030101865ddeeff7b12be .card-title {
.card-title {
  color:  $text-primary !important;
  font-weight: 600;
  font-size: 16px;

//.vdae53627530030101865ddeeff7b12be .all-card-container-left{
.all-card-container-left{
  padding-top: 20px !important;
  display: grid !important;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr !important;
  gap: 30px !important;

  @media (max-width: 991px) {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr !important; 
  }
  @media (max-width: 767px) {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr !important; 
  }
}
//.vdae53627530030101865ddeeff7b12be .card-thumbnail-align-left.card-medium{
.card-thumbnail-align-left.card-medium{
  display: flex !important;
  align-items: center !important;

  padding: .5rem !important;
  @include topic-card;
  max-height: 87px !important;
  height: 87px !important;
  min-height:87px !important;
  &:hover {
    @include content-card-hover; 
  }
}
//.vdae53627530030101865ddeeff7b12be .card-title {
.card-title {
  color:  $text-primary !important;
  font-weight: 600;

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sp_page"><sp_page action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><category>sn_ex_sp_taxonomy</category><css>/* cham config */
.cham-topic-bread {
  margin-bottom: -73px;
  overflow: hidden;
  z-index: 1;
  position: relative;
  margin-top: 3rem;
}
.topic-bg {
  padding: 0;
  overflow: hidden;

  .container-fluid, .col-md-12 {
    padding: 0;
  }
}
.topic-head-text {
  margin-top: -115px;
  margin-bottom: 35px;
  margin-left: 35px;

  .col-md-12 {
    padding: 0;
    padding-left: 15px !important;
  }
  .container {
    padding-left: 20px;
  }
}

.sub-topics-container {
  margin-bottom: -20px;
}
.topic-subs {
  @media (min-width: 62em){
    padding-left: 40px !important;
    padding-right: 40px !important;
  }

  @media (max-width: 62em) {
    padding-left: 2.4rem;
  }
}
.topic-content {
  margin-top: 30px;

  @media (min-width: 62em){
    padding-left: 40px !important;
    padding-right: 40px !important;
  }

  @media (max-width: 62em) {
    padding-left: 2.4rem;
  }
}

/* Cant get around with out important as mesp has container style with important */
.topic-page__row {
  display: flex;
}
.flex-basis-zero {
  flex-basis: 0;
  padding-right: 0;

  @media (max-width: 62em) {
    padding-left: 0;
  }
}

.flex-basis-auto {
  flex-basis: 0;
}
.flex-basis-auto.topic-side > span > div > * {
  min-width: 300px;
}

@media (max-width: 991px) {
  .topic-page__row {
    display: unset;
  }
}

.topic-breadcrumbs-container .breadcrumbs{
  padding-top: 1.375rem;
  margin-left: 0.9375rem;
  .nav{
    a{
      color: $text-color;
    }
    .fa{
      color: $text-muted;
    }
    .a-disabled{
      color: $text-color;
      font-weight: 700;
    }
  }
}

[accessibility] [tabindex]:focus , [accessibility] .btn.btn-default:focus{
  box-shadow: none;
}

@media(max-width: 22em){
  .topic-breadcrumbs-container .breadcrumbs{
    display: none;
  }
}

@media(max-width: 31em){
  .topic-breadcrumbs-container .breadcrumbs{
    padding-top: 0.375rem;
    > ul {
      margin-bottom: 0;
      > li{
        padding-bottom: 0.375rem;
      }
    }
  }
}

@media (max-width: 48em) {
  .flex-orientation {
    flex-direction: column;
  }
  .lf-margin  > span > div > *{
    margin: 0rem 1.6rem 2.4rem 1.6rem;
  }
  .rt-margin  > span > div > *{
    margin: 0rem 1.6rem 2.4rem 1.6rem;
  }
}

@media screen and (-ms-high-contrast: active),
  (-ms-high-contrast: none) {
    .flex-basis-auto {
      flex-basis:auto;
    }
}

@media screen and (-ms-high-contrast: active),
  (-ms-high-contrast: none) and (max-width: 48em) {
    .flex-basis-zero {
      flex-basis:auto;
    }
}</css><draft>false</draft><dynamic_title_structure/><human_readable_url_structure/><id>cham_emp_taxonomy_topic</id><internal>false</internal><omit_watcher>false</omit_watcher><public>false</public><roles/><seo_script/><short_description/><sys_class_name>sp_page</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>mc.admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-03-10 12:13:09</sys_created_on><sys_id>446645408354aa10c0fb56d6feaad3c1</sys_id><sys_mod_count>2</sys_mod_count><sys_name>cham_emp_taxonomy_topic</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Employee Center Core" source="sn_hr_sp">3d1da2705b021200a4656ede91f91ab6</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Employee Center Core">3d1da2705b021200a4656ede91f91ab6</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sp_page_446645408354aa10c0fb56d6feaad3c1</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>mc.admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-03-10 12:49:47</sys_updated_on><title>Chameleon Employee Topic </title><use_seo_script>false</use_seo_script></sp_page><sys_translated_text action="delete_multiple" query="documentkey=446645408354aa10c0fb56d6feaad3c1"/></record_update>
