sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>public</access><active>true</active><api_name>sn_hr_sp.ChameleonAPI</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description/><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>ChameleonAPI</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[var ChameleonAPI = Class.create();
ChameleonAPI.prototype = {
	initialize: function() {
		this.user_id = gs.getUserID();
		this.ticket_page = gs.getProperty('cham.ticket_page') || "ticket";
		this.sc_cat_item_guide_page = gs.getProperty('cham.sc_cat_item_guide_page') || "sc_cat_item_guide";
		this.sc_cat_item_page = gs.getProperty('cham.my_items_page') || "sc_cat_item";
		this.sc_request_page = gs.getProperty('cham.sc_request_page') || "sc_request";
		this.approval_page = gs.getProperty('cham.approval_page') || "approval";
		this.inc_icon = gs.getProperty('cham.inc_icon') || "cham-inc-icon.png";
		this.req_icon = gs.getProperty('cham.req_icon') || "cham-req-icon.png";
		this.incident_query = gs.getProperty('cham.incident_query') || "caller_idDYNAMIC90d1921e5f510100a9ad2572f2b477fe";
		this.request_query = gs.getProperty('cham.request_query') || "requested_forDYNAMIC90d1921e5f510100a9ad2572f2b477fe";
		this.recent_items_query = gs.getProperty('cham.recent_items_query') || 'userDYNAMIC90d1921e5f510100a9ad2572f2b477fe^type=Cat Item View^ORtype=KB Article View^sys_created_onONLast 6 months@javascript:gs.beginningOfLast6Months()@javascript:gs.endOfLast6Months()';
	},

	//Called from RF Ticket Progress Tracker to retrive Flow Formatters for current ticket
	//Returns as an array
	getTicketStages: function(options, params, ticket) {
		var flagActive = false;
		var spliceCount = 0;
		var stopCounting = false;
		var NumberOfState = 0;
		var pStages = [];

		/* -- Finds Process Flow for related record table -- */
		/* -- Flags a match as "active" -- */
		var pr = new GlideRecord('sys_process_flow');
		pr.addEncodedQuery('active=true^table=' + params.table);
		pr.orderBy('order');
		pr.query();
		while (pr.next()) {
			NumberOfState++;
			var tab =  new GlideRecord(params.table);
			tab.addEncodedQuery('number=' + ticket.display_value + '^' + pr.condition);
			tab.setLimit(1);
			tab.query();
			if (tab.next()) {
				stopCounting = true;
				var prDesc = pr.description.getDisplayValue().replace(/<\/?[^>]+(>|$)/g, "");
				var prLabel = "In Progress";
				pStages.push({title: pr.label.getDisplayValue(), active: true, displayValue: prDesc, label: prLabel});
				flagActive = NumberOfState;
			}else {
				var prDesc = pr.description.getDisplayValue().replace(/<\/?[^>]+(>|$)/g, "");
				var prLabel = "Pending";
				pStages.push({title: pr.label.getDisplayValue(), active: false, pending: true, displayValue: prDesc, label: prLabel});
			}
			if(!stopCounting) {
				spliceCount++;
			}
		}

		/* -- Marks anything before the "active" stage as "completed" -- */
		for (var i=0; i<pStages.length; i++){
			if(i<spliceCount){
				pStages[i].completed = true;
				pStages[i].pending = false;
				pStages[i].label = "Complete";
			}
		}

		return pStages;
	},


	//Called from RF Announcement Carousel v2 to retrieve announcements for the current portal
	//Returns as an array
	getAnnouncements: function(portalID, options, params) {
		var results = [];
		var widgetType = '';
		var consumerTypeGR = new GlideRecord('announcement_consumer_type');
		if (consumerTypeGR.get('name', 'Widget')) {
			widgetType = consumerTypeGR.getUniqueValue();
		}
		var z = new GlideRecord("announcement");

		//Query - 'Active' is true && 'From' at/before today && 'To' at/after today OR empty && 'Type' is Widget
		z.addEncodedQuery("active=true^from<=javascript:gs.endOfToday()^ORfromISEMPTY^to>=javascript:gs.beginningOfToday()^ORtoISEMPTY^typeLIKE" + widgetType);
		z.orderByDesc("sys_updated_on");
		z.query();

		while(z.next() && results.length < options.limit) {

			var annID = z.getUniqueValue();
			var verify = this._verifyPortal(annID, portalID);
			if (!verify) {
				continue;
			}

			var a = {};
			a.sys_id = z.getUniqueValue();
			a.title = z.getDisplayValue('title');
			a.summary = z.getDisplayValue('summary');
			a.image = z.getDisplayValue('u_image') ? z.getDisplayValue('u_image'): null;
			if (!a.image) {
				a.glyphicon = "fa-bullhorn";
			}
			a.display_first = z.getValue('display_first');
			a.click_target = z.getValue('click_target');
			a.url_text = z.getDisplayValue('details_link_text');
			if (a.click_target === 'urlNew') {
				a.url_target = '_blank';
				a.url = z.getValue('details_url');
			}
			if (a.click_target === 'urlCurrent') {
				a.url_target = '_self';
				a.url = z.getValue('details_url');
			}
			if (a.click_target === 'page') {
				a.url_target = '_self';
				a.url = "?id=" + z.getDisplayValue('details_page');
			}

			if(a.display_first == true) {
				results.unshift(a);
			}else {
				results.push(a);
			}
		}
		return results;
	},

	//Called from getAnnouncements to verify the Announcement is on the current portal
	//Returns as a boolean value
	_verifyPortal: function(sysID, portal) {

		var z = new GlideRecord("m2m_announcement_portal");
		z.addQuery("sp_portal", portal);
		z.addQuery("announcement", sysID);
		z.setLimit(1);
		z.query();

		if (z.next()) {
			return true;
		} else {
			return false;
		}
	},


	// Used by the reference qualifier on the Instance Template field
	getWidgetTemplates: function(current) {
		var sys_id = current.getValue('sp_widget');
		var query = "sp_widget=" + sys_id;
		return query;
	},
	// Used for setting page specific user preferences
	getPagePrefID: function() {
		var sys_id = "";
		var id = $sp.getParameter('id');
		if (!id) { id = "index"; }
		var pageGR = new GlideRecord('sp_page');
		if (pageGR.get('id', id)) {
			sys_id = "CHAM" + pageGR.getUniqueValue();
		}
		return sys_id;
	},

	// Returns list of columns for a given table
	getTableColumns: function(table) {
		var arr_fields = [];
		var fields = new GlideRecord('sys_dictionary');
		fields.addQuery('name', table);
		fields.addEncodedQuery('internal_type!=collection^ORinternal_type=NULL');
		fields.query();
		while (fields.next()) {
			arr_fields.push(fields.element.toString());
		}
		return arr_fields;
	},

	// Returns array of popular catalog items
	getPopularItems: function(options) {
		if (!options) { options = {}; }

		var catalog = [];

		if (options.hasOwnProperty('sc_catalog')) {
			catalog = Array.isArray(options.sc_catalog) ? options.sc_catalog : options.sc_catalog.split(',');
		}

		var limit = options.limit || 16;

		var items = [];
		var count = 0;
		var spLogGR = new GlideAggregate('sp_log');
		spLogGR.addAggregate('COUNT', 'id');
		spLogGR.groupBy('id');
		spLogGR.addQuery('type', 'Cat Item Request');
		spLogGR.orderByAggregate('COUNT', 'id');
		spLogGR.query();
		while (spLogGR.next() && count < limit) {

			var catalogItemJS = new sn_sc.CatItem(spLogGR.getValue('id'));
			if (!catalogItemJS.canView() || !catalogItemJS.isVisibleServicePortal()) { continue; }

			var cat_item = spLogGR.id.getRefRecord();
			var cat_item_catalogs = cat_item.getValue('sc_catalogs') ? cat_item.getValue('sc_catalogs').split(',') : [];

			// Verify that the Catalog Item still exists (Log could reference a deleted item) and that it belongs to at least one Catalog
			if(!cat_item.isValidRecord() || cat_item_catalogs.length == 0) { continue; }

			/*
			** Belongs to one of the set catalogs?
			** Some function compares the two arrays. 
			** If there is at least one overlap of values between the two, it returns true
			** 1) portalCatalogs: passed in array of Catalog sys_ids from options
			** 2) itemCatalogs: Catalog sys_ids from the Catalogs field on the Cat Item
			*/

			var isInCatalog = function (portalCatalogs, itemCatalogs) {
				return itemCatalogs.some(function (v) {
					return portalCatalogs.indexOf(v) != -1;
				});
			};

			// If there is no overlapping values, continue to next record
			if (!isInCatalog(catalog, cat_item_catalogs)) { continue; }

			// Include record producers?
			if (!options.include_record_producers && spLogGR.getValue('table') == 'sc_cat_item_producer') { continue; }

			items.push(this._createPopularItem(spLogGR, cat_item));
			count++;
		}
		return items;
	},

	// Return object representing the popular item
	_createPopularItem: function(spLogGR, cat_item) {
		var item = {};
		item.count = spLogGR.getAggregate('COUNT', 'id');
		item.name = cat_item.getDisplayValue('name');
		item.short_description = cat_item.getDisplayValue('short_description');
		item.picture = cat_item.getDisplayValue('picture');
		item.price = cat_item.getDisplayValue('price');
		item.sys_id = cat_item.getUniqueValue();
		item.page = this.sc_cat_item_page;
		item.table = spLogGR.getValue('table');
		if (spLogGR.getValue('table') == 'sc_cat_item_guide') {
			item.page = this.sc_cat_item_guide_page;
		}
		item.href = "?id=" + item.page + "&sys_id=" + item.sys_id;
		return item;
	},

	// Returns array of requests and incidents
	getItems: function(options) {
		if (!options) { options = {}; }

		var results = this._getSortedResults([
			this._getIncidents(options),
			this._getRequests(options)
		]);

		if (options.limit) {
			results = results.slice(0, options.limit);
		}

		return results;
	},

	// Returns count of requests and incidents
	getItemsCount: function(options) {
		if (!options) { options = {}; }
		options.limit = false;
		options.active_only = true;
		var items = this.getItems(options);
		return items.length;
	},

	// Returns count of approvals, typically called from header widget
	getApprovalsCount: function() {
		var grApproval = new GlideAggregate('sysapproval_approver');
		grApproval.addEncodedQuery('approver=javascript:global.getMyApprovals()^state=requested');
		grApproval.addAggregate('COUNT');
		grApproval.query();
		var myApprovalsCount = 0;
		if (grApproval.next()) {
			myApprovalsCount = grApproval.getAggregate('COUNT');
		}
		return parseInt(myApprovalsCount);
	},

	// Returns approvals pending for the current user
	getApprovals: function(options) {	
		var esigRequiredMap = options.check_esignature ? this._getEsigs() : {};

		var results = [];

		var z = new GlideRecord('sysapproval_approver');

		var myApprovals = global.getMyApprovals();
		z.addQuery("approver", myApprovals);
		if (options.encoded_query) {
			z.addEncodedQuery(options.encoded_query);
		}
		if (options.filters && options.filters['state']) {
			var query = this._getStateQuery(options);

			if (query) {
				z.addEncodedQuery(query);
			}
		}
		if (options.filters && options.filters['date_updated_query']) {
			z.addEncodedQuery(options.filters['date_updated_query'].value);
		}
		//CR - Removed because breaks when there's an invalid record
		//See line 310
		/*if (options.limit) {
			z.setLimit(options.limit);
		}*/
		z.orderBy("sys_created_on");

		z.query();
		var count = 0;
		while (z.next()) {
			//Break the loop if there's a limit
            if(options.limit && options.limit == count) { break; }

			var recordGR = this.getRecordBeingApproved(z);
			if (!recordGR.isValidRecord()) {
				continue;
			}

			count++;
			results.push(this._createApprovalItem(z, recordGR, esigRequiredMap));

		}

		return this._getSortedResults([results]);

	},

	// Return object representing the approval
	_createApprovalItem: function(z, recordGR, esigRequiredMap) {
		var a = {};
		a.columns = [
			{ "name": "record_opened_by", "label": "Requested by", "class": "col-md-3" },
			{ "name": "approver_dv", "label": "Approver", "class": "col-md-3" },
			{ "name": "state_dv", "label": "State", "class": "col-md-6" }
		];
		this._setPrimaryFields(a, z);

		a.type = 'approval';
		a.type_dv = 'Approval';
		a.href = "?id=" + this.approval_page + "&table=sysapproval_approver&sys_id=" + a.sys_id;
		a.approver = z.getValue('approver');
		a.approver_dv = z.getDisplayValue('approver');
		a.delagated_approval = z.getValue("approver") != gs.getUserID();

		a.record_number = recordGR.getDisplayValue();
		a.record_sys_id = recordGR.getUniqueValue();
		a.record_table = recordGR.getTableName();
		a.record_table_label = recordGR.getLabel();
		a.record_short_description = recordGR.getDisplayValue("short_description");
		a.e_sig_required = esigRequiredMap[a.record_table];

		if (recordGR.isValidField("opened_by") && !recordGR.opened_by.nil()) {
			a.record_opened_by = recordGR.opened_by.getDisplayValue();
		}

		if (recordGR.isValidField("requested_by") && !recordGR.requested_by.nil()) {
			a.record_opened_by = recordGR.requested_by.getDisplayValue();
		}

		if (a.record_table == "sc_request") {
			this._createRequestItemRelatedToApproval(a, z);
		} else {
			//If Approval is requested get variables for record being approved
			if (z.getValue('state') == "requested") {
				var detailRecord = sn_std_tkt_api.TicketConfig.getTicketRecord(a.record_table, a.record_sys_id);
				if (detailRecord && detailRecord.isValid() && detailRecord.canRead()){
					a.variables = this.filterVariables(new global.GlobalServiceCatalogUtil().getVariablesForTask(detailRecord, false));
				}
			}
		}
		return a;
	},

	// Return object representing the request related to the approval
	_createRequestItemRelatedToApproval: function(a, z) {
		var itemsGR = new GlideRecord("sc_req_item");
		itemsGR.addQuery("request", a.record_sys_id);
		itemsGR.query();
		var rowCount = itemsGR.getRowCount();
		if (rowCount > 1) {
			a.record_short_description = rowCount + " " + gs.getMessage("requested items");
		} else {
			itemsGR.next();
			a.record_short_description = itemsGR.short_description.toString();
		}
		//If Approval is requested get variables for RITM
		if (z.getValue('state') == "requested") {
		var ritmRecord = sn_std_tkt_api.TicketConfig.getTicketRecord(itemsGR.getTableName(), itemsGR.getUniqueValue());
			if (ritmRecord && ritmRecord.isValid() && ritmRecord.canRead()){
				a.variables = this.filterVariables(new global.GlobalServiceCatalogUtil().getVariablesForTask(ritmRecord, false));
			}
		}
	},

	// Removes variables that are not set to visible_summary
	filterVariables: function(variables) {
		if (!variables || variables.length == 0)
			return variables;

		var filteredVariables = [];
		variables.forEach(function(variable) {
			if (variable.visible_summary) {
				filteredVariables.push(variable);
			}
		});

		return filteredVariables;
	},

	/**
	 * 
	 * @param {Object} options 
	 * @param {Number} options.limit  Optional limit parametr
	 * @returns {Array<Object>}
	 */
	getRecentItems: function (options) {
		if (!options) {
			options = {};
		}
		try {
			var limit = options.limit;
			var results = [];
			var filtered = {};
			var logGR = new GlideRecord('sp_log');
			logGR.addEncodedQuery(this.recent_items_query);
			logGR.orderByDesc('sys_created_on');
			logGR.query();
			count = 0;
			while ((!limit && logGR.next()) || (logGR.next() && count < limit)) {
				if (!filtered[logGR.getValue('id')]) {
					var item = this._getRecentItemFields(logGR);
					filtered[item.sys_id] = item;
					results.push(item);
					count++;
				}
			}
			return results;
		} catch (e) {
			gs.addErrorMessage('CHAMRecentItems getRecentItems failed: ' + e.message);
			return results;
		}
	},

	/**
	 * Gets fields from a sp_log record
	 * @param {GlideRecord} gr gs_log record 
	 * @returns {Object} Item with populated fields
	 */
	_getRecentItemFields: function (gr) {
		var item = {};
		item.type = gr.getDisplayValue('type');
		item.time = gr.getDisplayValue('sys_created_on');
		item.table_name = gr.getValue('table');
		item.sys_id = gr.getValue('id');
		if (item.type === "KB Article View") {
			item.title = gr.getDisplayValue('text');
			item.href = "?id=kb_article" + "&sys_id=" + item.sys_id;
			item.type_dv = gs.getMessage("Article");
			item.icon = "fa-file-text";

		}
		if (item.type === "Cat Item View") {
			var catItemJS = new sn_sc.CatItem(item.sys_id);
			item.catItem = catItemJS.getItemSummary();
			item.image = item.catItem.picture;
			item.title = gr.getDisplayValue('id').replace(/.*: /, ""); // match and remove everything up until colon and space;
			item.href = "?id=sc_cat_item" + "&sys_id=" + item.sys_id;
			item.type_dv = gs.getMessage("Request");
			item.icon = "fa-cart-plus";
		}
		return item;
	},

	// Returns map of tables that require esignature
	_getEsigs: function() {
		var esigRequiredMap = {};
		var e_sig_required = this._isEsigActive();
		if (e_sig_required) {
			var esigRegistryGR = new GlideRecord("e_signature_registry");
			esigRegistryGR.addQuery("enabled", "true");
			esigRegistryGR.query();
			while(esigRegistryGR.next()) {
				esigRequiredMap[esigRegistryGR.getValue("table_name")] = true;
			}
		}
		return esigRequiredMap;
	},

	// Returns true if the e_signature_approvals plugin is active
	_isEsigActive: function() {
		var grPlugins = new GlideRecord('sys_plugins');
		if (grPlugins.get('source', 'com.glide.e_signature_approvals')) {
			if (grPlugins.isValidRecord() && grPlugins.getValue('active') == true) {
				return true;
			}
		}
		return false;
	},

	// Create encoded query for selected states in provided filters option
	_getStateQuery: function(options) {
		var arr = [];
		var stateArr = options.filters['state'];

		if (!Array.isArray(stateArr)) {
			return;	
		}

		for (var i=0; i < stateArr.length; i++) {
			if (stateArr[i].selected == true) {
				arr.push('state=' + stateArr[i].value);
			}
		}

		return arr.length > 1 ? arr.join('^OR') : arr[0];
	},

	// Gets the record being approved from the provided GlideRecord object
	getRecordBeingApproved: function(gr) {
		if (!gr.sysapproval.nil())
			return gr.sysapproval.getRefRecord();

		return gr.document_id.getRefRecord();
	},

	_getIncidents: function(options) {

	// Internal. Returns requests, called by getItems()
	_getRequests: function(options) {
		var results = [];
		var z = new GlideRecord('sc_request');
		if (options.request_query) {
			z.addEncodedQuery(options.request_query);
		} else {
			z.addEncodedQuery(this.request_query);
		}
		if (options.active_only) {
			z.addActiveQuery();

			z.addEncodedQuery(this._getActiveQuery(options));
		}

			z.addEncodedQuery(options.filters['date_updated_query'].value);

	// Creates request object with requested items
	_createRequest: function(z){
		var a = {};
		a.columns = [
			{ "name": "short_description", "label": "Description", "class": "col-sm-6 col-xs-12" },
			{ "name": "stage", "label": "Stage", "class": "col-sm-3 col-xs-6" },
			{ "name": "delivery_date", "label": "Delivery Date", "class": "col-sm-3 col-xs-6" }
		];

		this._setPrimaryFields(a, z);
		a.requested_for = z.getValue('requested_for');
		a.requested_for_dv = z.getDisplayValue('requested_for');
		a.rel_opened_by = (a.opened_by == this.user_id);
		a.rel_opened_for = (a.requested_for == this.user_id);
		a.rel_watching = (a.watch_list.indexOf(this.user_id) !== -1);
		a.__page = this.sc_request_page;
		a.type = 'request';
		a.type_dv = gs.getMessage('Request');
		a.href = "?id=" + a.__page + "&table=" + a.__table + "&sys_id=" + a.sys_id;
		a.items = [];

		var ritm = new GlideRecord('sc_req_item');
		ritm.addQuery('request', z.getUniqueValue());
		ritm.query();

		while (ritm.next()) {

			var i = {};
			i.sys_id = ritm.getValue("sys_id");
			i.short_description = ritm.getDisplayValue("short_description");
			i.stage = ritm.getDisplayValue("stage");
			i.state = ritm.getDisplayValue("state");
			i.__table = ritm.getTableName();
			i.__page = this.ticket_page;
			i.delivery_date = ritm.getDisplayValue('due_date'); // TODO is delivery date same as due date?
			i.href = "?id=" + i.__page + "&table=" + i.__table + "&sys_id=" + i.sys_id;

			if (ritm.getValue("cat_item")) {
				i.picture = ritm.cat_item.getRefRecord().getDisplayValue('picture');
			}

			a.items.push(i);
		}
		var rowCount = a.items.length;
		if (rowCount > 1) {
			a.short_description = rowCount + ' requested items';
			a.picture = this.req_icon;
		} else {
			if (a.items.length > 0) {
				a.short_description = a.items[0].short_description;
			}
			if (ritm.cat_item) {
				a.picture = ritm.cat_item.getRefRecord().getDisplayValue('picture') || this.req_icon;
			}
		}
		return a;
	},

	// Used by getItems function to set common fields
	_setPrimaryFields: function(a, z) {
		a.sys_id = z.getUniqueValue();
		a.short_description = z.getValue('short_description');
		a.number = z.getValue('number');
		a.state = z.getValue('state');

		a.assigned_to = z.getValue('assigned_to');
		a.assigned_to_dv = z.getDisplayValue('assigned_to');
		a.opened_by = z.getValue('opened_by');
		a.opened_by_dv = z.getDisplayValue('opened_by');
		a.priority = z.getValue('priority');
		a.priority_dv = z.getDisplayValue('priority');
		a.sys_updated_on = z.getValue('sys_updated_on');
		a.sys_updated_on_dv = z.getDisplayValue('sys_updated_on');
		a.sys_updated_days_ago = this._getDaysAgo(a.sys_updated_on);
		a.sys_created_on = z.getValue('sys_created_on');
		a.sys_created_on_dv = z.getDisplayValue('sys_created_on');

		a.__table = z.getTableName();
	},

	// Returns combined and sorted results from array of result sets (REQ, INC)
	_getSortedResults: function(ary) {
		var results = [];
		for (var i in ary) {
			var x = ary[i];
			results = results.concat(x);
		}
		results.sort(function(a, b) {
			return b.sort_order - a.sort_order;
		});
		return results;
	},

	// Calculates how long ago the provided date occurred
	_getDaysAgo: function(date) {
		var today = new GlideDate();
		var compare = new GlideDate();
		compare.setDisplayValue(date);
		var duration = GlideDate.subtract(compare, today);
		duration = new GlideDuration(duration);
		return duration.getDayPart();
	},

	// Created encoded query when the provided options have an active filter
	_getActiveQuery: function(options) {
		var arr = [];
		var query;
		var activeArr = options.filters['active'];
		if (!activeArr){
			return;	
		}
		var str;
		for (var i = 0; i < activeArr.length; i++) {
			if (activeArr[i].value == true){
				str = "true";
			} else {
				str = "false";
			}
			arr.push("active=" + str);
		}
		if (activeArr.length > 1){
			query = arr.join("^OR");
		} else {
			query = arr[0];
		}

		return query;
	},

	// Returns a knowledge GlideRecord for the provided sys_id or article number
	getKBArticle: function(sys_id, sysparm_article) {
		var knowledgeGR = new GlideRecord('kb_knowledge');
		
		if (!gs.nil(sysparm_article)) {
			knowledgeGR.addQuery('number', sysparm_article);
			knowledgeGR.addQuery('workflow_state', 'published');
			knowledgeGR.orderByDesc('sys_updated_on');
			knowledgeGR.setLimit(1);
			knowledgeGR.query();
			if(knowledgeGR.next() && knowledgeGR.canRead()) {
				return knowledgeGR;
			}
		} else if(knowledgeGR.get(sys_id) && knowledgeGR.canRead(sys_id)) {
			return knowledgeGR;
		} 
		
		return false;
	},

	// Adds a bookmark to the user's preferences
	// Deprecated
	favorite: function(preferenceName, user, favoriteToEvaluate) {
		var favorites = this.validatePreferences(user.getPreference(preferenceName));
		var result = this.updateFavorite(favorites, favoriteToEvaluate);

		var sanatizedFavorites = this.removePropsHref(JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(result.updatedFavorites)));
		user.savePreference(preferenceName, JSON.stringify(sanatizedFavorites));

		result.updatedFavorites = this.getURLForFavorites(result.updatedFavorites);
		return result;
	},

	// Updates a user's bookmarks
	// Deprecated
	updateFavorite: function(favorites, favoriteToEvaluate) {
		var action = 'saved';
		var length = favorites.length;
		var i;

		for (i = 0; i < length; i++) {
			if(favorites[i].id == favoriteToEvaluate.id) {
				action = 'deleted';
				break;
			}
		}

		if (action == 'saved') {
			favoriteToEvaluate.props.href = this.getFavoriteURL(favoriteToEvaluate);
			favorites.push(favoriteToEvaluate);
		} else {
			favorites.splice(i, 1);
		}

		return {
			updatedFavorites: favorites,
			action: action
		};
	},

	/* Removes the dynamically built href value on each favorites props item before storing in the sys_user_preference table */
	removePropsHref: function(favorites) {
		favorites.forEach(function(fav) {
			if (fav.props && fav.props.href) {
				delete fav.props.href;
			}
		});

		return favorites;
	},

	// Returns the user's bookmarks
	// Deprecated
	favorites: function(preferenceName, user, favoritesToUpdate) {
		var favorites = this.validatePreferences(user.getPreference(preferenceName));

		if (favoritesToUpdate) {
			return this.updateFavorites(favorites, favoritesToUpdate, user, preferenceName);
		}

		return this.getURLForFavorites(favorites);
	},

	// Updates the user's bookmarks
	// Deprecated
	updateFavorites: function(favorites, favoritesToUpdate, user, preferenceName) {
		var i, j;
		var newLength = favoritesToUpdate.length;
		var allLength = favorites.length;

		for (i = 0; i < newLength; i++) {
			for (j = 0; j < allLength; j++) {
				if (favoritesToUpdate[i].id === favorites[j].id) {
					favorites[j] = favoritesToUpdate[i];
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		var sanatizedFavorites = this.removePropsHref(JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(favorites)));
		user.savePreference(preferenceName, JSON.stringify(sanatizedFavorites));

		return favorites;
	},

	// Returns a valid object with the user's bookmarks
	// Deprecated
	validatePreferences: function(favorites) {
		return typeof favorites == 'string' && favorites !== ''? this.parsePreferences(favorites) : [];
	},

	// Ensures the the provided bookmarks data is json parsable
	// Deprecated
	parsePreferences: function(favorites) {
		favorites = JSON.parse(favorites);

		// Intentionally included for potential backwards compatability 06/3/21
		if (typeof favorites.length == 'undefined') {
			favorites = [favorites];
		}

		return favorites;
	},

	// Add correct URL to each of the user's bookmarks
	// Deprecated
	getURLForFavorites: function(favorites) {
		var parentScope = this;
		favorites.forEach(function(favorite) {
			if (!favorite.props) {
				favorite.props = {};
			}

			favorite.props.href = parentScope.getFavoriteURL(favorite);
		});

		return favorites;
	},

	// Based on the type of favorite, will create an appropriate URL based on the bookmark's data
	// Deprecated
	getFavoriteURL: function(favorite) {
		var tableURLMap = {
			"defaultURL": "?id=" + favorite.t + "&sys_id=" + favorite.id,
			"kb_article": '?id=cham_kb_article&sys_id=' + favorite.id
		};

		return tableURLMap[favorite.t] ? tableURLMap[favorite.t] : tableURLMap.defaultURL;
	},

	// Returns an array of Angular providers based on the providerTitle
	getProviderExtensions: function(providerTitle) {
		if (!providerTitle) {
			return;
		}
		var providers = [];
		var provm2mGR = new GlideRecord('m2m_sp_ng_pro_sp_ng_pro');
		provm2mGR.addQuery('sys_name', 'CONTAINS',  providerTitle);
		provm2mGR.query();

		while (provm2mGR.next()) {
			var prov = {};
			prov.name = provm2mGR.getDisplayValue('required_by');
			prov.sys_id = provm2mGR.getValue('required_by');
			prov.scope = provm2mGR.getDisplayValue('sys_scope');

			provGR = new GlideRecord('sp_angular_provider');
			provGR.get(prov.sys_id);
			prov.type = provGR.getValue('type');
			prov.updatedBy = provGR.getValue('sys_updated_by');
			prov.updateOn = provGR.getValue('sys_updated_on');

			providers.push(prov);
		}

		return providers;
	},

	// Returns array of widgets that use the particular providerTitle
	getWidgetsUsingProvider: function(providerTitle) {
		if (!providerTitle) {
			return;
		}

		var widgets = [];
		var widgetsm2mGR = new GlideRecord('m2m_sp_ng_pro_sp_widget');
		widgetsm2mGR.addQuery('sys_name', "CONTAINS", providerTitle + ".");
		widgetsm2mGR.query();

		while (widgetsm2mGR.next()) {
			var widget = {};
			widget.name = widgetsm2mGR.getDisplayValue('sp_widget');
			widget.sys_id = widgetsm2mGR.getValue('sp_widget');

			var widgetGR = new GlideRecord('sp_widget');
			if (widgetGR.get(widget.sys_id)) {
				widget.scope = widgetGR.getDisplayValue('sys_scope');
				widget.updatedBy = widgetGR.getValue('sys_updated_by');

				widgets.push(widget);
			}
		}

		return widgets;
	},

	// Gets a record count based on the provided table and encoded_query
	getCount: function(options) {
		if (!options.table || !options.encoded_query) {
			return;
		}
		var count = 0;
		/* 
		If the data method is changed to GlideRecordSecure this method will need an update
		GlideAggregate does not use the same security checks and GRSecure. 
		*/
		var agg = new GlideAggregate(options.table);
		agg.addEncodedQuery(options.encoded_query);
		agg.addAggregate('COUNT');
		agg.query();

		if (agg.next()) {
			count = agg.getAggregate('COUNT');
		}

		return parseInt(count);
	},

	// Returns an array of objects based on the provided table, encoded_query, and limit
	getData: function(options) {
		if (!options.table || !options.encoded_query) {
			return;
		}

		var items = [];

		/* 
		If this is changed to GlideRecordSecure the counts method will need an update
		GlideAggregate does not use the same security checks and GRSecure. 
		*/
		var itemsGR = new GlideRecord(options.table);
		itemsGR.addEncodedQuery(options.encoded_query);

		if (options.limit) {
			itemsGR.setLimit(options.limit);
		}

		itemsGR.query();

		var fieldsArr = this._getTableColumns(options.table);

		while (itemsGR.next()) {
			var item = {};

			fieldsArr.forEach(function(field) {
				item[field] = itemsGR.getValue(field);
			});

			items.push(item);
		}

		return items;
	},

	// Returns an array of field names for the provided table
	// Handles extended tables
	_getTableColumns: function(table) {
		var arr_fields = [];
		var fields = new GlideRecord('sys_dictionary');
		fields.addQuery('name', table);
		fields.addEncodedQuery('internal_type!=collection^ORinternal_type=NULL');
		fields.query();
		while (fields.next()) {
			arr_fields.push(fields.element.toString());
		}

		//Recursively get parent table fields	
		var baseFieldsGR = new GlideRecord('sys_db_object');	
		if (baseFieldsGR.get('name', table)) {	
			if (!gs.nil(baseFieldsGR.getDisplayValue('super_class'))) {	
				var parentTableName = baseFieldsGR.super_class.getRefRecord().name;	
				arr_fields = arr_fields.concat(this._getTableColumns(parentTableName)); // concat creates a new array	
			}	
		}	

		return arr_fields;
	},
	
	/**
	 * Table security checker.
	 *
	 * Usage:
	   Primary usage is to immediate interrupt widget code if access is not veritied:

		api.verifyTableAccess('sc_cat_item_guide');
		
		However, the method can be caught and redirected. Please understand the security implications first. For example:
		try {
			api.verifyTableAccess('sc_cat_item_guide');
		} catch (e) {
			console.log("Caught sc_cat_item_guide table access prohibited.");
		}
	 */
	verifyTableAccess: function(table){
		var loggedIn = gs.getSession().isLoggedIn();
		var hasAccess = new global.SNCACLUtil().hasPublicAccess(table);
		
		if (!loggedIn && !hasAccess) {			
			throw "No Table Access Exception";
		} else {
			gs.info("Table access verified: " + table);
		}
	},

    type: 'ChameleonAPI'
};]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>mc.admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-03-06 13:33:33</sys_created_on><sys_id>572230768388e210c0fb56d6feaad3ad</sys_id><sys_mod_count>3</sys_mod_count><sys_name>ChameleonAPI</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Employee Center Core" source="sn_hr_sp">3d1da2705b021200a4656ede91f91ab6</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Employee Center Core">3d1da2705b021200a4656ede91f91ab6</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_572230768388e210c0fb56d6feaad3ad</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>dditan</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-03-17 10:00:24</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include><sys_es_latest_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><id>572230768388e210c0fb56d6feaad3ad</id><sys_created_by>mc.admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-03-06 13:33:33</sys_created_on><sys_id>2e62b8768388e210c0fb56d6feaad3e5</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>mc.admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-03-06 13:33:33</sys_updated_on><table>sys_script_include</table><use_es_latest>true</use_es_latest></sys_es_latest_script></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>public</access><active>true</active><api_name>sn_hr_sp.ChameleonPadAPI</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description/><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>ChameleonPadAPI</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[var ChameleonPadAPI = Class.create();
ChameleonPadAPI.prototype = Object.extendsObject(sn_hr_sp.ChameleonAPI, {
	
	getItemsCount: function(options) {
		var count = 0;
		var queries = sn_hr_sp.CHAMConstants.MY_ITEMS_QUERIES;

		for (var e in queries) {
			var ga = new GlideAggregate(e);
			ga.addEncodedQuery(String(queries[e]));
			ga.addQuery('active', true);
			ga.addAggregate('COUNT');
			ga.query();
			
			if (ga.next())
				count+= Number(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'));
		}
		
		return count;
	},
	
	//Gets Topic Page data to display a custom heading for Topic Pages
	getTopicPageData: function(options){
		if (!options)
			options = {};

		try {
			var results = [];
			var topicID = $sp.getParameter('topic_id');

			var z = new GlideRecord('topic');
			z.get(topicID);

			var a = {};
			a.title = z.getDisplayValue('name');
			a.description = z.getDisplayValue('description');
			a.icon = z.getDisplayValue('icon');
			a.banner_image = z.getDisplayValue('banner_image');
			if(a.banner_image == ""){
				a.banner_image = this.getBannerImage(topicID);
			}

			results.push(a);

			return results;

		} catch (e) {
			gs.error('getTopicPageData failed: ' + e.message);
			return [];
		}

	},

	//Returns image string - called from getTopicPageData
	getBannerImage: function(sysId){
		var topic = new GlideRecord("topic");
		if(topic.get(sysId)){
			var image = topic.getDisplayValue('banner_image');
			var parent = topic.getValue('parent_topic');

			if(image != ""){
				return image;
			}else if(parent != ""){
				return this.getBannerImage(parent);
			}else{
				return "cham-topic-default.jpg";
			}
		}else{
			return "cham-topic-default.jpg";
		}
	},

	// Returns array of requests and incidents
	getItems: function(options) {
		if (!options) options = {};

		var results = this._getSortedResults([
			this._getIncidents(options),
			this._getRequests(options),
			this._getHRCases(options),
			this._getChangeRequests(options),
			this._getProblems(options)
			//this._getFacilitiesRequests(options)
		]);

		if (options.limit)
			results = results.slice(0, options.limit);

		return results;
	},

	_getChangeRequests: function(options) {
		var results = [];
		var z = new GlideRecord('change_request');
		if (options.change_query) {
			z.addEncodedQuery(options.change_query);
		} else {
			z.addEncodedQuery(CHAMConstants.MY_ITEMS_QUERIES.change_request);
		}
		if (options.active_only)
			z.addActiveQuery();
		if (options.filters && options.filters['active'])
			z.addEncodedQuery(this._getActiveQuery(options));
		if (options.filters && options.filters['date_updated_query'])
			z.addEncodedQuery(options.filters['date_updated_query'].value);
		z.orderByDesc('sys_updated_on');
		if (options.limit)
			z.setLimit(options.limit);
		z.query();
		while (z.next()) {
			var a = {};
			a.columns = [
				{ "name": "short_description", "label": "Description", "class": "col-sm-6 col-xs-12" },
				{ "name": "u_approval_stage_dv", "label": "Approval Stage", "class": "col-sm-3 col-xs-6" },
				{ "name": "end_date_dv", "label": "End Date", "class": "col-sm-3 col-xs-6" }
			];

			this._setPrimaryFields(a, z);
			a.u_approval_stage_dv = z.getDisplayValue('u_approval_stage');
			a.end_date = z.getValue('end_date');
			a.end_date_dv = z.getDisplayValue('end_date');
			a.requested_for = z.getValue('requested_for');
			a.requested_for_dv = z.getDisplayValue('requested_for');
			a.rel_opened_by = (a.opened_by == this.user_id);
			a.rel_opened_for = (a.requested_for == this.user_id);
			a.rel_watching = (a.watch_list.indexOf(this.user_id) !== -1);
			a.__page = this.ticket_page;
			a.type = 'change';
			a.type_dv = 'Change';
			a.href = "?id=" + a.__page + "&table=" + a.__table + "&sys_id=" + a.sys_id;

			results.push(a);
		}

		return results;
	},

	_getProblems: function(options) {
		var results = [];
		var z = new GlideRecord('problem');
		if (options.problem_query) {
			z.addEncodedQuery(options.problem_query);
		} else {
			z.addEncodedQuery(CHAMConstants.MY_ITEMS_QUERIES.problem);
		}
		if (options.active_only)
			z.addActiveQuery();
		if (options.filters && options.filters['active'])
			z.addEncodedQuery(this._getActiveQuery(options));
		if (options.filters && options.filters['date_updated_query'])
			z.addEncodedQuery(options.filters['date_updated_query'].value);
		z.orderByDesc('sys_updated_on');
		if (options.limit)
			z.setLimit(options.limit);
		z.query();
		while (z.next()) {
			var a = {};
			a.columns = [
				{ "name": "short_description", "label": "Description", "class": "col-sm-6 col-xs-12" },
				{ "name": "u_requested_by_dv", "label": "Requested By", "class": "col-sm-6 col-xs-12" }
			];

			this._setPrimaryFields(a, z);
			a.requested_by = z.getValue('u_requested_by');
			a.requested_by_dv = z.getDisplayValue('u_requested_by');
			a.rel_opened_by = (a.opened_by == this.user_id);
			a.rel_opened_for = (a.requested_for == this.user_id);
			a.rel_watching = (a.watch_list.indexOf(this.user_id) !== -1);
			a.__page = this.ticket_page;
			a.type = 'problem';
			a.type_dv = 'Problem';
			a.href = "?id=" + a.__page + "&table=" + a.__table + "&sys_id=" + a.sys_id;

			results.push(a);
		}

		return results;
	},

	_getRequests: function(options) {
		var results = [];
		var z = new GlideRecord('sc_req_item');
		if (options.request_query)
			z.addEncodedQuery(options.request_query);
		else {
			z.addEncodedQuery(CHAMConstants.MY_ITEMS_QUERIES.sc_req_item);
		}
		if (options.active_only)
			z.addActiveQuery();
		if (options.filters && options.filters['active'])
			z.addEncodedQuery(this._getActiveQuery(options));
		if (options.filters && options.filters['date_updated_query'])
			z.addEncodedQuery(options.filters['date_updated_query'].value);
		z.orderByDesc('sys_updated_on');
		if (options.limit)
			z.setLimit(options.limit);
		z.query();
		while (z.next()) {

			var a = {};
			a.columns = [
				{ "name": "short_description", "label": "Description", "class": "col-sm-6 col-xs-12" },
				{ "name": "stage_dv", "label": "Stage", "class": "col-sm-3 col-xs-6" },
				{ "name": "delivery_date_dv", "label": "Delivery Date", "class": "col-sm-3 col-xs-6" }
			];

			this._setPrimaryFields(a, z);
			a.stage = z.getValue('stage');
			a.stage_dv = z.getDisplayValue('stage');
			a.delivery_date = z.getValue('due_date');
			a.delivery_date_dv = z.getDisplayValue('due_date');
			a.requested_for = z.getValue('requested_for');
			a.requested_for_dv = z.getDisplayValue('requested_for');
			a.rel_opened_by = (a.opened_by == this.user_id);
			a.rel_opened_for = (a.requested_for == this.user_id);
			a.rel_watching = (a.watch_list.indexOf(this.user_id) !== -1);
			a.__page = this.ticket_page;
			a.type = 'request';
			a.type_dv = 'Request';
			a.href = "?id=" + a.__page + "&table=" + a.__table + "&sys_id=" + a.sys_id;

			if (z.getValue("cat_item")) {
				var catItemGR = z.cat_item.getRefRecord();
				a.picture = catItemGR.getDisplayValue('picture');
			}

			results.push(a);
		}
		return results;
	},

	getTodos: function(options) {
		var limit = options && options.limit ? options.limit : 3;
		var todoUtil = new sn_hr_sp.todoPageUtils();
		var tds = todoUtil.getMyTodos(limit, null);
		return tds.recordsToShow.open || [];
	},

	_getHRCases: function(options) {
		var results = [];
		var z = new GlideRecord('sn_hr_core_case');
		if (!z.isValid())
			return results;

		if (options.hr_case_query)
			z.addEncodedQuery(options.hr_case_query);
		else {
			z.addEncodedQuery(CHAMConstants.MY_ITEMS_QUERIES.sn_hr_core_case);
		}

		if (options.active_only)
			z.addActiveQuery();
		if (options.filters && options.filters['date_updated_query'])
			z.addEncodedQuery(options.filters['date_updated_query'].value);
		z.orderByDesc('sys_updated_on');
		if (options.limit)
			z.setLimit(options.limit);
		z.query();
		
		while (z.next()) {
			var a = {};
			a.columns = [
				{"name":"short_description", "label": "Description", "class": "col-md-6"},
				{"name":"assignment_group", "label": "Assignment Group", "class": "col-md-3"},
				{"name":"priority", "label": "Priority", "class": "col-md-3"}
			];
			this._setPrimaryFields(a, z);
			a.picture = "cham-hr-icon.png";
			a.assignment_group = z.getDisplayValue('assignment_group');
			//a.__page = this.ticket_page;
			a.__page = 'hrm_ticket_page';
			a.type = 'hr_case';
			a.type_dv = 'HR Case';
			a.href = "?id=" + a.__page + "&table=" + a.__table + "&sys_id=" + a.sys_id;
			results.push(a);
		}
		return results;
	},

	_getFacilitiesRequests: function(options) {
		var results = [];
		var z = new GlideRecord('facilities_request');
		if (!z.isValid())
			return results;
		z.addEncodedQuery("opened_byDYNAMIC90d1921e5f510100a9ad2572f2b477fe^ORopened_forDYNAMIC90d1921e5f510100a9ad2572f2b477fe");
		if (options.active_only)
			z.addActiveQuery();
		if (options.filters && options.filters['date_updated_query'])
			z.addEncodedQuery(options.filters['date_updated_query'].value);
		z.orderByDesc('sys_updated_on');
		if (options.limit)
			z.setLimit(options.limit);
		z.query();
		while (z.next()) {
			var a = {};
			a.columns = [
				{"name":"short_description", "label": "Description", "class": "col-md-6"},
				{"name":"category", "label": "Category", "class": "col-md-3"},
				{"name":"priority", "label": "Priority", "class": "col-md-3"}
			];
			this._setPrimaryFields(a, z);
			a.picture = "cham-fac-icon.png";
			a.category = z.getDisplayValue('category');
			a.__page = this.ticket_page;
			a.type = 'facilities';
			a.type_dv = 'Facilities Request';
			a.href = "?id=" + a.__page + "&table=" + a.__table + "&sys_id=" + a.sys_id;
			results.push(a);
		}
		return results;
	},

	getECFavoritesCount: function(portalId){
		var types = this.getFavCategories();
		var results = {};
		results.all = {"count": 0,
					   "name": "all"};
		for(var i=0; i<types.length; i++){
			var a = {};
			var fav = new GlideAggregate('sn_ex_sp_st_favorite');
			fav.addQuery("portal", portalId);
			fav.addQuery("category", types[i].sys_id);
			fav.addAggregate('COUNT');
			fav.query();
			var count = 0;
			a.name = types[i].type;
			a.sys_id = types[i].sys_id;

			if(fav.next()){
				count = fav.getAggregate('COUNT');
			}
			a.count = parseInt(count);
			results.all.count += a.count;
			results[a.name] = a;
		}
		return results;
	},

	getFavCategories: function(options){
		var results = [];
		var type = new GlideRecord('sn_ex_sp_favorite_content_type');
		type.addQuery("active", true);
		type.query();

		while(type.next()){
			var a = {};
			a.type = type.getDisplayValue('name');
			a.sys_id = type.getUniqueValue();
			results.push(a);
		}

		return results;

	},

	// Will fetch OOB favorites for the current user and portal.
	getECFavorites: function (options) {
		var favoritesGr = new GlideRecord('sn_ex_sp_st_favorite');
		favoritesGr.addQuery("portal", options.portal);		

		if (options.limit_num)
			options.limit = options.limit_num;
		// 		if (options.limit)
		// 			favoritesGr.setLimit(options.limit);
		if (options.category) 
			favoritesGr.addQuery("category", options.category);
		favoritesGr.query();

		var favorites = [];

		while (favoritesGr.next() && favorites.length < options.limit) {

			var type = favoritesGr.getDisplayValue("category");
			var secondaryVal = favoritesGr.getValue("secondary_display");

			var favorite = {
				"sysId": favoritesGr.getUniqueValue() || '',
				"tableName": favoritesGr.getValue("table_name") || '',
				"iconClass": favoritesGr.getValue("badge_icon") ? 'fa-' + favoritesGr.getValue("badge_icon") : '',
				"type": type || '',
				"primaryField": favoritesGr.getDisplayValue("primary_display") || '',
				"image": favoritesGr.getDisplayValue("fav_image") || '',
				"secondaryField": favoritesGr.getValue("secondary_display") || '',
				"href": favoritesGr.getValue("url") || '',
				"target": favoritesGr.getValue("target") || '',
				"end": favoritesGr.getValue("end") || ''
			};

			//limit character length on secondary field for kb
			if (type == "Article" && secondaryVal) {
				if(secondaryVal.length > 112)
				favorite.secondaryField = secondaryVal.trim().substring(0, 112) + "...";
			} else {
				favorite.secondaryField = favoritesGr.getValue("secondary_display") || '';
			}

			favorites.push(favorite);

		}

		return favorites;

	},

	//Retrieves recently viewed Catalog Items and Knowledge Articles
	//Returns data as an array
	getRecentItems: function(options) {
		if (!options) 
			var options = {};

		try {
			var limit = options.limit_num ? options.limit_num : 8;
			var results = [];
			var ids = [];

			var logGR = new GlideRecord('sp_log');
			logGR.addEncodedQuery('type=KB Article View^ORtype=Cat Item View^userDYNAMIC90d1921e5f510100a9ad2572f2b477fe^sys_created_onRELATIVEGT@month@ago@6');

			logGR.orderByDesc('sys_created_on');
			logGR.query();

			while (logGR.next()) {
				if (results.length === limit)
					break;

				var id = logGR.getValue('id');
				if (this.isAlreadyAdded(id, ids))
					continue;

				var params = {
					sys_id: id,
					type: logGR.getDisplayValue('type'),
					table: logGR.getValue('table')
				};

				if (this.isNotActive(params))
					continue;

				var type = logGR.getDisplayValue('type');

				if(type == "Cat Item View"){
					var item = this.getItemDataSC(params);
				}else if(type == "KB Article View"){
					var item = this.getItemDataKB(params);
				}else{
					continue;
				}

				results.push(item);
				ids.push(id);
			}
			return results;
		} catch (e) {
			gs.error('ChameleonPadAPI - getRecentItems failed: ' + e.message);
			return [];
		}
	},

	//Called from getRecentItems - checks if the item is active
	//Returns boolean value
	isNotActive: function(item){
		var grActive = new GlideRecord(item.table);
		grActive.get(item.sys_id);

		var active = grActive.getDisplayValue('active');
		return active === false ? true : false;
	},

	//Called from getRecentItems - checks if the item is already in the list
	//Returns boolean value
	isAlreadyAdded: function(item, array) {
		return array.indexOf(item) === -1 ? false : true;
	},

	//Called from getRecentItems - Returns values for Catalog Items
	//Returns as object
	getItemDataSC: function(options) {
		var sc_item = {};
		var scGR = new GlideRecord(options.table);
		scGR.get(options.sys_id);

		sc_item.sys_id = options.sys_id;
		sc_item.type = 'Request';
		sc_item.iconClass = "fa-pencil-square-o";
		sc_item.table = options.table;
		if(options.table == "sc_cat_item_guide")
			sc_item.url = '?id=sc_cat_item_guide&sys_id=' + sc_item.sys_id;
		if(options.table != "sc_cat_item_guide")
			sc_item.url = '?id=sc_cat_item&sys_id=' + sc_item.sys_id;
		sc_item.title = scGR.getDisplayValue('name');
		sc_item.description = scGR.getDisplayValue('short_description');
		sc_item.delivery_time = scGR.getDisplayValue('delivery_time');
		sc_item.show_delivery_type = scGR.getValue('u_delivery_type') == 'auto' ? true : false;
		sc_item.topic = scGR.getDisplayValue("taxonomy_topic");
		return sc_item;
	},

	//Called from getRecentItems - Returns values for Knowledge Articles
	//Returns as object
	getItemDataKB: function(options) {
		var kb_item = {};
		var kbGR = new GlideRecord(options.table);
		kbGR.get(options.sys_id);

		kb_item.sys_id = options.sys_id;
		kb_item.type = 'Article';
		kb_item.iconClass = "fa-file-text-o";
		kb_item.table = options.table;
		kb_item.url = '?id=kb_article&sys_id=' + kb_item.sys_id;
		kb_item.title = kbGR.getDisplayValue('short_description');
		var description = kbGR.getDisplayValue('text');
		kb_item.description = description.replace(/<\/?[^>]+(>|$)/g, "");
		kb_item.topic = kbGR.getDisplayValue("taxonomy_topic");

		return kb_item;
	},
	
	getApprovals: function(options) {	
		var esigRequiredMap = options.check_esignature ? this._getEsigs() : {};

		var results = [];

		var z = new GlideRecord('sysapproval_approver');

		var myApprovals = global.getMyApprovals();
		z.addQuery("approver", myApprovals);
		if (options.encoded_query) {
			z.addEncodedQuery(options.encoded_query);
		}
		if (options.filters && options.filters['state']) {
			var query = this._getStateQuery(options);

			if (query) {
				z.addEncodedQuery(query);
			}
		}
		if (options.filters && options.filters['date_updated_query']) {
			z.addEncodedQuery(options.filters['date_updated_query'].value);
		}
		if (options.limit) {
			z.setLimit(options.limit);
		}
		z.orderBy("sys_created_on");

		z.query();
		while (z.next()) {

			var a = {};
			a.columns = [
				{ "name": "record_opened_by", "label": "Opened By", "class": "col-md-2" },
				{ "name": "record_requested_for", "label": "Requested For", "class": "col-md-2" },
				{ "name": "record_opened_date", "label": "Open Date", "class": "col-md-2" },
				{ "name": "record_short_description", "label": "Short Description", "class": "col-md-6"}
			];
			this._setPrimaryFields(a, z);

			a.type = 'approval';
			a.type_dv = 'Approval';
			a.href = "?id=" + this.approval_page + "&table=sysapproval_approver&sys_id=" + a.sys_id;
			a.approver = z.getValue('approver');
			a.approver_dv = z.getDisplayValue('approver');
			a.delagated_approval = z.getValue("approver") != gs.getUserID();

			var recordGR = this.getRecordBeingApproved(z);
			if (!recordGR.isValidRecord())
				continue;

			a.record_opened_date = recordGR.getDisplayValue('sys_created_on').split(' ')[0];
			a.record_number = recordGR.getDisplayValue();
			a.record_sys_id = recordGR.getUniqueValue();
			a.record_table = recordGR.getTableName();
			a.record_table_label = recordGR.getLabel();
			a.record_short_description = recordGR.getDisplayValue("short_description");
			a.e_sig_required = esigRequiredMap[a.record_table];

			if (recordGR.isValidField("opened_by") && !recordGR.opened_by.nil())
				a.record_opened_by = recordGR.opened_by.getDisplayValue();

			if (recordGR.isValidField("requested_by") && !recordGR.requested_by.nil())
				a.record_opened_by = recordGR.requested_by.getDisplayValue();
			
			if (recordGR.isValidField("requested_for") && !recordGR.requested_for.nil())
				a.record_requested_for = recordGR.requested_for.getDisplayValue();
			else if (recordGR.isValidField("u_requested_for") && !recordGR.u_requested_for.nil())
				a.record_requested_for = recordGR.u_requested_for.getDisplayValue();
			
			if (a.record_table == "sc_request") {
				var itemsGR = new GlideRecord("sc_req_item");
				itemsGR.addQuery("request", a.record_sys_id);
				itemsGR.query();
				if (itemsGR.getRowCount() > 1) {
					a.record_short_description = itemsGR.getRowCount() + " " + gs.getMessage("requested items");
				} else {
					itemsGR.next();
					a.record_short_description = itemsGR.short_description.toString();
				}
			}

			results.push(a);

		}

		return this._getSortedResults([results]);

	},

	type: 'ChameleonPadAPI'
});]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>mc.admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-03-06 11:13:02</sys_created_on><sys_id>9180587a83c4e210c0fb56d6feaad35f</sys_id><sys_mod_count>10</sys_mod_count><sys_name>ChameleonPadAPI</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Employee Center Core" source="sn_hr_sp">3d1da2705b021200a4656ede91f91ab6</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Employee Center Core">3d1da2705b021200a4656ede91f91ab6</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_9180587a83c4e210c0fb56d6feaad35f</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>mc.admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-03-07 13:09:20</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include><sys_es_latest_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><id>9180587a83c4e210c0fb56d6feaad35f</id><sys_created_by>mc.admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-03-06 11:13:02</sys_created_on><sys_id>1042dcfa83c4e210c0fb56d6feaad34e</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>mc.admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-03-06 11:13:02</sys_updated_on><table>sys_script_include</table><use_es_latest>true</use_es_latest></sys_es_latest_script></record_update>

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sp_widget"><sp_widget action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><category>sc</category><client_script><![CDATA[function($scope, spAriaUtil, i18n, spModal) {

    var c = this;

    c.trackPage = function() {
        window.GlideWebAnalytics.trackEvent("Service Catalog", "Catalog My Requests", "My Requests Widget Loaded");
    }

    if (c.data.is_new_order)
        spAriaUtil.sendLiveMessage(c.data.requestSubmitMsg);

    c.viewFilter = 'open';
    c.filterOptions = [{key:'open',value:c.data.messages.openRequests},{key:'close',value:c.data.messages.closedRequests}];

    c.changeView = function() {
        window.GlideWebAnalytics.trackEvent("Service Catalog", "Catalog My Requests", "Open/Close Filter Toggled");
        c.server.get({
            action: "change_view",
            view: c.viewFilter,
            search_text: c.filterText
        }).then(function(response) {
            c.data = response.data;
            var resultMsg = (c.data.request.req_list.length == 1 ? 'result' : 'results') + ' returned';
            spAriaUtil.sendLiveMessage(i18n.getMessage('{0} ' + resultMsg).withValues([c.data.request.req_list.length]));
        });
    }

    c.search = function() {
        c.server.get({
            action: 'search',
            search_text: c.filterText,
            view: c.viewFilter
        }).then(function(response) {
            c.data = response.data;
            var resultMsg = (c.data.request.req_list.length == 1 ? 'result' : 'results') + ' returned';
            spAriaUtil.sendLiveMessage(i18n.getMessage('{0} ' + resultMsg).withValues([c.data.request.req_list.length]));
        });
    }

    c.checkEnter = function(event) {
        if (event.which === 13)
            c.search();
    }


    c.filterDraftItem = function(item) {
        if (!c.data.draftSearchText)
            return true; // If no searchText, return true to show all items

        var searchText = c.data.draftSearchText.toLowerCase();

        // Perform the filtering based on item.name or item.displayName
        return (
            (item.name && item.name.toLowerCase().includes(searchText)) ||
            (item.cart_item_name && item.cart_item_name.toLowerCase().includes(searchText))
        );
    };

    c.updateFilteredDraftItems = function() {
        if (!c.data.draftItems)
            return;

        if (!c.data.draftSearchText)
            c.filteredDraftItems = c.data.draftItems;
        else {
            c.filteredDraftItems = c.data.draftItems.filter(function(item) {
                return c.filterDraftItem(item)
            });
        }
    }

    c.filteredDraftItems = [];
    c.updateFilteredDraftItems();

    c.removeDraftItem = function(cartItem) {
        var options = {
            title: c.data.deleteDraftItemMsg,
            headerStyle: {
                border: 'none',
                'padding-bottom': 0
            },
            footerStyle: {
                border: 'none',
                'padding-top': 0
            },
            messageOnly: true,
            buttons: [{
                label: c.data.dialogCancel,
                primary: false
            }, {
                label: c.data.dialogDelete,
               // class: 'btn-danger',
                primary: true
            }],
        };

        spModal.open(options).then(function(actionButton) {
            if (actionButton) {
                if (!actionButton.primary)
                    return;

                c.fetchingDrafts = true;
                c.server.get({
                    action: "remove_item",
                    removeItemID: cartItem.sys_id,
                    prevLimit : c.data.draftItems && c.data.draftItems.length ? c.data.draftItems.length : 100,
                    attachmentTable: cartItem.attachment_table
                }).then(function(response) {
                    c.data.draftItems = response.data.draftItems;
                    c.data.hasMoreDrafts = response.data.hasMoreDrafts;
                    c.updateFilteredDraftItems();
                    c.fetchingDrafts = false;
                });
            }
        });
    }

    c.loadMore = function() {
        window.GlideWebAnalytics.trackEvent("Service Catalog", "Catalog My Requests", "Show More Clicked");
        var currentRequests = c.data.request.req_list.length;
        spAriaUtil.sendLiveMessage("${Loading more requests}");
        c.fetching = true;
        c.server.get({
            action: 'fetch_more',
            lastLimit: c.data.lastLimit,
            view: c.viewFilter,
            search_text: c.filterText
        }).then(function(response) {
            var addedRequests = response.data.request.req_list.length - currentRequests;
            var resultMsg = (addedRequests == 1 ? 'request' : 'requests') + ' added';
            spAriaUtil.sendLiveMessage(i18n.getMessage('{0} ' + resultMsg).withValues([addedRequests]));
            c.data = response.data;
            c.fetching = false;
        });
    }

    c.loadMoreDrafts = function() {
            c.fetchingDrafts = true;

            c.server.get({
                action : 'fetch_more_draft_items',
                prevLimit: c.data.draftItems && c.data.draftItems.length ? c.data.draftItems.length : 100,
            }).then(function(response){
                c.data.draftItems = response.data.draftItems;
                c.data.hasMoreDrafts = response.data.hasMoreDrafts;
                c.updateFilteredDraftItems();
                c.fetchingDrafts = false;
        });
    }

    c.changeSelectedTab = function(selectedTab) {
        c.data.isRequestsTabActive = selectedTab == "requests";
        c.data.isDraftsTabActive = selectedTab == "drafts";
    }
}]]></client_script><controller_as>c</controller_as><css>$sp-space--sm: 8px !default;

 	color: $primary;

}

  > .list-group, >.panel-collapse{
    	.list-group-item {
		  	border-width: 1px 0 0 0;

  .requests-header-container {
    margin: 0px;
